npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.0: I am Brownbark. If you seek answers, I can honestly tell you that I am not the one you should ask.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.1: I have left my "brethren" a long time ago in search of solitude.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.10: GreyLeaf is the powerful "Daemon" "Tree" that roams in "Ravenwood".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.11: Bane is the mad man who attempts to control the island.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.12: Beware of the monsters that roam in the desert of Vulture's Den.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.13: Silversky is the only town on "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.14: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.15: Althea is the name of the world in which we live in.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.16: Artherk is the human's God of Healing and Mending.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.17: I have never seen it myself.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.18: I cannot taste the softness of flesh.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.19: I am not the Oracle. I do not have answers for everything.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.2: They have been hired by "Bane" "Blackblood" himself to cause mischiefs.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.20: It is time for you to depart, %s.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.3: He is a befuddled wizard but do not judge him hastily. He is quite powerful in the Art.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.4: If you see them, they are located to the south-west of "Silversky".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.5: The Forest Guardian are the protectors of Light. They are allied with the "Druids".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.6: The Daemon Trees are the evil counterpart of the "Forest" "Guardians". They do not see the Light, they only see darkness and hatred.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.7: Ravenwood is the name of the cursed forest.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.8: This is a beautiful place, isn't it? There is no hatred here. Only peace.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.9: I used to be allied with "GreyLeaf" but I have learned the mistakes of my ways. The "Forest" "Guardians" showed me the light. I've decided to reside in this peaceful place known as "mirror" "lake".
npc.topic.adriana.10: There have been several adventurers seeking my training, but none that seemed too unusual.
npc.topic.adriana.11: Come back if you ever need more training!
npc.topic.adriana.2: If you want help developing those fighting skills, you've come to the right place! I have a very useful skill I can "teach" you. You won't find all the tricks I can teach you in a "book", that much I can tell you!
npc.topic.adriana.3: Very good, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.adriana.4: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.adriana.5: So you've met my assistant? He's alright, I guess.
npc.topic.adriana.6: I have nothing to say about him! Ask someone else!
npc.topic.adriana.7: Hey! You've got a Book of Warfare on you? Think you'd be interested in trading it? I'll give you a Blade of Sharpness in return. So, what do you say, yes or no?
npc.topic.adriana.8: Hmmm. I am not exactly the bookworm-type but if you ever get a grip on a book called the "Book" "of" "Warfare", I would be immensely grateful if you could give it to me.
npc.topic.adriana.9: I tell you, that boy's cooking is pretty amazing! If he only had a little more enthusiasm and determination, he could start his own tavern!
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.0: What? You've lost the precious platinum ring I gave you? Humpft! You should be careful, it is a precious magical item. Hmmmm, I think I could manage to sell another one to you for.. *ahem* 50,000 gold pieces. Is that a deal?
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.1: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.10: The Kingdom of Goldmoon is currently ruled by King Theodore XIII.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.11: The Nightblades are a group of assassins working for "Bane".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.12: The spellbook is the most precious thing in the life of a wizard.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.13: Ravenwood? Surely you do not want to go there by yourself. Instead, you should travel south to where the "druids" are located. The Forest Guardians up there will protect you.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.14: Since the Forest Guardians and the druids both share the same concern about nature, it is just fitting that they should hang together.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.15: The druids strongly believe in the old ways and I advise you not to harm nature in their presence lest you want to taste their elemental fire blasts.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.16: I have attempted to find clues on what the future holds but failed miserably in understanding what the prophecies mean.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.17: Elysana BlackRose has much more powers than she wants to show. That is a shame that she did not want to ally with the council against our two strongest enemies: "Bane" "Blackblood" and the "orcs".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.18: The orcs combine the sheer strength of their savage warriors, the black magic of their filthy shamans and the might of their "siege" "weapons". Therefore, they are a serious threat to our "Kingdom" and they must be stopped otherwise they will win.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.19: Zhakar is a powerful wizard and I urge you not to underestimate his abilities. Despite his mental illness, he is still very competent in the arcane arts and is a valuable ally to our cause.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.2: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.20: Well, well. You've learned some pretty words, haven't you? Have a nice trip, on me!
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.3: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.4: I am Aloysius Starbolt, master wizard of this castle.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.5: Well, aside from being one of the king's many advisors, I am also a licensed spell-teacher. As a magic user, I often also need some magical components. If you come across some "tarantula" "eyes", I would gladly buy them from you.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.6: Ahh, finally, I am going to make some money... Oops, uh.. yes, ahem.. let's begin.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.7: Bane Blackblood is a self-centered butcher. He seeks to gain dominion over the Kingdom of Goldmoon and therefore often attempts to end King Theodore's life. In fact, he has created a group of assassins named the "Nightblades".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.8: King Theodore is not exactly a competent king but we could have gotten worse...Or could we?
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.9: I heard that there is a small oasis located right in the middle.
npc.topic.amandra.0: He goes by the name of "Haden".
npc.topic.amandra.1: Although he is my brother, I can't help but despise him for what he has done. It seems despite all the things I have done to keep him on the right path, he has strayed away from it.
npc.topic.amandra.4: I am constantly travelling in search of "adventure" to better hone my fighting skills.
npc.topic.amandra.5: The thrill of the hunt, the intensity of the chase and the joy of overcoming an adversary stronger than you, these are the things for which I live.
npc.topic.amandra.6: How do you know I have a brother? If this is some kind of foolish attempt at gaining my favor, I must warn you that it will not only fail, but it will also anger me!
npc.topic.amandra.7: A strange visitor? I have not really been paying attention to that.
npc.topic.amandra.8: Ahhh, so you wish to test your skills against mine, is that it?
npc.topic.amandra.9: Farewell, until the next time we meet.
npc.topic.amelia.0: No I swear! I was just passing by and I didn't... Huh? You're not with "them"? Oh thank god!
npc.topic.amelia.1: There were at least six of them and they attacked the High Priest. Before he even had a chance to react, he was taken away by the "brigands". I think I saw "where" they went.
npc.topic.amelia.2: I think they work for the necromancer because the guards didn't do anything to stop them... Oh please! You must do something! The townspeople don't dare oppose them.
npc.topic.amelia.3: They took the west bridge out of town... I think they went southwest after that, but I can't be sure.
npc.topic.amelia.5: Oh, I was just on my way to talk to the mayor.
npc.topic.annabelle.0: I'm Annabelle. Nice to make your acquaintance. What are you doing in these parts?
npc.topic.annabelle.10: Lighthaven is a small yet beautiful town located on the other side of the island.
npc.topic.annabelle.11: Windhowl is "Lighthaven"'s sister town located south. It's a bit far, but I heard the merchants have great merchandise up there. That reminds me, perhaps "William" will bring me back a gift when he comes back. I wonder what it could be... A silk dress, maybe? Yes, that would be nice.
npc.topic.annabelle.12: That's the island you are currently standing on. I hope you knew that or you are somewhat lost, methinks.
npc.topic.annabelle.13: I was a priestess, once... I am not ignorant in the matters of removing "curses" and "healing" the wounded.
npc.topic.annabelle.14: I can do little for you myself, but perhaps you could visit the "Old" "Hermit" and ask for his guidance. He has little power himself, but knows many powerful priests and has acquired great wisdom during his "exile".
npc.topic.annabelle.15: His real name is Theorn Lemnearan. He lives in the mountains and shuns people. Do not be surprised if he receives you coldly, but remember that he has a good heart.
npc.topic.annabelle.16: He left everything behind him to study his books and to finally have peace.
npc.topic.annabelle.18: Train you with what? I do not think I could help you.
npc.topic.annabelle.19: I have little to teach, alas, except perhaps the ways to a kinder, gentler lifestyle. *sigh* There are few students for that, nowadays.
npc.topic.annabelle.2: Oh, I do a little of this, a little of that. I'm just tidying things up until my "William" returns to me. He is a little late though.
npc.topic.annabelle.20: Mhorgwloth is the name of the "troll" who dwells around here.
npc.topic.annabelle.21: The brigands are brutes, but "Mhorgwloth" protects me from their dirty hands.
npc.topic.annabelle.22: Hmmmm... I see that "Balork" has put his evil mark upon your brow... Great sorrow it will bring you, I fear, but great achievements as well. Years ago, I could have removed it from you, but the demon's curse has grown in strength while the years have weakened my faith. Alas, I cannot "help" you.
npc.topic.annabelle.23: I have healed some of your wounds, but I cannot heal you more.
npc.topic.annabelle.24: Farewell. If you see my "William", tell him to meet me here at once.
npc.topic.annabelle.3: It seems like ages ago since he left for war. Still, he promised to meet me here, so I wait for him. Perhaps you've seen him? He's tall, dark and handsome...
npc.topic.annabelle.4: Yes, he walks around here, but he is not dangerous, not if you do not attack him. In fact, he is very friendly and always protects me from those "goblins".
npc.topic.annabelle.5: This is the Orkanis Castle, although it isn't as beautiful as it was before the "troll" established himself here.
npc.topic.annabelle.6: I do not like goblins, they are mean creatures.
npc.topic.annabelle.7: I heard that Jarko is a mad man. I hope somebody will be able to stop him.
npc.topic.annabelle.8: There are a few beings in this world that bestow curses upon innocents like you. They are truly evil beings.
npc.topic.annabelle.9: I shiver just to think of this monster! Does he still roam the dungeon below the temple of "Lighthaven", cursing people with his "Brand"?
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.1: I am Annithae Teardrop. And you are...? %s? I am pleased to make your acquaintance. I hope that your stay in our fair little town will be enjoyable.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.2: I tend to the chores I have to do around the house. In my spare time, I sometimes craft necklaces with the nice pearls I find. You see the one I'm wearing right now? I've made it myself.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.3: A tear-shaped pearl? Yes, I have a few of those. Why d'you ask, you need one? Well, I could depart myself of one tear-shaped pearl but it will cost you... let me see... 12,000 gold. I think it is fair enough since these are quite rare. Do we have a deal?
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.4: I don't really need your help finding them as I can find them by myself but thank you for offering your help. See? I already have alot of these nice tear-shaped pearls.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.5: I misjudged you for I thought that you were a decent person. Obviously, I was wrong.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.6: I'm afraid I'm not very good at this. If you need assistance with your quests, why don't you ask Chryseida the fortune teller? Her advice is expensive and it doesn't always come the first time, but it's always accurate and reliable when it *does* come.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.7: I sincerely hope to see you soon.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.1: I do what I can to keep this house from crumbling.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.3: The desert? Surely you do not want to go there. I almost prefer to stay in this damned forest then going into this infernal oven.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.4: Over here, King Theodore XIII has no powers.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.5: Morindin Arrowmist is a skilled hunter.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.7: You are always welcome in my small home.
npc.topic.antonian.0: I don't know anything about that.
npc.topic.antonian.1: That fast yes! Very exciting isn't it? You see, the high priest of Lighthaven recently asked me to look into matters concerning magical transportation. It seems this tablet is the answer to the high priest's "prayers".
npc.topic.antonian.2: Well, the stone's magic is so "ancient" that it predates even the oldest of races, making it impossible for any other magic, including Olin Haad's, to detect its use.
npc.topic.antonian.3: From what I can tell by the engravings, the tablet acts as a kind of focus. When the bearer of the tablet places it on a "nexus" "index", the tablet's rune that matches that of the nexus stone beside it will start to glow. I believe that if you activate enough of these runes, you will be able to travel to Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.antonian.4: I had originally sent Tarnian to activate the nexus stones, but I guess he got caught up in that crusade of his. I can give you "directions" to the stones to help you out. Oh I almost forgot, you can use the tablet at any time to come back here. When I discovered that, I had this cottage built so I could better study the tablet's behavior. You can use this knowledge to your advantage when activating the nexus stones.
npc.topic.antonian.5: Now where did I put those charts? Please excuse me a moment, I seem to have misplaced them...
npc.topic.antonian.6: While you were away looking for nexus stones, I received a message from the High Priest saying you were looking for the Nameless Bard. Unfortunately, I have no way of knowing where you will end up once you get to Raven's Dust. However, I can tell you that Silversky is on the southeastern part of the island. Maybe that will be enough for you to find it.
npc.topic.antonian.7: He's a zoologist that studies creatures that manifest some degree of intelligence. One day, he heard about this creature that could speak and he sought it out. He is now one of a few people who know where to find the Nameless Bard.
npc.topic.antonian.9: Oh, I am just an old hermit...
npc.topic.aquinos.0: The message said you were looking for the Nameless Bard... I'm still not sure how comfortable I feel about divulging his "location" to someone I barely know though...
npc.topic.aquinos.1: Well, if Antonian trusts you, then I suppose I should as well. He's always been a good judge of character you know. After all, he counts me among his friends! Heh heh. Alright, it's settled then. I will tell you "where" the Nameless Bard resides, so to speak.
npc.topic.aquinos.2: Because of his nature, the Nameless Bard lives deep inside a cave far to the west. Take the road out of town heading northwest, then at the second fork, the one where the road continues on north and branches off to the northwest, take the northwest route. Follow that road until it ends, then keep going west until you reach the mountain range. The entrance to the cave can be found in that viscinity.
npc.topic.aquinos.4: I am researching intelligent creatures and documenting their behavior.
npc.topic.araknor.0: You need some necromantic scrolls? Hmm, I suppose I can sell some to you. I don't have any right now so you must give me time to make some. I must warn you that they will cost no less than 10000 gold each. Do you still want me to create some?
npc.topic.araknor.1: Je peux vous transmettre une partie de mon savoir si vous êtes prêt à apprendre.
npc.topic.archibald.0: I am called Archibald. I only speak to Seraphs. If you're interested in visiting the "Forest" "of" "No" "Return", I'm your man.
npc.topic.archibald.2: I'm just a traveller. Did you know I've been to the "Forest" "of" "No" "Return"?
npc.topic.archibald.3: Maybe I'll see you later then.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.0: I am Sir Arganor Iargh. How are you faring, my friend?
npc.topic.arganoriargh.1: I am the chief trainer of this "town". I can "teach" you how to use your strength to inflict great damage in combat.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.2: Very good, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.3: I do not have time to train you. Talk to Garnir if you need some training.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.4: He shouldn't be too far. I'm sure you will find him.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.5: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.7: You are in Windhowl, the greatest town in the kingdom of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.asarr.0: Perhaps I could give you this small wooden box of jewels. They are worthless to me, but Lord Sunrock has a weakness for jewels. Actually, I think that I'll SELL you the box. It's a fair price for your cowardice, don't you agree? You could then lie to him and say that you defeated us--yeah right! Do you agree with this plan of action?
npc.topic.asarr.1: It's not a good thing to further endanger your life. You will have to settle your differences with Lord Sunrock.
npc.topic.asarr.10: I think you need one, don't you? Will not be a hard task, I tell you. Are you interested?
npc.topic.asarr.11: They treated us like beggars. They ain't gonna get away with that easily.
npc.topic.asarr.12: You've already robbed one diamond and brought it back to me. You don't hafta prove yourself worthy anymore.
npc.topic.asarr.13: How do ya think we handle those little vermins? We simply let them do the biggest part of our job, distract the villagers' attention. Why would we bother ourselves wtih them? They have tried to bypass our caves, but they surely do not have your skills. Goblin scouts occasionally find their way into our camp, but will never successfully find it unless they come with their entire army.
npc.topic.asarr.14: You did a good job fetching one of Lord Sunrock's precious diamonds. When one of my associate will deem you ready, he or she will tell you to come back to me and then, I'll be able to teach you some pretty neat tricks.
npc.topic.asarr.15: You did a good job fetching one of Lord Sunrock's precious diamonds. When one of my associate will deem you ready, he or she will tell you to come back to me and then, I'll be able to teach you some pretty neat tricks.
npc.topic.asarr.16: Before I trust you, you will have to do a "job" for me. Heh heh heh...
npc.topic.asarr.17: I already gave that useless rock to somebody else.
npc.topic.asarr.18: Yeah, yeah, I've already told you all I know about him.
npc.topic.asarr.19: I'd like you to deliver something to Lord Sunrock for me. You see, I like to taunt him once in a while and tell him what crime we're about to do. It drives him nuts because his troops are too inept to stop us. Would you do this for me?
npc.topic.asarr.2: Be careful with what ya ask, but I will tell you my name. Asarr, leader of all these "brigands".
npc.topic.asarr.20: Don't get lost on your way out.
npc.topic.asarr.5: The Shadow Guild? No, that's not us, it's what we're part of. Its headquarters are not on this island, nor on Raven's Dust. I'm the Guild's representative in the Kingdom of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.asarr.6: Why would I have to work when I can steal the wealth of others as easily as I would slay a goblin with my scimitar? Pfah! If I could get "information" about transactions between Lighthaven and Windhowl, I could wreak havoc and gain a fortune quite easily!
npc.topic.asarr.7: I heard the merchants were hiring adventurers to bring a "report" to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl...
npc.topic.asarr.8: Lord Sunrock owns the town of Windhowl. He is selfish and he does not want to share his wealth. But he will... Ah ha ha ha!
npc.topic.asarr.9: We are proud of what we do. We treat the "villagers" of Lighthaven and Windhowl like they have treated us a long time ago.
npc.topic.assystanter.0: I am Assyst Anter, greetings to you from our great town.
npc.topic.assystanter.1: I am in charge of keeping "count" of our soldiers. I also tend to the needs of our army by ordering weapons, armor and anything else our guards might need to accomplish their work.
npc.topic.assystanter.3: I heard she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.assystanter.4: I must say, it has decreased drastically. Moreover, some pirates have tried to rob our port. *sigh* I fear we will have more enemies to deal with in the near future. Fortunately, we still have some great warriors like "Guntertag" or "George" the IIIrd to repel invasions.
npc.topic.assystanter.5: I doubt even a goblin army would be able to defeat such a powerful man. I tell you, he's very dumb and his brain is probably as thick as his biceps, but what a great warrior he is! He once vanquished thirty goblins all by himself and he was still shouting for more. If only his brother, Murmuntag, would come live here instead of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.assystanter.6: It's the other town on the island, probably the one where you come from, I'll wager.
npc.topic.assystanter.7: George the IIIrd is one intelligent guy. After all, he isn't captain of the guards for nothing, you know. He doesn't fight with the brutality that is Guntertag's pride and joy, but he is so skilled that he can defeat just about anyone in a fair duel.
npc.topic.assystanter.8: May luck be with you in your travels.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.0: Say what you have to say. I do not have time for useless chit-chat with you.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.1: I'm known around here as Baldric Silverknife, the part-time "musician" and notable thief. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.11: Well, that's not all I do, but let's face it, it's fun isn't it? heh. I suppose I could "teach" you how if you ask me really nicely.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.12: Hmmm. Perhaps I have something for you. Meet "Doremas" and ask him if his low-life friend "Grimish" has what I require.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.13: Grimish is a goblin and I hate goblins. That's why I leave a fool like "Doremas" to deal with him.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.14: Doremas is but a fool. However, I find him useful at times. That's probably why I didn't cut his throat open.. for the time being anyways.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.15: You're barely making sense. Have you been drinking at Thorbin's filthy tavern or what? If so, you'll have to sober up before talking to me again.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.17: I'm a thief, not an assassin. The only person in town I would think who has the poison lore knowledge would be Elysana Blackrose. Stay out of troubles and remember... I've never seen you.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.19: Shhh! If the town guards hear you say his name, you will find yourself spending the remaining of your life in the "prison" of Silversky.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.20: I think Lord Bane has some but you'd be foolish to steal one from him nor do I want to be associated with you if you do such a thing.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.22: If you insist, I will tell you what I know but you must keep your voice low lest we want to get caught and executed by the royal guards for treason. "Blackblood" is the leader of the "Nightblades".
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.23: The Nightblades are a "group" of assassins recruited and trained by Blackblood himself. They combine the swift death of a dagger covered with lethal poison and the various offensive spells, they are the best assassins you will find around.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.24: To be able to enter into their organization, one must do the Test. Only those who succeed are accepted. I never did the Test thus I cannot really say what it is exactly. Only "Blackblood" knows. The "Nightblades" have sworn on their life and soul that they will never give any information regarding the Test to anyone.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.25: How should I know? Ask a Nightblade.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.26: "Kalir" and "Jamar" are often wandering in the desert. Quite frankly, I do not have a clue how they do it or for what purpose.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.27: Kalir and Jamir are both fools.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.28: Zhakar is an insane old wizard who lives secluded in his tower.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.3: Hmmm, I can tell you for a price. Are you willing to pay?
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.4: Well, I am quite a talented artist. I excell at the flute and the "drum" mostly. However, I can assure you that my voice is quite excellent as well.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.5: Yes, I enjoy playing the drum. Uhh? You want my drum? For what purpose? You don't know, eh? I betcha that old Thorbin is up to something. It doesn't bother me at all as he cannot truly understand art as well as I do. And also, I don't mind giving one of my drums as I have plenty of them in store. *smile* Now, let's get down to business. If you want the drum, you'll have to do a little "something" for me.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.6: Oh, geez! You've found a blood dagger and a gleaming shard? I am truly impressed by your well hidden talents. Do you want to give me the blood dagger and the gleaming shard?
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.7: Good luck finding one. I never said it would be easy to get this drum out of me. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.8: Listen up, buddy! You'll laugh when I tell you the simple task you have to do for me. You simply have to kill 10 of Rondy's pigs.
npc.topic.balork.0: I am Balork, servant of the "darkness".
npc.topic.balork.1: Whatever I spend my time doing, it is none of your concern.
npc.topic.balork.2: Heh, you're going to see a lot of it very soon.
npc.topic.balork.3: You still owe me some blood, worm.
npc.topic.balork.4: Aaah, now these are words to my liking. Perhaps you would like to join the darkness? I could use some help in undermining the authority of the priests who dwell above me. Would you accept such a mission?
npc.topic.balork.5: Shh! This you must whisper only to my ally, Kalastor.
npc.topic.balork.6: You will have to find somebody else to forge you a Gloomblade for I will not.
npc.topic.balork.7: Farewell, worm. If you haven't done so already, meet Kalastor on the surface.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.1: That's better. You learn quite fast. This is good for it could save your sorry life.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.10: It has been a while since we have met.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.11: Baldric Silverknife would do well to not interfere with us.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.12: Even the orc leader and its allies won't stand in my way!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.13: He is the only one around here I truly trust.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.14: Who cares about the desert? Surely not me!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.15: The royal crown shall be mine someday.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.16: You're standing on it, you maggot-pie!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.17: I have heard of these fairy-tales told to frighten the farmers. May all the fools on "Raven's" "Dust" consider me as the Harbinger.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.18: If the "Harbinger" ever shows up, he'll have to face ME.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.19: You've met with Jarko, haven't you? He is but a weakling. His little dabbling with necromancy is nothing compared to the raw power of my offensive spells.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.2: If you must talk to me, do it properly! I am "Lord" "Bane"!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.20: This old wizard can cause me some headaches. Although I rarely admit any weaknesses of mine, mainly because I have few, I must say that Zhakar's knowledge in the arcane arts is much more pronounced than mine. He could be a real threat to my plans...
npc.topic.baneblackblood.21: This is the name of our world.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.22: This is where the castle of King Theodore XIII is located.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.23: I rarely send "nightblades" for they sometimes do not return...
npc.topic.baneblackblood.24: And you think I'll reveal them to you? You must be a FOOL!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.25: Have you been cursed by that Balork? Are you feeling ill? Do I care? No. Quit mumbling about your problems or you'll get more.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.26: Ho-Ho! If Artherk, the god of healing and mending, does not approve of my actions, then why doesn't he stop me?
npc.topic.baneblackblood.27: I think you deserve a lesson.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.3: That is none of your business. I have but one fate for those who are too curious. Still, perhaps you can be useful. I need some rare "ingredients" normally used for magic.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.4: Bane Blackblood is the name. And soon, you and everyone shall bow down before me when you will hear it.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.5: All right, already! I've had enough of you! Here's your blasted key. You can bet it won't be so easy next time!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.7: Aah, finally, you are back, %s! You have brought me the two components I need? Do you agree to give me a pouch of blue cohosh and a manastone?
npc.topic.baneblackblood.8: Lighthaven is a small town in the northern "Arakas".
npc.topic.baneblackblood.9: Arakas is an island located north from here. The brigand leader "Asarr" controls everything up there.
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.0: My name's Bastien Milandra. I "work" here. I know I look big, but would you believe I'm only twelve?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.1: Um... Well, I don't do much, I just "help" folks around this town. Y'know, I have great magical powers. D'you believe me?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.2: Oh, sure, I could help you! Did I ever tell you my mother was a "Seraph" and she taught me all sorts of neat things. You believe me, right?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.3: Yes, my mom's a Seraph. She has nice wings now. Have you seen her?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.4: I like nice people. I like it when people believe me. I don't lie, y'know?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.5: AAAAH! You said a bad word!
npc.topic.belagan.10: Ahhh, now that I enjoy doing. I can practice my cooking skills and eventually maybe open my own tavern or something like it.
npc.topic.belagan.11: Alas, right now it is but a dream.
npc.topic.belagan.12: I do not recall seeing anyone out of the ordinary, but I could be wrong.
npc.topic.belagan.2: I help Adriana with the chores around the house. In exchange, she lets me stay for free.
npc.topic.belagan.3: Adriana is the mistress here. She is often too busy "training" adventurers in the art of war, so I take care of the everyday tasks, such as "cleaning" and "cooking".
npc.topic.belagan.4: Just like I said, Adriana takes care of that. If you seek to improve your skills or learn new ones, go seek her out.
npc.topic.belagan.5: I'm sorry, I'm a little busy right now...
npc.topic.belagan.6: I guess it's a cave where there are many illusions. I don't know where that would be, sorry.
npc.topic.belagan.7: I have nothing to say about that poison-brewing witch.
npc.topic.belagan.8: It is a book that teaches the finer points of the art of war. It is extremely rare and valuable.
npc.topic.belagan.9: I don't mind the work, since I do get to spend some time with Adriana, and I don't have to pay for my room.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.1: I am a holy "paladin" who watches over the land.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.10: One of his disciples, "Mordenthal", is a dark knight who resides in northern Stoneheim. He is extremely deceitful and must not be trusted.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.11: He is a dark knight and was once foremost amongst the great generals in Ogrimar's army. Even as we speak, he is recruiting followers of the dark path to further his master's "cause".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.12: The god Ogrimar seeks the demise of the Dark One. It is also our main concern, as followers of Artherk. %s, I'll make this short for both you and I. You have been granted the title of Champion of Light back in Raven's Dust. It is now time to "fulfill" your destiny and prove that you are indeed worthy of this honor.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.13: The first step toward the fulfillment of your destiny is to become a "Lightbringer" of Artherk.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.14: Lightbringer, it is time for you to learn about the "task" that has to be done.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.2: I follow the path of Light set for me by my god, "Artherk".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.3: Since the past few thousand years, there has been one who's evil power has grown steadily. Since a balance has to be kept, what is gained must be lost somewhere. So great his power has become that he poses a serious "threat" to everybody, even to Artherk himself.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.4: If you would assist me, I could use some "Rings" "of" "the" "Lion". King Aedenas Gravesoul, ruler of the Centaurs, should have some, but you might need to give him something in return.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.5: The "Dark" "One" has to be destroyed no matter what, as he will stop at nothing to gain whatever power he can have.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.6: The one I am referring to is none other than "Makrsh" "P'Tangh", the elven lich.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.7: The elven Lich's power has grown steadily over the past few thousand years. His strength is so great that it rivals that of the gods themselves. Fortunately, Artherk is not the sole god to be affected by the "uprise" of Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.8: The uprise of the Dark One has also left the foul "Ogrimar", god of the night, partially drained of his powers as well.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.9: The god of the night, Ogrimar, represents terror and chaos but he is also an unlikely ally in the war versus to Makrsh P'Tangh. In fact, some of his "disciples" are gathering followers to launch an assault against the lich itself.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.0: I have no time for this.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.1: Yes, I am the Bishop Crowbanner.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.2: I am the Bishop Crowbanner! If you truly have to say something to me, do it properly by using my holy title.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.3: It is said that a demon on Arakas has been cursing a great number of heroes.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.4: My name is Crowbanner. My first name is of no concern to you.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.5: I am the kingdom's bishop, the highest ranking religious man here.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.6: Hmm, I would rather be resting, but I suppose I could teach you some spells.
npc.topic.bishopcrowbanner.7: If only all would be as sweet as her.
npc.topic.boreas.10: Raven's Dust's sister island located somewhere to the north.
npc.topic.boreas.13: I hope I'll see you again!
npc.topic.boreas.2: My trade is in the brewing of potions of which I am very skilled. If you travel alot, then you had better "buy" something to keep you alive in case of danger. I also have a few "scrolls" in which you might be interested as well.
npc.topic.boreas.3: Yes.. I have plenty of scrolls that you could use. Especially if you need a fast way of going back and forth between "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.boreas.4: I have several different kinds of potions, all of which are for "sale".
npc.topic.boreas.6: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.boreas.7: Business isn't what it used to be, so if anyone strange had entered my store, I would've seen him right away.
npc.topic.boreas.8: Eh, that's the name of this island.
npc.topic.boreas.9: Yes, this town is named Silversky.
npc.topic.brother1.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother1.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother1.3: My brothers and I have a tale to tell... But you must know who to ask, and when. Let me know if you need "help".
npc.topic.brother1.4: The sixth told you who was first.
npc.topic.brother1.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.

npc.topic.brother10.4: My work is beyond your understanding.
npc.topic.brother10.5: I speak after the foul one.
npc.topic.brother10.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother11.0: They block the way to the "Lower" "Dungeon" where lies the herb...
npc.topic.brother11.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother11.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother11.4: You understand little about death, do you?
npc.topic.brother11.5: The last one speaks after me.
npc.topic.brother11.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother12.0: Only worthy adventurers may solve this puzzle. When you have the six Royal Keys, come and tell me "I" "have" "the" "six" "keys".
npc.topic.brother12.1: Well, then, since you've got all six keys, I can send you to the Cave of Fear, which lies deep within the earth, and you can look for the cuthana herb there. Are you ready?
npc.topic.brother12.10: Indeed, we fought each other, but even after our passing, I cannot hold a grudge against them. It was our father's crime that caused our death, not anyone else's. Still, I should have become king, not Theodore...
npc.topic.brother12.11: A shame that our weakest and laziest brother now rules this kingdom. Had I acceeded to the throne, Goldmoon would now rule over Stoneheim as well as Goldmoon. But one must accept's one fate, I guess.
npc.topic.brother12.12: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother12.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother12.3: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother12.4: I was named Gran Theo, eldest and mightiest of Theopold's sons.
npc.topic.brother12.5: Loathsome I may be, but you go nowhere before me.
npc.topic.brother12.6: Mock me not! My mass was a great asset as a fighter! Few could resist my unrelenting onslaughts!
npc.topic.brother12.7: These keys can be found all over Raven's Dust, and will help you unlock the dungeon where you will find the cuthana herb. Return to me when you have them all.
npc.topic.brother12.8: I will help you, for you are a good person at heart, and even in death I have some life force to give.
npc.topic.brother12.9: I am the guardian of my brothers, no less, even in death and after they tried to kill me, back then.
npc.topic.brother2.0: Our brother betrayed us, made a mockery of the "Tournament" "of" "Princes".
npc.topic.brother2.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother2.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother2.5: I do very little except stumble around.
npc.topic.brother2.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother3.0: So it was ordained by our father's testament, a battle to the death to choose the "King of Goldmoon".
npc.topic.brother3.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother3.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother3.3: Why even ask? I am dead.
npc.topic.brother3.4: I do not work, I moan...
npc.topic.brother3.5: I do not speak after the fourth.
npc.topic.brother3.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother4.0: We died fighting each other. I killed my brothers, they killed me. All save "Theodore".

npc.topic.brother4.4: I do not work, I moan...
npc.topic.brother4.5: The corpse tells you what you need before the one who speaks before me.
npc.topic.brother4.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother5.0: Oh, the mockery! The sham! He lay sleeping in his chambers, only to wake after our "deaths".
npc.topic.brother5.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother5.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother5.3: That is none of your concern.
npc.topic.brother5.5: The order of speech of the putrid one is twice my own.
npc.topic.brother5.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother6.0: A dark comedy, it was. Theodore, the sole survivor, inherited the title! And now, the realm is "poisoned" by his inactivity.
npc.topic.brother6.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother6.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother6.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother7.0: We remain here, "cursed" and tormented, till the day he comes to join us.
npc.topic.brother7.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother7.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother7.4: The dead but wail their sorrows...
npc.topic.brother7.5: I talk after the pitiful one.
npc.topic.brother7.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother8.0: We suffer, and not even the "cuthana" herb can help us.
npc.topic.brother8.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother8.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother8.3: I was once a student of the faith.
npc.topic.brother8.4: I pray for all, though none prays for us...
npc.topic.brother8.5: I talk between foul and entity.
npc.topic.brother8.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brother9.0: Yes, this herb can "heal" even the grievest wound, but not pain from the soul.
npc.topic.brother9.1: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother9.2: You are asking the wrong corpse. You must start all over again.
npc.topic.brother9.5: The fiend speaks after the one who speaks after me.
npc.topic.brother9.6: Such foul language can only mean you have life force to spare.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.0: I am called Brother Harforr, a priest of "Artherk".
npc.topic.brotherharforr.1: Don't you know about Artherk? The god Artherk? I have worshipped him for many years now.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.2: I am a priest of "Artherk". I consider myself very lucky to be part of those who devote their lives to helping others in the name of our god. What about you, stranger? Perhaps I could help you by "healing" your wounds or by setting your "sanctuary" place into our beautiful temple, right here in Windhowl.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.3: Pray for Artherk, my friend, for you have been cursed by the foul Balork. Whenever he is defeated, he brands yet another victim, hoping to own his or her soul in the abyss. He then returns from his demonic plane to plague us again with his malevolent presence.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.4: Young, lovely Annabelle, how we miss her! She could heal the sick and comfort the downtrodden. She would hear your plight and help you, no doubt. If she were still alive, that is.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.5: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.6: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.7: The Sanctuary is where your body and soul are restored by the Gem of Destiny if you have been killed. Do you wish to set the Temple of Windhowl as your sanctuary?
npc.topic.brotherharforr.8: May Artherk protect you in your travels.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.0: Father Gunthar is the High Priest of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.1: I am called Brother Kiran. I have followed the path of "Artherk" for many years now.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.2: I am a priest of "Artherk". I pray for all those who need help and healing. I must ask, however, that you donate some gold pieces in exchange for this service.  You must understand that our church is rather poor and we can put these donations to good use.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.3: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.4: Young, lovely Annabelle, how we miss her! She could heal the sick and comfort the downtrodden. She would hear your plight and help you, no doubt. If she were still alive, that is.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.5: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.6: Balork was once a man of good but it seems he was corrupted by an evil force. An adventurer who barely escaped with his life claimed that Balork is no longer human. Surely the poor adventurer has gone insane.
npc.topic.brotherkiran.7: The dungeon under the temple has fallen into the hands of "Balork".
npc.topic.brotherkiran.8: Artherk is the god I will worship all my life. His followers have the task of helping anyone they can and aid those in need. In times of war, unlike some priests, we do not cower in our temples.  We go to the front lines of battle and heal the valiant warriors, sometimes at the cost of our own lives. Such is the faith and devotion of our members.
npc.topic.brotherniuss.0: I am Brother Niuss. I am a priest of Artherk's church.
npc.topic.brotherniuss.1: I am a priest of Artherk. How lucky I am to be in such a great organization that is dedicated to helping others. How about you, stranger, do you have any wounds that need to be "healed"?
npc.topic.brotherniuss.2: I see you bear the "Balork"'s "brand" upon your brow my friend.
npc.topic.brotherniuss.3: I heard that she has elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.brotherniuss.4: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.brotherniuss.5: Artherk will protect you as much as he will be able to.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.0: I am Brother Thorkas. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.1: I spread seeds of rightenousness for each sin caused by humans. My life is devoted to the study of the various prophecies and of the upcoming "4th" "coming" event. I also try to ease pain and "suffering" whenever I am given the opportunity. In addition, I have some "spells" I would be willing to share with you. Blessed be Artherk, he has also given me the Gift of "sanctuary" and the ability to create "holy" "water".
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.10: Why do we suffer? That is not ours to know the reason why. Fortunately, I have the power to "heal" your wounds. Once, I tried to heal a poor warrior but alas failed. Yet, this was not in vain for it soothed the pain. Why am I telling you this? Simply to make you understand that failures are not always what they seem. Sometimes, they must be to teach you who you really are.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.11: Making stony pathways smoother by a gentle word or deed is all what you need to follow the path of worthiness.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.12: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.13: You have found one of our precious golden chalices? Do you wish to give it back to us?
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.14: Do not speak hastily for your anger darkens what you say.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.15: You are always welcome in our humble temple.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.16: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.17: The Sanctuary is where your body and soul are restored by the Gem of Destiny if you have been killed. Do you wish to set the Temple of Raven's Dust as your sanctuary?
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.18: Very well, I will share my knowledge with you.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.2: If you are in need of holy water, a cleric of Artherk such as I can perform a prayer to bless a "flask" "of" "crystal" "water". However, a small donation of 1000 gold to our humble temple is required for this service. Do you have the required donation and a flask of crystal water?
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.3: Surely a seasoned adventurer such as you can easily find a flask of crystal water somewhere.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.4: The prophecies are rather nebulous regarding that particular event. The Key, according to what is written, lies in the previous "events".
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.5: I do not have enough information about the previous events. Perhaps the elves or the dwarves might know something... if they still exist on this plane.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.6: Monsignore Damien was once a great member of our order, but he fell from grace for reasons that I'm not aware of. All I know is that he blamed a certain "Shadeen" for framing him. He lives in seclusion, now, and it would probably be wise to avoid mentioning her name in front of him.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.7: A magic ring you say? Let me see... ACK! This ring is EVIL! I will have nothing to do with it! You had best take it back to wherever you found it or whoever told you to come here.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.8: She is a well-known criminal on Raven's Dust. I do not mingle with such evil people.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.9: Artherk is the god of healing and mending. It is He who we praise in this small temple. Unfortunately, we have been the target of thieves recently. Sadly, they have been able to steal numerous of our precious golden "chalices".
npc.topic.captainharockharr.0: I am Harock Harr, the greatest Sailor of all time! Har! I have "stories", I tell you, that you would never believe, but they're as true as I am here! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.1: What kind of question is this? Har! I have "sailed" many seas and fought beasts as big as the entire village. I am a captain.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.10: Hardy har har! To this day, no fight like that had even been fought before. Dozens of sharks, fifty meters long, sometimes more, attacked me! My hands were even tied behind my back, for I had just been thrown out into the sea by pirates. I had to fight each and every one of those sharks with my teeth. Har! Blood was spilled I can tell ya! Har! har! I nearly lost an arm, but with my extraordinary fighting skills, I vanquished those overgrown sharks and swam back ashore with only one leg left and my hands still tied up! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.2: Har! By my grandfather's rotting wooden leg! Balork's curse is just a fairy tale, methinks. I have fought beasts that are much stronger than that weakling. Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.3: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.4: I have sailed across all the seas and oceans, and I even went to the end of the world! Har! But to this day, I have never been able to find a flying ship to go farther.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.5: Hardy Har har! Be forewarned, for that these stories be real, says I! Which one do you wish to hear, eh? The story of the giant "squid" or when I battled a giant "whale"? Or maybe the time I caught a twelve meter long "trout"! Har! Har! Maybe I ought to tell you about when I "drank" the whole ocean to help one of my crew members from drowning! Hardy Har har! Or my personal favorite story: when I dove in water full of twenty meter, har!, make it forty meter long "sharks", to reach an undersea treasure!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.6: The sea was angry on that day, I'm tellin' ya! The waves were high and the wind was blowing so hard that giant whales were flying by. Har! But I had a map to the secret location of a squid that had gold in its belly! Har! It took great courage and leadership to brave such a dreadful day. The squid finally decided to come out of its hideout to attack our great ship. I took my favorite harpoon and without thinking about my own life, I charged at the squid. Har! Oh, but you seem in a hurry... Do ya want to know the rest of the story? Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.7: Har! This be the story of my life! Har! I was hunting for a great white whale that had twice before foiled me in combat. I survived, but not before the giant beast had taken one of my legs along with it. Revenge was the only thing I could think of for many years after that. Har! Well... actually, it is quite a long story, but suffice it to say, I vanquished this great, twenty-meter long raging white whale in a fight that shook the whole sea!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.8: Har! You don't believe me? I was fishing one day aboard my great vessel and some giant beast grabbed my hook. For thirty days and nights I tried relentlessly to get it out of the water, leading to the greatest battle of all time between man and beast! Har! Har! And finally, I succeeded in taking this giant thirteen-meter trout out of the sea by making it believe the air was better than the water! Ya know what? The beast actually believed me! Har! Har! I really AM a genius! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.9: Har! This be a great story, my friend. One day, while me and my crew had just vanquished a bunch of pirates, one of my crewmembers was drunk from the festivities of our great victory and tripped on the bridge, falling into the deep, dark sea. Har! har! As a good captain, I had the obligation of saving the lad. Without consideration for my personal safety, I jumped in the sea, and in one big gulp, I drank it all up! Har har! The crewman then boarded my ship, and I spat out the entire ocean. We then sailed safely back home and were in time for dinner. Hardy har har! What a story eh?
npc.topic.captainironleg.0: I am the great Captain Ironleg. In my youth, I have fought pirates and thieves with my unbreakable "cutlass". I tell ya, nothing could have stopped me then.
npc.topic.captainironleg.1: I am too old to sail for adventures nowadays. Instead, I teach the apprentice sailors about the ways of sailing. I am proud to say that I was the teacher of Corsair Leodwald, my best student ever.
npc.topic.captainironleg.2: Corsair Leowald is a very talented young sailor who shall go far on the sea.
npc.topic.captainironleg.3: You want to see my iron leg? It's a great piece indeed. Oh, I know, it's a bit rusty but it is still strong enough to support most of my weight. I looted it from the corpse of a pirate I slew with my "cutlass".
npc.topic.captainironleg.4: Like I said lad, this cutlass saved my life numerous times. Aye, I even fought sharks with it.
npc.topic.captainironleg.5: Harr... I'm not the har-har type ya know laddie!
npc.topic.captainironleg.6: I heard you can drown in a desert too. Ha!
npc.topic.captainironleg.7: The sea is always hungry. She can eat "ships" and their crew all day long.
npc.topic.captainironleg.8: Ah lad! I see you're interested in boats. Sadly, King Theodore does not think it's that important to keep the vessels in good condition.
npc.topic.captainironleg.9: If I'd be younger, I would make you walk the plank into the sea!
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.0: Hi! What can I do for you?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.1: Indeed, Celestina Waterbreeze is my name.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.10: Bane Blackblood is a mad man. I have heard rumors that he even has spies lurking from inside the castle of "King" "Theodore".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.11: I do not care about King Theodore because he doesn't care for us either.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.12: The Order of Nature is dedicated to the well-being of nature.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.13: Yrian Earthsong is an elder druid who founded the "Order" "of" "Nature".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.14: I do not think it was a good idea to create the Stone of Life for its powers could be used for evil.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.15: Dunikus Hornwind is also a druid and he lives in northern Arakas with his mentor, "Yrian" "Earthsong". Like my brother, I teach what "knowledge" I can pass on to anyone I meet.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.16: You've found two flasks of crystal water for my dying tree? You have done well, %s. Do you agree to give these to me?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.17: Well, if you are interested, I can teach you how to cast certain "spells".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.18: I will teach you what I can.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.19: The desert is a desolated landscape where rare are those who can survive.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.2: I am Celestina Waterbreeze, sister of "Dunikus" "Hornwind".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.20: Ravenwood is a dark forest where "Bane" "Blackblood"'s "nightblades" are scattered. You may also encounter dangerous "demon" "trees" who possess incredible magical powers.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.23: Be careful! We cannot assure your protection out of our sanctuary.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.3: I do everything that has to be done. Since we are a small community, we have to stick together and share the chores if we want to survive. Currently, I am trying to save this little "tree". As a druid, I feel that it is my duty to protect nature no matter what.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.4: Oh, yes, now I remember, you mean the key I got after trading with Tobias! I'd completely forgotten about it! Well, is this what you've come to get from me?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.5: This herb is extremely hard to find. You can only find it in the Cave of Fear, where lies the corpse of King Theopold.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.6: Key? I'm not sure what you're talking about...
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.7: The demon trees are the exact opposite of the "Forest" "Guardians".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.8: The Forest Guardians are working with us to protect nature from being harmed.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.9: The Nightblades are the elite assassins of "Bane" "Blackblood".
npc.topic.celydia.0: I am Celydia, a faithful "servant" of our good king.
npc.topic.celydia.1: Tell me if there is anything I can do for you.
npc.topic.celydia.2: I am at his majesty's service. As one of his servants, I must do my best to provide him with whatever he wishes for.
npc.topic.celydia.3: Oh, wait, now that I think about it, I remember seeing one such key on the king's desk a few years ago. It was very, very ornate, and caught my attention. I remember it well because a few days later, the king was furious at the loss of a precious family heirloom... I never saw the key after that. I think the king mentioned that a thief calling himself  "Reynen" "Aspicdart" had signed his burglary.
npc.topic.celydia.4: I don't know where that rogue is hiding now. You'll have to ask around town, maybe someone's seen him lately.
npc.topic.celydia.5: I really must get on with my duties... unless there is something more you want to ask me.
npc.topic.celydia.6: He is good, but also very demanding. It is a good thing I am not his only aid, because I don't think I could ever keep up.
npc.topic.celydia.7: I'm afraid I can't very well keep an eye on everyone that enters the castle.
npc.topic.celydia.8: Farewell, and don't get lost inside the castle.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.0: I am Chamberlain Thomar. I manage the daily affairs of this castle. Not a thing happens here that I do not know about. How may I help you?
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.1: I work here as chamberlain of the castle. I attend all domestic matters within the castle. One could say I am the eyes and ears of these walls. I am also the one you must ask if you wish an "audience" with our good king.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.10: You must be a "Champion" "of" "Light" else I will not help you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.11: Champions of Light are individuals who have sworn to uphold the good cause. Only a select few are worthy of this title, and I am one of those who can bestow it upon you. In order to become such a person, you must "swear" "fealty" by taking an "Oath" "of" "Worthiness".
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.12: You've already taken the oath of worthiness, %s.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.13: You do not need my approval, you can already have an audience with our king.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.14: You have already completed the quest I had set for you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.16: Be well. May Artherk protect you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.2: The poor princess is most distraught, lately. You see, her mentor, Bishop Rikken Crowbanner, has fallen deathly ill, and she has become very quiet and depressed as a result. Perhaps I could help you?
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.3: You can find that herb somewhere in a deep, deep dungeon, I hear. The trick is finding someone who'll tell you which one, when to go, etc. Sadly, I cannot help you with that.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.4: A very holy man, he is. All priests and priestesses under his tutelage demonstrate the utmost loyalty to him and his ideals. That is a rare thing, nowadays.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.5: An interesting tale you spin. It means little to me, however.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.6: Monsignore Damien is a most evil man, I'm told. Someone once told me he was still alive, hiding in some hold and biding his time until he could exact his revenge. I'm a little unclear as to the details, I'm afraid.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.8: This is terrible! Bishop Crowbanner is ill again! This MUST stop!
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.9: There are so few noble people, nowadays...
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.1: Werk? Me no werk like liddle hummie, me barsh skulls guud.
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.2: Me gonna do guud hummie stew wit yew flesh!
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.3: Guud. Me bash skull if hummie stey longger.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.1: Me werk is tew barsh meen skraugs frum odder tribe and smash hummie skulls wen dey try tew hert us.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.2: Yaghwuhl go far tru forest an giv da skullz tew da hummie inside gate.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.3: No wun ebber sey dat tew Yaghwuhl! Me gonna SMASH yer skull!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.0: Oy's calld Wuuthgoran, da king of us KAHP LETH!!!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.1: Wuuthgoran da biggess, da strongess, da smathess  skraugz of dem oll!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.3: Me nutt gonna miss yew. Hummie week.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.0: I am known as Chryseida Yolangda, the wandering "gypsy".
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.1: I wander around the world in "search" of kindred spirits. I can also "foretell" your future, but only once an hour.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.10: Raven's Dust is an island located south of "Arakas". I am sure that you've already visited it.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.11: There are six collectors on Stoneheim: Headhunter Wajpoothin, Khan Wulgworth, Grant Hornkeep, King Aedenas Gravesoul, Beltigan Whitesword and Mordenthal. If you ask them nicely, perhaps they'll send you on a quest to help them with their collections.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.12: Arakas is located somewhere to the north of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.13: Have you ever heard such a thing as a gypsy curse?
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.15: I fear I see... nothing. Perhaps I can try again, if you *really* need a "hint"?
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.16: You need %u more levels and %u more intelligence to learn search.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.17: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.2: This title bears a lot of incomfort to the townspeople but I can assure you that I am no thief nor a charlatan.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.3: Let me look into it... I see nothing!
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.4: I might have a few items of interest to you. Feel free to browse through them.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.5: I can't help you find him, but I'm sure you don't need me to tell you where he is. Simply follow your heart and you should be able to find him.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.6: Let's see what you have to sell then.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.7: Well, wandering the country like this, I have developed an uncanny ability to discover what is "hidden", be it objects left by thieves, or animals trying to hide themselves from me. If you wish, I could "teach" you this ability, for a price.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.8: Yes, there is one that I know who has a knack for hiding things. We used to play hide and go seek when we were but little children, although he would never tell you that. It has been a long time since I have heard from him though, and I doubt he would remember me. His name was Meltar. If you ever see him, ask him to teach you how to hide.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.9: Althea is the name of the world in which we live in.
npc.topic.colosseumowner.1: What can I do for you?
npc.topic.colosseumowner.2: I am the owner of two magnificent establishments. One is called the famed "colosseum" while the other one is called the "battleground".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.3: In the colosseum, fighters of all rank and caliber come to "test" their abilities against powerful creatures. However, if you don't feel like fighting, it is possible to become a "spectator".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.4: Unlike the "colosseum", the battleground does not allow creatures. It is a dreadful place where there are *NO* rules. No matter what rank you are, if you "fight" in the battleground, you can be slain by *ANY* other gladiators. However, if you don't feel like fighting, it is possible to become a "spectator".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.5: So, you want to become a spectator?
npc.topic.corsairmagere.0: I am Leodwald but I ask of my men to call me Corsair Leodwald.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.10: I am not of the har-har generation. Oh, I almost forgot... I hate parrots!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.11: Ah, now *there's* a lovely lass! All curves and spunk, just like I like 'em wenches! I hear she's the reason why that moron Monsignore Damien fell from grace in the church. She told me all about how she framed him, and that was pretty shrewd, let me tell you. If you ever meet that idiot Damien, you just ask him about "Shadeen".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.12: Captain Ironleg taught me everything I know. He does not deserve all the credits however. I have trained myself day and night to become the man I am. I am proud today to say that my swordsman skills are unmatched in all "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.13: Raven's Dust has many dangerous reefs surrounding it. Our boats often get damaged by them. Some of our crewmen are not very much experienced.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.14: I usually carry a cutlass and a small dagger. You never know what could happen in these troubled times.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.15: You're unworthy to speak to me. Out of my sight at once!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.16: Fine! I have work to do.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.2: Not Leowald you hammerhead! It's Corsair Leodwald!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.3: We do not encounter many pirates these days. Mainly because our fleet is not "suitable" to sail right now.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.4: As I have said, I am Corsair Leodwald and my duty is to lead the royal fleet of our *ugh* "Majesty".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.5: Aye, "King" "Theodore" does not want to invest gold pieces for the restoration of our old vessels.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.6: King Theodore is unworthy of the royal throne but I will serve him no matter the circumstances.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.7: The kingdom of Goldmoon is ruled so-to-speak by "King" "Theodore".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.8: Count on Harock Harr for exagerating everything.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.0: The letter was a necessary precaution. You see, I could not contact you directly because of all the parties involved. You probably have hundreds of questions and we will come around to them in time. For now though, let us start from the "beginning".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.1: You are what we call a New Breed, a child born with the pain of his predecessors. The Nameless Bard was one such child... he too, was "chosen".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.10: This is a vial of my blood... when you are ready, consume it and you will feel something change inside of you. Also, this Armlet of Flames will come in handy I am certain. This is just my way of helping you face the trials ahead.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.12: I watch over the lesser races. No matter what happens, balance must always be preserved.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.2: In our Dharma, it is said that in the wake of a lost god, his children will awake and will demand to be avenged. When Lothar the Just died, "Justice" "died" along with him.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.3: We have stayed silent since the beginning of time, removed from the influence of the gods. But there was a day when even dragons could not remain idle... a day when the "winds" threatened the very existence of Althea.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.4: The screams of the dying were so many that they woke us from our slumber. This is when we decided to intervene, to take action against the evil that was unraveling the threads of our existence. That day was called the "Battle" "of" "Emanations".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.5: Ironically, the ranks of the enemy were mostly made up of the ancient races that the corrupted one called Makrsh P'Tangh had ammased in his own army. He wanted to bring back the same god who had caused the downfall of his own kind. When we destroyed his Harvesters of Life, he withdrew from the battlefield and escaped with "Olin" "Haad".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.6: Olin Haad was one of us when we attacked the Harvesters of Life. He was doing so well that I decided to give him the responsibility of keeping the Skull of Gluriurl. For some reason I cannot explain, he was "fascinated" with the Skull.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.7: He began to develop powers that are very akin to that of gods. He started to become arrogant, and even hostile when things did not go the way he wished them to. Eventually, we decided not to include him in our council meetings... shortly after that, he "changed" "sides".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.8: When we destroyed the Harvesters of Life, we vowed never to kill another of our kind. Olin Haad is a dragon after all, and as much as it pains my heart to say it, we must "prevent" him from summoning Gluriurl. That's why I implore you to help us.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.9: Without further delay, you must travel to the "Great" "Library" of Althea. You must search within its walls to find the true reason behind Olin Haad's raid on Lighthaven. Once you find it, you must confront him with it. Now, I have "something" to give you that will help you on the rest of your journey.
npc.topic.custodian.0: This library is exclusively for scholars. It's because of "uneducated" people like you that books don't last forever. I will not tolerate your presence any longer.
npc.topic.custodian.1: Alright, so you think you're smart huh? Let's see if you can pass the "Rite" "of" "Passage" then.
npc.topic.custodian.2: Don't just repeat what I said back at me! I want you to tell me what all this means! These four phrases are the key to passing the Rite of Passage. Tell me what it means or you can forget about ever seeing the upper floor of the library.
npc.topic.dafyd.0: Greetings, I gladly welcome your company in this desolate place.
npc.topic.dafyd.10: I do not like towns all that much, to tell you the truth. I would rather be outside in the wilderness with all the wild beasts than the "simple-minded" people of that city.
npc.topic.dafyd.11: They are so caught up with their petty disputes that they don't even notice the "enemy" is advancing upon them even as we speak.
npc.topic.dafyd.12: Why, the orcs of course! Have you been living in a dungeon all your life? ...Oh dear, please forgive my loss of temper. I tend to become rather hostile when I start to think of the "happenings" of this isle.
npc.topic.dafyd.13: The orcs move ever closer and all the king thinks of doing is sleeping. The people of that town are no better, mind you. All they do is quarrel amongst themselves about whether the king is fit to rule or not. It is a sad thing, I tell you.
npc.topic.dafyd.14: Their numbers are ever increasing, and there is not much anyone can do about it. I imagine they will someday overtake the town, and I pray for a swift death for any who will still be there when it happens.
npc.topic.dafyd.15: I will not tolerate such language from anyone. You should leave now.
npc.topic.dafyd.16: Good luck in your travels, friend.
npc.topic.dafyd.3: I come from a land far from here in search of new and interesting objects to add to my "collection".
npc.topic.dafyd.4: Well, so far I have accumulated a great deal of "weapons" and "armor" of a rather high quality. Unfortunately, I cannot carry everything I own, so I am restrained to bringing only a few weapons.
npc.topic.dafyd.5: As I said before, it is quite impossible for me to carry all of my armor collection without the use of a charriot or wagon of some kind.
npc.topic.dafyd.6: The weapons in my collection are among the very finest you will ever see around these parts.
npc.topic.dafyd.7: What? You wish to buy one of them? Hmm, I don't know about that. I suppose there is no harm in it, I can always find another one. Well, do you want to take a look at what I have?
npc.topic.dafyd.8: Let me take a look at what you have for sale...
npc.topic.dafyd.9: Raven's Dust is the island you are on, friend.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.0: I am Dantalir Songweaver, at your service.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.1: Guilty as charged. I am a bard and a talented one, I might add. I can play almost any musical instruments you can find around.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.10: Grant Hornkeep is an incompetent fool.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.12: I shall see you again later, %s.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.13: You need %u more levels and %u more agility to learn sneak.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.14: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.2: Unfortunately, I've never had the pleasure of having a drum of fate. I heard that there is only one person on Raven's Dust that can craft them.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.3: I got some finely crafted drums from a merchant a long time ago for a very fine price indeed. However, I'm sorry to say that I have absolutely no clue where I've stored them. They should be somewhere around here...
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.4: That is not of your business, pal!
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.6: Once a person is hidden, they can "sneak" behind you and follow you without you ever knowing they were there.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.7: Heh heh, so you want to become a master of the art of silent footsteps, do you? I suppose I could "teach" you since I am in a good mood.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.8: The thieves' hideout is a secret. You must not reveal its location to anyone lest you want us to cut off your tongue.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.9: You see the tall man with the sword over there? That's him.
npc.topic.daranannithae.0: I don't say hello for free nowadays.
npc.topic.daranannithae.1: Yes, that is my name. Lightfoot refers to my fleeing talents.
npc.topic.daranannithae.10: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.daranannithae.12: That's the name of this island.
npc.topic.daranannithae.13: Stonecrest is the name of the town you're in.
npc.topic.daranannithae.16: No, no, don't misunderstand, I'm not her! I only LOOK like her! I'm actually Daran Lightfoot. Um... It'd be a little hard to explain, so let's just pretend this isn't happening, okay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.17: WILL YOU LOOK AT ME?!? It's me, Daran! I know, I look like Annithae, don't remind me! Look, you gotta help me get outta this, 'kay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.18: Look, pal, I really need your "help".
npc.topic.daranannithae.19: Yeah, I look like Annithae, let's not dwell on this, 'kay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.2: The name is Daran Lightfoot, at your service. Hey, you wouldn't know someone who has some "assassin's" "blades", would you? Uhh, guess not. I tell you what... if you ever get your hands on some of these blades, I'd be interested in making a little trade with ya.
npc.topic.daranannithae.3: Mayor Fairweather is the rich bas... man living down the street in a large house he built using the Stonecrest taxes.
npc.topic.daranannithae.4: The Stonecrest sheriff, Grant Hornkeep, can usually be found patrolling the town's entrance.
npc.topic.daranannithae.5: Guild? What guild are you talking about?
npc.topic.daranannithae.6: You seem like a reasonable person. I think I can tell a little "secret", just between you and me.
npc.topic.daranannithae.7: You civilized people usually refer to this as "robbing" but I personally prefer long-term borrowing. If they don't notice that you've borrowed something, it probably means they don't need it in the first place. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.daranannithae.8: Shhh! Keep it down, damnit! You don't want that fool "Hornkeep" to catch m.. us. If you want to "learn" from the master himself, you need only to ask and I'll help you... for a fee, of course.
npc.topic.daranannithae.9: You're not good enough at peeking! If you don't know how to "peek", how can you expect to rob people? Never mind, you're obviously not worth the effort.

npc.topic.daranatrocity.12: That's the name of this island.
npc.topic.daranatrocity.13: Stonecrest is the name of the town you're in.
npc.topic.daranatrocity.16: Yeah, it's kind of because of her this all started. Oh, don't blame her, she's got nothing to do with this, it's my own fault. But it should be all right soon... I hope. Meanwhile, let's pretend this isn't happening, 'kay?
npc.topic.daranatrocity.17: THIS IS A CATASTROPHE! It keeps going downhill! First I was in Annithae's body, now I'm a friggin' ATROCITY! Look, will you help me one more time?
npc.topic.daranatrocity.18: Look, it's not the right time to talk about the components. Just "help" me, willya!

npc.topic.daranlightfoot.15: Annithae is the nicest woman I've ever met. She lives alone in a small house near the fountain. Someday, I swear I'll steal her heart with my charm and my good looks
npc.topic.daranlightfoot.17: Annithae is the nicest woman I've ever met. She lives alone in a small house near the fountain. Someday, I swear I'll steal her heart with my charm and my good looks
