npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.0: Hello! What can I do for you?
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.1: I am known amongst our "order" as Darius Moonglow.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.10: The nightblades sometimes attempt to enter in our sanctuary but the Forest Guardians are able to keep them at bay.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.11: You look like someone who could help me. I need four rare colored gems. I need a red, a green, a yellow and a blue gem. Retrieve them and bring them to me and you shall be rewarded.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.12: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.13: Apples are not as common as in our sister island. That is why we have to sell them at such an expensive price.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.14: Yrian Earthsong is the elder and leader of the druidic "Order" "of" "Nature" located in northern Arakas.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.15: I'm sure you could find a long piece of wood covered with squirrel's oil somewhere that could suit your needs.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.16: It was nice talking to you.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.2: I have many chores to do, we all do if we want to survive as a community. I am currently busy searching for some "gems"...
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.3: The Nature's garb is our ceremonial robes.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.4: The sole purpose of the Order of Nature is to protect the nature around us lest we want it to be destroyed and seal our fate as well.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.5: Our druidic order's name is the "Order" "of" "Nature".
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.6: He is insane and must be stopped.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.7: They are nearly as old as Althea itself and they have great powers.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.8: In case you weren't aware already, this is the name of the world.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.9: I don't know much about that. If it's some kind of herb, you should ask Celestina Waterbreeze.
npc.topic.darkfang.0: Je suis DarkFang. Que puis-je faire pour vous ?
npc.topic.darkfang.1: Je m'occupe de mes affaires et je connais bien les environs.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.0: Be careful, this forest is filled with vile "creatures".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.1: The name's Delvar Irongrip, the strongest warrior on this island, with the possible exception of "Murmuntag". I am a "survivor", I cannot be beaten even in this hostile forest.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.10: The Druids are sworn to protect nature no matter what.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.11: Help? Perhaps I could part with one of my healing "potions".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.12: I've already helped you, remember? I gave you a potion. Now, if you are not able to dwell in the forest by yourself, you should return to "Lighthaven".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.13: The key to survive is to keep yourself healthy. You can bring "potions" or learn techniques to "heal" yourself.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.14: I can treat your minor wounds. I am sorry but I cannot teach you how to mend yourself because I don't have the time. Someday, you'll find somebody who'll be able to.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.15: Artherk? If he is the God his worshippers claim he is, why does he hide in the celestial realm while we need him right here? It is not him who prevents the "goblins" from gaining dominion over the island, it is my sword and I.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.16: If only I could find where he is hiding...
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.17: There are many caverns on this island. Keep an eye for "Jarko"'s caverns because they are filled with undeads and "goblins".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.18: The kingdom of Goldmoon is currently ruled by King Theodore the XIIIth. It encompasses the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.19: Raven's Dust is a small island located southwest of this island. It can only be reached by ship. The castle of King "Theodore" and the town of "Silversky" are also located on that island.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.2: Indeed, hideous creatures such as "goblins" roam in the forest. You might even see "brigands" cowardly hidden in the shadows, waiting for the opportunity to strike a lethal blow in your back and steal your gold.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.20: King Theodore is not worthy of being our king. He doesn't do anything for his kingdom, nor does he seem to care.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.21: I have never gone to Silversky myself, I could not tell you what it's like.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.22: Arakas is the name of this island.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.23: Windhowl is on this island, southwest from here.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.24: I was born and raised in this small town. On the opposite side of the island stands its sister town, "Windhowl".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.25: I could easily break you in half if I wanted to, little one.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.26: It is time to depart, my friend.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.3: I am a mercenary and I have been employed by a few inhabitants of "Lighthaven" to purify this forest of "brigands" and "goblins".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.4: Some people call it a glum sword, but it's actually a Gloomblade, and it's not very easy to find. I guess you'd have to ask someone who knows more about making swords than I do. I just use them.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.5: Aye, I knew her well, that Annabelle. Lovelier than an Elf -- not that I know what Elves look like, they left this world a long, long time ago. But aye, you'd love to meet her...
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.6: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.7: He is skilled, but he is also an orc. I do not have hatred toward his race despite their dark origins, I simply do not trust him.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.8: I have heard that you have been doing business with them. I must warn you my friend, you are walking a dangerous path.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.9: I always slay a few after breakfast, it helps my digestion.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.0: I am Derran Ironstrife, warrior dedicated to the protection of our "Majesty".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.1: Yes, I am Derran Ironstrife. I already told you that didn't I? You could have asked me simply by asking me my "name".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.10: It's the island you are currently standing on. We're locating south of Arakas if you did not know already.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.11: How dare you to speak to me like that? I could slice you in two in a swift movement of my arm.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.12: Until we meet again my friend.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.2: King Theopold was King Theodore XIIIth's honorable father.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.4: I am a warrior fighting for the good cause of our King. I also help "train" those who are willing to fight the orc menace. Sometimes, we attack the orcs to prevent their siege weapons from approaching within range of the castle's walls. Sadly, we aren't able to eradicate them once and for all. I heard they often hide in the surrounding "caverns".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.6: I hate those orcs. Their leader, Ghundarg, almost killed me the other day. He cowardly attacked me from behind. Someday, I'll get my revenge...
npc.topic.derranironstrife.7: There are many caverns on the island of Raven's Dust. You should always bring a few torches if you wish to explore them. Oh, and bring a sword, that will prove useful too. Trust me.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.8: I wouldn't dare to go there if I were you.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.9: The Ravenwood forest is not a nice place to wander around. I heard that a woodcutter lives there though.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.0: My name is Dionysus Silverstream. What is yours friend?
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.1: I am here to help you rest your travel-weary bones.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.10: You're already taking care of recharging my "Lute" "of" "Peace", right? Don't let me down, I'm counting on you.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.11: A Champion of Light is a person who has decided to follow the path of Light.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.12: To become a Lightbringer, you must be a "Champion" "of" "Light". If you are, then all you have to do is to seek a paladin.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.13: I sense malice deep within your soul. I am afraid that I cannot help you.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.14: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.15: You are a dishonor to your race. Flee now lest I summon the guards.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.16: Farewell. May you not stray from the path of Light.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.2: King Gravesoul is a proud and noble king. His heart is always sad and heavy, though, but most don't notice that. I think he never recovered from the loss of his wife and son.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.3: I can't say I like him much, but there are many who believe he should succeed King Gravesoul after his passing. Let us pray this moment doesn't come to pass any time soon.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.4: He and Gladdius protect us from monsters and enemies that might attack us when we sleep.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.5: Don't mind his rough manners, he's a smith, not a socialite. If good weapons and equipment are what you're looking for, then you should talk to him. If it's comfort and counsel, I'd be glad to be of assistance.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.6: There is something very, very wrong and evil with him, but I don't know exactly what it is. Just be careful around him, you never know.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.7: He and Kyathos protect us from monsters and enemies that might attack us when we sleep.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.8: Should you feel like helping out, you could free the souls of my kin that are trapped in "Skeletal" "Centaurs".
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.9: I know she lives in the Nether Isles, but I don't know how to get there. I'm sure someone as resourceful as you wouldn't have a problem finding her, though.
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.0: I created eight of these portals in the hopes that you would find them. You see, your newfound powers granted you by your rebirth did not just come from out of thin air. When you gained those powers, I lost some of mine and it has to "stop"!
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.1: If you step through the portal, it will bring you to a neutral plane where I'm sure we can come to some sort of an agreement. Well, what do you say? Will you meet me on equal terms so that we may find a solution to this problem?
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.2: What? Where are you going? Get back here and finish our business!
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal2a.0: I created eight of these portals in the hopes that you would find them. You see, your newfound powers granted you by your rebirth did not just come from out of thin air. When you gained those powers, I lost some of mine and it has to "stop"!

npc.topic.doremas.0: I don't see how that concerns you.
npc.topic.doremas.1: Don't tell me you're here for some "training"...
npc.topic.doremas.10: Don't mess around him too much or you'll get thrown in jail. I tell ya, it ain't the kind of place you want to hang around!
npc.topic.doremas.11: You were supposed to rob the bank to create a diversion, numbskull! Do you really wish to abort the plan we so carefully elaborated?
npc.topic.doremas.12: Sure thing, skipper! You are only a
npc.topic.doremas.13: Whatever, just be quick about it!
npc.topic.doremas.15: I'm closing my eyes now, and when I open them you'd better be gone!
npc.topic.doremas.2: I don't know what you're talking about. Only strange person I've seen is you!
npc.topic.doremas.3: You would do best to forget that name...
npc.topic.doremas.4: Zhakar? I swear I never heard that name before! It's not me! I wasn't the one who murde.. erm... Oh! You just want to know if I heard about him? Uh. No, sorry I cannot help you.
npc.topic.doremas.5: He is my... associate but don't you tell this to anybody. If you do jolthead, I'll cut your sticky tongue with this rusted butter knife!
npc.topic.doremas.6: That brain-squashed goblin "scum"! I clearly told him that he was to meet me here! He has the nerve of making me wait here like a dim-witted bastard! AH! Wait until I get my hands on him and I'll show who is the boss around here.
npc.topic.doremas.7: Do I look like I know the safe's combination? I've already told you all this before!! Weren't you listening or what?! Rondy, Geram and Talon Irongaze are the ones you must seek.
npc.topic.doremas.8: If you want to meet him, you'll probably find him crawling on the tavern's floor.
npc.topic.doremas.9: Do not bother me about this pathetic pig-loving farmer.
npc.topic.draconisguardian.0: We half-dragons... were to protect this temple. He somehow knew that... and came prepared with some magic that... that was alien to us. He corrupted my kin and... defeated me. Please, I implore you... I can feel Caledbolg on you... which can only mean that you are... you are the one from the "prophecy".
npc.topic.draconisguardian.1: 'A Traveler who comes from the tears of the past will be sent by the Winds to cleanse the Land of its Wounds. To him the power of Balance will be given...' You are that traveler... the only one that can restore Justice to Althea. You are the one that can stop Olin Haad from bringing corruption to the entire world. You must "stop" him...
npc.topic.draconisguardian.2: Urgh... you must hasten %s for Olin Haad has already made is way inside the "burial" "chamber"... it is only a matter of time before the unthinkable happens...
npc.topic.draconisguardian.4: I am the guardian of Lothar's tomb but alas I failed...
npc.topic.dragon.0: Only other dragons know my ancient name, for I am the greatest dragon of Firesky. You mortals may call me "Darkfang".
npc.topic.dragon.1: How ignorant you can be sometimes, little one. I am a "dragon", I do not have to work as you do. I am my own person.. erm.. dragon! If I am ever hungry, I could always eat you anyway! Fortunately for you, the citizens of this "town" are bringing me enough food to satisfy my appetite.
npc.topic.dragon.10: The measure of a person isn't gold but karma, or worth in your language. The more good deeds you do, the more you attract positive magic. The reverse is also true: a black heart attracts negative magic. Some people will not want to help you if you are too far in one path or another.
npc.topic.dragon.11: Do not EVER speak that word again to me until you are ready.
npc.topic.dragon.12: The world of Althea of course!
npc.topic.dragon.13: Ahh, another mortal come to annoy me with feeble requests. Tell me, what is it you "want"?
npc.topic.dragon.14: Want help? Most people come to me requesting many things. I can only offer a few "gold" pieces or perhaps "heal" your wounds if you wish me to.
npc.topic.dragon.15: What let you think that I have a ruby dragon fang?
npc.topic.dragon.16: I kept some of Scarlet's "ruby" "dragon" "fangs" as souvenirs of this duel.
npc.topic.dragon.17: Ruby dragons are very fond of battle, and that is usually their downfall. Even though they are powerful spell casters, they prefer to dive blindlessly, breathing flames, and ripping foes apart with their talons. I once fought a ruby dragon who was foolish enough to dare challenge me to the death, guess who won?
npc.topic.dragon.18: Scarlet is the "ruby" "dragon" that I fought a long time ago. Let's say that I kept a few "souvenirs" of that fight.
npc.topic.dragon.19: Eat? I do not require food right now.
npc.topic.dragon.2: This is a small human town. It is nothing compared to the Dragon Kingdom, I tell you. This town's name is Lighthaven--how ridiculous! There's even a filthy cemetery with a "crypt" where the dead still walk.
npc.topic.dragon.20: Gold? You want me to lend some to you, small one?
npc.topic.dragon.21: I have healed weaklings such as you for days. It's time to grow. Seek your own kind at the temple to heal your frail body.
npc.topic.dragon.22: Indeed I am, and probably the oldest of all dragons. Most of us dwelt on this "world" long before the human race appeared. Don't get on the bad side of my brothers, for we love the sweet taste of hum... erm... nevermind that.
npc.topic.dragon.24: You are unworthy to speak with I. Now begone, puny mortal, before I eat you!
npc.topic.dragon.3: Artherk is not my god. He is but a human god, which simply shows how much of a weakling he is.
npc.topic.dragon.4: I ate a red monster yesterday whose name was "Diabobolo". I had indigestion for hours and had to rest here. The people of this "town" took advantage of my weakness to surround me with this meaningless fence. Of course, they have not yet figured out that I could simply fly over it. *growl*
npc.topic.dragon.5: It tasted rather bitter, gave me heartburns and left me with a heck of a bad breath!
npc.topic.dragon.6: Thank you for taking care of the tomb raider who was hiding in the Crypt.
npc.topic.dragon.7: You have GOT to be kidding!! You think I'm going to give you one of my sharp, precious teeth? Do you REALLY want to see them from this close? I guess I could chew on you for a while, if that's what you truly desire... No? Didn't think so. Don't bother me with these idiocies.
npc.topic.dragon.8: Arakas is the island you are currently standing on. Did you not know that already?
npc.topic.dragon.9: The Fourth Coming approaches and it will be thee who shalt be judged this time. The question is... Are you ready for it?
npc.topic.drardos.1: You have not heard of me before? I am the most famous "antiques" collector in all of Althea!
npc.topic.drardos.2: I have several shops on the mainland, and I'm just now moving into this new one.
npc.topic.drardos.3: What's that you got there? Hmm, what a strange looking piece this is. May I see it?
npc.topic.drardos.4: Well, at the moment we're rather busy unpacking and setting the "shop" up.
npc.topic.drardos.5: Yes, I collect antiques, but I also sell them. You didn't know? Well, I guess I can't be famous everywhere.
npc.topic.drardos.6: My "wife" and I have been too busy unpacking that we haven't had time to look around the city. You're one of the few people who came in today.
npc.topic.drardos.7: Yes, I have many swords in my beautiful collection. I will have to do an inventory of all of them later on.
npc.topic.drardos.8: My beautiful wife Leana works with me night and day to turn this into one of the best shops around!
npc.topic.drardos.9: Samuel told you that I could tan this skin? Well, he was right. I'll tan this antelope skin for 1400 gold pieces. Is that alright?
npc.topic.drunk.1: She wants to *hic* give me a beer, I hope? *snort*
npc.topic.drunk.3: Eeh? *hic* Wanna make a *gurgle* donation? A hundred gold pieces *hic* would be fine... Can you shpare that much?
npc.topic.drunk.4: *Hic* I know some things... Just give me gold and the more you give me... the more I talk... *snort*
npc.topic.drunk.5: Work? *Hic* My job is to empty the tavern's beer mugs! Now get out of my way, I need another *hic* *snort* beer! I alsho know shome "rumors", if you can shpare shome gold pieces...
npc.topic.dunikus.0: The name is Dunikus Hornwind to you, good adventurer.
npc.topic.dunikus.1: Our work is to preserve nature. It may appear simple, but it is not, for we have to fight foul creatures such as "goblins" when they threaten our forest. I have acquired a special talent in brewing "potions", and I can even "teach" you a new "spell" or two.
npc.topic.dunikus.10: Arakas is the name of this island. The "Lighthaven" is located on the south eastern part while "Windhowl" is located on the south western part of the island.
npc.topic.dunikus.11: The Stone of Life is an ordinary stone in which we have poured life energy. The stone can be used as a catalyst for our spells of nature. The burden of guarding it safely lies upon the shoulders of "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.dunikus.12: I do not like goblins and undeads, but the Forest Guardians keep them away from the druidic camp.
npc.topic.dunikus.13: The dreaded Jarko sometimes sends "goblin" spies in our camp to steal our "Stone" "of" "Life", but I have no fear since "Yrian" is guarding it.
npc.topic.dunikus.15: I shall begin instructing you right away.
npc.topic.dunikus.16: Farewell my friend, be watchful of "goblins".
npc.topic.dunikus.2: Celestina Waterbreeze is my sister. She is a druid also and resides in Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.dunikus.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.dunikus.4: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.dunikus.5: I would be glad to brew a flask of bluish liquid for you but I lack a few  special ingredients that only I know where to find them. Come back later if you want.
npc.topic.dunikus.6: The Order of Nature is a small community of druids dedicated to the protection of nature and was founded by "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.dunikus.7: Yrian Earthsong is the Elder of our community. He is our spiritual leader and a man with a great sense of responsibility. If you wish to meet him, his house is located northeast of this camp.
npc.topic.dunikus.8: Lantalir Rainmist is still an apprentice in the "Order" "of" "Nature", but his work is appreciated nevertheless. He learns very fast and has proven to be a great student. Already, he has learned the art of summoning the rain.
npc.topic.dunikus.9: We rarely get in contact with the inhabitants of Lighthaven, for they do not share our concerns for nature. The same goes for the citizens of Windhowl.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.0: You could say that I am a barber with very bad aim.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.1: Stand aside. I do not have time for this.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.10: They still have much to learn in this field of work but they are extremely well-trained.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.11: They have been chosen for their loyalty to Lord "Bane" and their assassination skills. They are everywhere. Some are even under "King" "Theodore"'s service. They are waiting for the right "moment"...
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.12: You shall see in due time...
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.13: One day, he will kneel before me and beg for mercy. But I will not listen to that weakling. No, I will not! I will deliver a clean and swift blow to his neck and present his head on a silver plate to Lord "Bane".
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.14: Ding-a-ling! I don't know everybody you numbskull!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.16: Bane is probably the most dangerous man you'll ever see. This is why I serve him... because I know that he simply cannot lose.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.17: Delwobble is a mad summoner who dwells under the castle.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.18: I never went in the desert nor do I ever want to.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.19: Have you lost your head? Or better yet, do you want to lose it?
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.2: Yes. Dwarthon Stoneface is the name.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.20: Now, let me do my work.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.3: The name is "Dwarthon" "Stoneface" to you. I am "Bane"'s most favored servant and thus, earned the title of "executioner".
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.4: Why am I an executioner? Hmmm! Let's see... ah yes... I love to kill!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.5: The tower? Ah yes, that's where that insane "old" "man" lives!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.6: Zhakar is only a fool but do not underestimate his arcane skills.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.7: You are new around here, aren't you? Yes, even this small island is part of Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.9: The rogue mages are great scouts and their magical skills are of great use to us.
npc.topic.edden.0: That's the name of this island.
npc.topic.edden.2: Yes, I am a knight of "Silversky".
npc.topic.edden.3: I "guard" the entrance to the castle, along with my friend here, Idas.
npc.topic.edden.4: It is a great town, but I still wish it wasn't so close to the castle.
npc.topic.edden.5: We are to stand here and keep any unwanted intruders from entering the castle.
npc.topic.edden.6: He is a good friend, that is for sure. We always help each other out, he and I.
npc.topic.edden.7: Have you come to see the king? Proceed then.
npc.topic.edden.8: I haven't noticed anything out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.edgar.0: They're giving us a hard time that's for sure.
npc.topic.edgar.1: I'm Head Merchant Edgar Gimplestratten, if you like formal titles, or just Edgar, if you're more the relaxed type.
npc.topic.edgar.10: Trade? WHAT trade? With all the trouble on the island, it's not like we are making loads of money, eh? If you wanna help, go kill some of those "goblins" out there.
npc.topic.edgar.11: There are many adventurers running in the streets, lately, and that'd be a good thing if they were all fine folks. Some just prey upon the weak, though, and we'd prefer not to have them here if we had a choice.
npc.topic.edgar.12: A lovely town, don't you think? "Windhowl" is a bit larger, but I think it's not as lively as Lighthaven. And the people here are nicer, too. Windhowl is just too mercantile.
npc.topic.edgar.13: Oh no you don't! I'm not about to give in to the likes of you! If you want the money, you'll have to knock me out!
npc.topic.edgar.14: It isn't easy, trading in Lighthaven. We have some ruthless thieves' guild in town who operates a "protection" racket on our merchants, and we have brigands who roam the countryside, waylaying traders who travel between Lighthaven and Windhowl. Let me tell you, it's been slim pickings, of late.
npc.topic.edgar.2: I'm the master of the Lighthaven "Merchant" "Guild", the LMG as we call it for short. I used to be an adventurer, but I decided to settle down a few years ago and fight the good fight with money rather than with my sword.
npc.topic.edgar.3: There have been plenty of people asking about her, lately. Who is she?
npc.topic.edgar.4: I wouldn't know. Ask a priest or something.
npc.topic.edgar.6: Yes, even a small place such as "Lighthaven" has its own merchants' guild. It's necessary to keep trading smooth, especially with the "goblins" and "brigands" disrupting everything these days.
npc.topic.edgar.7: Ah, they're everywhere, these days! Like the plague! You get outta town, you run into armed goblins. ARMED! What's this world coming to! It's a disaster for Lighthaven's economy, if you ask me.
npc.topic.edgar.8: It's like I tell everyone, everybody there is just a little too bent on making money. They forget to be nice to their neighbors, to help each other, to actually care, if you get my drift.
npc.topic.edgar.9: <Sigh> As if fighting goblins wasn't enough, we've got to fight our own kind. Not something I'm particularly proud of, as a human. We should be looking out for each other, not killing each other. What good is money if it's blood money?
npc.topic.efnisien.10: I'm sorry, as much as I would like to chat with you all day, I have other things to do. And since my jaw hurts like hell, I must attend to it. Oh yes, one last thing... if you want to make yourself known to Olin Haad, try giving his guards a beating or two. If you need a reason, do it for me, heh heh. Now, if you'll excuse me...
npc.topic.efnisien.11: It's too late anyway. Olin Haad has found an alternate way to enter and he's inside the temple right now. You can enter through the stairs in the room behind the locked door, but it will serve you no good, as you won't be able to defeat him without a special weapon of some sort.
npc.topic.efnisien.2: Oh, this and that. I would tell you more about myself, but I don't really know you.
npc.topic.efnisien.3: Look at me now... I'm covered in blood! Damn my jaw hurts too... Oh, but where are my manners? My name is Efnisien, and these gentlemen were "assassins" sent here by "Olin" "Haad", 'necromancer extraordinaire'.
npc.topic.efnisien.4: Ahem!, Aye... but nevermind them, it's just an old quarrel... Now, I presume you're here to talk about "Olin" "Haad", right? Let's get to it then.
npc.topic.efnisien.5: That bastard took the town "under" "siege", and for what? I heard it was for a worthless piece of stone!
npc.topic.efnisien.6: From what I hear, it's a stone or something of the sort that the king promised him in exchange for his "services".
npc.topic.efnisien.7: Our king Theodore XIII hired this guy to clean some rather powerful creatures that were roaming the land in these parts. Believe it or not, once the deed was done, the king actually "refused" to pay up.
npc.topic.efnisien.8: I don't know why, but seeing as you seem more interested in the matter than I, perhaps you should take it up with Olin Haad directly. You can find him in a cavern across town. After all, I believe he is the reason you came to "visit" me, is it not?
npc.topic.efnisien.9: The "letter" I received mentioned that you would come visit me to talk about Olin Haad.
npc.topic.eldantor.0: The name is Eldantor to you.
npc.topic.eldantor.1: I wander around the world to quench my insatiable thirst for knowledge. I am an experienced mage and could probably teach you the art of "meditation" if you wish to learn it. Furthermore, I am also a great "arcane" "scribe" and may be of assistance if you are interested in magical lore.
npc.topic.eldantor.10: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.eldantor.12: You must be so proud of yourself.
npc.topic.eldantor.13: Farewell. I shall return to my "meditation".
npc.topic.eldantor.14: Even I do not possess all the answers.
npc.topic.eldantor.2: I can't help you with whatever it is you need, but if it's advice you seek, perhaps you should consult Chryseida Yolangda, the old gypsy. Careful, though. The more advice you seek, the more she charges you for her services. Guess that's just the way the world is, eh?
npc.topic.eldantor.3: Arcane scribes can use a "magic" "scripting" "kit" in order to inscribe powerful symbols of magic into a blank magical tome.
npc.topic.eldantor.5: If you need a Tome of Valor, I heard of a mage who goes by the name of "Liurn" "Clar" would be most suitable for the task.
npc.topic.eldantor.6: I doubt you have enough talent in the Art to use it but if you insist on having one, I could probably sell you one for a mere 20,000 gold pieces. So, do you wish to buy a magic scripting kit from me?
npc.topic.eldantor.7: If you need to seek your true destiny, he can definitely help you... if you find him.
npc.topic.eldantor.8: To "meditate" is to heal the soul. The art of meditation is a discipline that takes time to master. If you wish, I could "teach" you how to use it.
npc.topic.eldantor.9: You need %u more levels, %u more intelligence and %u more wisdom to learn meditate.
npc.topic.eldrig.0: I have no time for chit-chats.
npc.topic.eldrig.2: I am Eldrig. Hey, while you're around, why don't you "train" your skills with me and see how good you are?
npc.topic.eldrig.3: I am being handsomely paid by "Grant" "Hornkeep" to enforce the laws in this town and to ensure protection of our citizens.
npc.topic.eldrig.4: You're asking the wrong person, I'm not the one to give you help or hints on your quests. You should ask the old gypsy, she can foretell your future. Be sure to have a lot of gold with you, though. She's not cheap.
npc.topic.eldrig.6: Grant Hornkeep is the town's sheriff.
npc.topic.eldrig.7: If you know where that thief is hiding, you'd better tell me or I'll assume that you are one of his accomplices!
npc.topic.eldrig.9: I'm sure he'll talk to someone like you. I hear he dwells at the very center of Stoneheim, although I don't know what you'll find there.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.0: Well, since the "brigands" have been attacking travelers in the forest, we haven't had many visitors. These guards roaming all over town aren't helping either, let me tell you. I wish the war with "Windhowl" and the goblins would end so we can have some guards to help with the "brigands" in the forest. At least, sometimes "Murmuntag" takes it upon himself to go scare them away.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.1: Aye, my friend, he isn't very smart, but he could take ten of my best men single-handedly. When he makes his surprise attack on the "brigands" in the forest, they usually calm down for a day or two. I wish I could send him there more often, but we need him to guard the town.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.10: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.11: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.15: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.2: I am the town's chief guard. I have the responsibility to ensure the town stays safe for our citizens.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.3: Aye! I am Elmert Merkis, but please, do call me Elmert.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.4: Windhowl is our sister town on the island. It is currently battling against the goblins in the northwestern mountains, trying to stop them from invading all of the island. But since King "Theodore" rose to power, the goblins have been gaining territory rather quickly. Reinforcements are always coming late, or never coming at all. I'm sure they could use good fighters.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.5: Raven's Dust is the island southwest of here. It is there that the castle of King "Theodore" resides. Most of the guards and soldiers in "Goldmoon"'s army are trained there.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.6: You're not going to believe this, but someone told me that a friend of his heard this as the dying words of a man who barely escaped Balork with his life... That Balork is building swords of darkness such as the Gloomblade to equip his evil armies when they try to take over our town. If you find some, give them to the priests. They can destroy them... I think.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.7: Goldmoon is the kingdom that encompasses the islands of "Raven's" "Dust" and the island you are currently on, Arakas.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.8: That sorry excuse for a king sleeps half of the time, and awakens only to go back to sleep! Meanwhile, "Windhowl"'s guards are decreasing at an alarming rate.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.9: I don't know what's been up with them lately, but they are constantly attacking our "merchants" when they attempt to do business with "Windhowl". This is nothing new, but lately they have been banding together and are in larger groups. I wish I could solve this problem, but I don't have time to take care of it.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.0: I am Elysana Blackrose, sorceress of Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.1: I do not have any specific occupation. I am devoted to my studies of the "mystical" "arts" and I spend most of my spare time with my books. If you could help me, I would be grateful if you could fetch some "ingredients". Also, I may have a "green" "gemstone" in which you might be interested if you intend to talk with tree people.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.12: It is said that somewhere beneath the desert lies an underground dungeon where treasures and mysteries can be found.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.13: I... I don't like being involved with people like you, but I can tell you're not going to take no for an answer. I'll do it, but you must promise never to tell anyone about this. Agreed?
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.14: You do not look gifted enough to learn spells worth of being taught.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.15: Sapphire gem? That's my birthday's rock.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.16: Do I look like your personal spiritual trainer? If you wish to train yourself in the mystical arts, you should think about reading a few books.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.17: King Theodore's kingdom of Goldmoon is falling apart.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.18: I foresee that you shall achieve a greater state of mind and body in %u more experience points.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.19: I should turn you into a fly and change myself into a frog so I can eat you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.2: You were able to gather all three ingredients, %s? That's nice. Now, would you like to trade them to me?
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.3: The herb you seek does not grow on the surface of the world, but rather in the deepest caves of this island. And no, before you ask, I don't have any to sell.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.4: They are my passion in life. I have been gifted since the day I was born. It would be a pleasure to share my "knowledge" with you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.5: I have learned many spells over the years, two of which I have designed myself. These two I would be willing to "teach" you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.8: Before I help you, %s, I'd like you to bring me some "ether".
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.9: Champions of Light are men and women who have dedicated themselves to the cause of pure good. They must take a special oath and have done far more good deeds than evil deeds.
npc.topic.eraka.1: I am a guard of this town, but I was injured in battle.
npc.topic.eraka.10: Lighthaven is our sister town. It's located on the eastern part of the island.
npc.topic.eraka.11: Yes, the name of this island is Arakas.
npc.topic.eraka.12: That's the name of the island somewhere to the south. I don't know any way to reach it. That island is also part of the kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.eraka.13: The kingdom of Goldmoon regroups both Raven's Dust and Arakas. It is currently under the rulership of "King" "Theodore" "XIII".
npc.topic.eraka.14: Why hasn't he sent any reinforcements here yet?
npc.topic.eraka.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.eraka.4: He is the necromancer who lives somewhere in the northern mountains.
npc.topic.eraka.5: Sunrock is currently the Lord of "Windhowl".
npc.topic.eraka.6: Why should I know anything about them?
npc.topic.eraka.8: The druidic camp is located to the northeast of the island.
npc.topic.eraka.9: Windhowl is the name of this town.
npc.topic.etheanan.0: There are a very few people who know me. My name is Etheanan. What can I do for you?
npc.topic.etheanan.1: Yes? Do I know you? Hmm, somehow I doubt that.
npc.topic.etheanan.11: Hah! you think so too eh?
npc.topic.etheanan.12: Well, I am what you might call an "elementalist".
npc.topic.etheanan.13: Yes, I have devoted my life to the study of all things arcane, but especially to the "elements".
npc.topic.etheanan.14: There are six elements in this plane of existence. Nearly all spells are connected with at least one of these elements. They are fire, water, air, earth, light and dark. There are many "theories" and "beliefs" out there about what happens when you cast a spell, but very few are actually accurate.
npc.topic.etheanan.15: Many people think that "mana" flows all around us, and that they can just bend and shape it to their will. This is at the most only partly true. "Mana" does flow around us, but not how you would think.
npc.topic.etheanan.16: Well for instance, many people, wizards included, believe that casting a spell involves channeling raw mana and altering it through force of will into one of the six elements for easier manipulation and containment. This is in fact a misconception, as the mana is not so much channeled and then altered, as it is drawn from one of the "metaplanes".
npc.topic.etheanan.17: The elemental metaplanes are where the true magic comes from. Whenever a wizard casts a spell, he is in fact tapping into one of the metaplanes. Each metaplane can be tapped for mana of the appropriate element. For example, to cast a firestorm, I would create a link between the elemental metaplane of fire and myself, allowing myself to draw sufficient mana to cast my spell. This is all done instinctively, of course, so no one would ever believe you if you tried to explain it to them.
npc.topic.etheanan.18: These often consist of utility spells and are most subject to having special, if not strange effects. The mana burst spell, for instance, is one such raw spell, and is quite useful in certain circumstances. At first sight, this spell appears to be rather weak, but careful examination will reveal a great potential on magic-resistant creatures. Because of the nature of this spell, the damage it inflicts may not be resisted by a creature's natural magic defenses.
npc.topic.etheanan.19: Ahhh, so you would like to learn some of my spells, is that it? Very well then.
npc.topic.etheanan.2: I am a "wizard", though a very "special" one at that.
npc.topic.etheanan.21: To understand mana is to control it. Each spell requires a special kind of mana, whether it be a simple fire dart spell or a devastating avalanche spell. There are, of course, exceptions to this rule, which we will call "raw" "spells".
npc.topic.etheanan.3: Yes, I create my own "spells" to help with my everyday "chores".
npc.topic.etheanan.4: These include "fishing", "hunting", "cleaning", oh and "cooking", of course. Heh heh heh.
npc.topic.etheanan.5: Ahh, one of the better things in life, if you ask me. Do you like to fish by any chance?
npc.topic.etheanan.6: Hmm, my food stores are getting quite a bit low, if I do say so myself. I'll not survive the next season if I don't get around to start hunting again. I don't really enjoy it, but it is a must for someone who lives around here.
npc.topic.etheanan.7: Bah! That is the one thing I truly dislike. I live so far away from the general populace that I cannot get a decent maid. If it wasn't for my magic, I would have gone back to "civilization" a long time ago.
npc.topic.etheanan.8: I am referring, of course, to the city of "Silversky".
npc.topic.etheanan.9: It is a fine city, but one I try to avoid nonetheless.
npc.topic.evelyn.0: I'm Evelyn. And you are...%s? It's really nice to meet you.
npc.topic.evelyn.2: My, my, aren't we curious today? I simply like to walk in the forest even though there are some vile "creatures" around here.
npc.topic.evelyn.3: Oh, don't worry! It's nothing I can't handle. Appearances can be truly deceiving you know. I have a trick or two up my sleeve if needed be.
npc.topic.evelyn.4: They're pretty hard to find. They try to lure you into the depth of the woods but when you get to the point where they were standing, they are no where to be seen. Hrm, I don't want to sound mean but I doubt you'll ever find one on your own. You'd best leave this to me.
npc.topic.evelyn.5: Okay, that does it! I'll show you some manners!
npc.topic.fali.1: I sell all those items. Please, feel free to have a "look".
npc.topic.fali.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.fali.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.fali.4: If you steal something, I swear you will regret it.
npc.topic.fali.5: Hmmm? Rolph or Sigfried might want to see the lord's registration letter.
npc.topic.fali.7: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.fali.9: Come back if you ever need anything.
npc.topic.filandrius.0: I've just finished translating an ancient text containing important information on a tome called "Filnar'thir", the Tome of Arcane Knowledge.
npc.topic.filandrius.1: That's what I want. Have you ever heard about Anthor the Mad? I suppose not... Anthor was the pride of the human civilization in the dwarven era. He devised many wonders and with the fall of the dwarfs, he helped make the human civilization what it is today. Unfortunately, like every flower, he bloomed under the light and faded in the "darkness".
npc.topic.filandrius.10: As I said before, I am the high sorcerer.
npc.topic.filandrius.2: He eventually met Makrsh P'Tangh... The lich did something that cost poor Anthor his sanity. Today he roams aimlessly on the island of Stoneheim, searching for something. I read somewhere that he would find peace only in death. That makes today his lucky day as I've developed a particular interest in the book he carries. If you've a bit of spare time, I would greatly appreciate it if you could "get" "it" for me.
npc.topic.filandrius.3: Alright then, feel free to look around as you please.
npc.topic.filandrius.4: Well, I read about these soulstones awhile back. It was written that they were used to open a gate to "countless" "riches".
npc.topic.filandrius.5: As you have probably guessed, the other two soulstones are guarded by creatures not unlike the one you defeated to get the soulstone that's in your possession. Unfortunately, I don't know where the other two guardians are located... but I can give you their "names".
npc.topic.filandrius.6: The three guardians are called Jormungand, Hel and Fenrir. Once you've found all three soulstones, look for the portal near the centaur village on Stoneheim. Be careful though, as I've read that once the soulstones are used to enter the portal, they are consumed by the portal's energies.
npc.topic.filandrius.7: Oh no, it's no trouble at all. And here you go, for all the trouble you've been through. I'm sure you'll enjoy this as much as I did.
npc.topic.filandrius.8: These are some of the more useful spells contained within the book.
npc.topic.filandrius.9: I am Filandrius, high sorcerer of this library.
npc.topic.forestwanderer.0: A voice says: ''I'm just a wanderer, don't mind me.''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.1: A voice says: ''I just walk around these woods, helping lost souls find their way home.''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.2: A voice says: ''Do you wish to be sent home?''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.6: A voice says: ''If there were Elves here, I certainly wouldn't tell you.''
npc.topic.garnir.0: Do not waste my time with petty questions! I have "work" to do.
npc.topic.garnir.1: I am an assistant to Lord Arganor. Tiring work it is, I tell you. I have done that for so many years, I just can't wait to finally "leave". Anyway, do you need "help" or not? I don't have all day! *grumble*
npc.topic.garnir.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I never met her myself.
npc.topic.garnir.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked for eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.garnir.4: I do not have all day to chat, you know! Go bother someone else!
npc.topic.garnir.5: I can help you train your skills to help better yourself, but you'd better be quick about it!
npc.topic.garnir.6: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.geena.1: I'm the waitress here.  I help "Halam" in his work.
npc.topic.geena.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.geena.3: I'll be with you as soon as I have a minute.
npc.topic.geena.5: He's very nice, and always joyful.  He speaks to all the "travelers".
npc.topic.geena.6: We haven't seen many lately. I'm waiting for the day that a nice adventurer will ask to "marry" me.
npc.topic.geena.7: I'll wait until a rich adventurer comes to marry me.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.0: Why, surely you must be an outsider to not be familiar with my name. I am known as George the third, son of George the second.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.1: I am the renowned captain of the guards. I protect the citizens of Goldmoon, which, I would like to point out, has never fallen to an invasion. Not even those damned "goblins" can breach the walls of this city.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.3: I heard that she has elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.4: Tough little brutes they've become lately, but still not even close to being a match for me or my well-trained army. Rest assured, as long as I, George the IIIrd, am captain of the guard, the goblins have no chance of invading our proud town.
npc.topic.geram.1: Umm, let's see now, I think it was Geram.
npc.topic.geram.2: ... oh, are you talking to me? It's been so long since someone spoke that name to me.
npc.topic.geram.3: I don't have any work. Would you happen to be offering me some by any chance?
npc.topic.geram.5: HIM! He's the reason I'm so poor! That devil took everything I had through gambling, my money, my home and even my wife Adriana! What a tragedy!
npc.topic.geram.6: A visitor? Well, you folks all look the same to me you know... you're all rich!
npc.topic.geram.7: Such evolved language, you probably have a coin or two to spare...
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.0: Me Ghundarg Rumblefoot. *snort* Me will to take over "Silversky"!
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.1: Dumb hummie think I would tell you this? HA! Me die before talk.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.10: Traitors! ARRRrrgh!!!! They have been brain-washed by the humans. *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.11: Soon, Raven's Dust will be ours! *snort*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.12: *snort* Weakling he is. Me much powerful than him.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.13: *snort* Humans always welcome when we hunger for flesh. *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.2: Small town filled with dumb hummies! We soon crush them!
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.3: Me orc leader. We crush humans. *snort* And we conquer what is rightfully ours! You can help me! You find some "ingredients" me need and me spare your puny life! *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.4: *grunt* You have the dandelion leaves and two pairs of tarantula eyes? You give to me?
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.5: *grunt* You have one human's foot? Me take! Will you give it to me?
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.6: We are invincible *grunt*. Silversky cannot resists us. *snort* King Theodore XIII's crown be mine and his head be over the *grunt* fireplace.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.7: *grunt* Grimish is an annoying slimy goblin spy. *snort* We took care of him.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.8: *grunt* Methinks it's time for me to teach you a lesson.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.9: He is only a feeble human. *grunt* All human are weaklings. *snort*
npc.topic.giamas.1: That is the name my god has chosen for me.
npc.topic.giamas.2: Ahh yes, I would gladly tell you about my work. Like many others, I am a priest and choose to worship Artherk. I also make it a hobby of mine to "teach" some of what I know to strangers like yourself.
npc.topic.giamas.3: 'Tis a potent herb, when used by someone of pure spirit... I doubt that you could be such a person, but the world is full of surprises.
npc.topic.giamas.4: Here are the spells that I can teach you.
npc.topic.giamas.5: I worship Artherk, and he looks after his people. He is a kind and just god and deserves all the followers he can get.
npc.topic.giamas.6: This is a beautiful town with alot of good people.
npc.topic.giamas.7: I have not seen anyone that fits that description, I'm afraid.
npc.topic.giamas.8: May Artherk guide you, my friend.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.0: I have told you before, my name is Gladdius.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.1: Yes, I am Gladdius! What do you want from me?
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.10: Say one more word and you'll feel the edge of my sword!
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.2: I have no idea what you want, but as long as you keep your nose clean and stay out of our affairs, you're okay with me. I'm busy enough keeping an eye on that "Zion" "Thunderheart" fellow without having to worry about you strangers.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.3: Careful what you do or say around him. He's a tricky fellow, very ambitious and dangerous. We don't have anything on him, but we'll get him yet. Meanwhile, stay away from him or bad things may happen to you. Don't say I didn't warn you!
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.4: He's another guard, like me. Don't get in our way, we have big fish to take care of.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.5: He's a manasmith. If you want special armors, he's the one you should talk to. Not all his armors might fit you, though, but some of his weapons might be more your size.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.6: He's a little weak by Centaur standards, but he's got a good heart and he worships Artherk. He may not look like much, but I wouldn't underestimate him if I were you. Without his influence, we Centaurs would probably be at each other's throats. He's very wise, that's for sure.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.7: He's a manaweaver. There's about one manaweaver for every one hundred Centaurs, so that's pretty rare. I'm told he keeps to himself and does very powerful items at very high cost.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.8: King Aedenas Gravesoul is a strong and honorable king. We're all very loyal to him... except "Zion" "Thunderheart", of course.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.9: I stand guard here to protect the town.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.0: I am Glaenshenmilandira, a seraph of Artherk.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.1: I am a Seraph of Artherk. I do not usually have to interact with mortals and I do not need to do mundane chores as you do.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.2: The purifiers are holy souls that have for purpose to maintain an acceptable amount of nether monsters around here. Bear them malice, and you'll feel sorry.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.3: The neoflares are powerful nether creatures that roam these isles. Even my "purifiers" are not strong enough to eradicate these vile monsters.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.5: The Will of Artherk represents the drive and passion one must have to truly change the world and the way people think.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.6: If you'd had wings, I'd clip 'em right now!
npc.topic.granthornkeep.0: Yes, that's the name. I am the town's sheriff.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.1: I am Grant Hornkeep, but you may call me Grant.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.10: Nissus Haloseeker is the only priest we have in our small temple. Seek his aid if you need healing or guidance.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.11: If you'll excuse me, there is work to be done.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.2: I could use some "Belt" "of" "Skraug" "Strength", if you know where to find some. Also, I could use some assitance in killing the "nightcreepers" and "pilferers" that hang around Stonecrest. Also, if you could bring me some of the thieves' "Secret" "Documents", I could learn of their plans and thwart them more efficiently.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.3: You will require the Key of Artherk before you can find him. Ask around, I'm sure you'll figure it out.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.4: Please kill as many as you can. For every nine you kill, I'll give you a reward.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.5: They are a real pain in the neck! Kill eight of them and I'll give you a reward.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.6: You may not think those are very useful, but once you've got enough of them, the Mayor himself will reward you.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.7: I am the town's sheriff. Now, if you'll excuse me, I still have some unresolved cases that require my full attention. Unless you want to "help", I'll have to ask you to leave.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.8: If I get my hands on this thief, he will spend the remaining days of his sorry life in a jail cell.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.9: Torgas is the bartender of the local tavern, where all the miscreants usually are.
npc.topic.greyareedy.0: My name? Humpf what a waste of time. Oh well, if you insist, I am Greyar Eedy.
npc.topic.greyareedy.1: Isn't it obvious? I am the banker of this town. I keep track of all the "deposits" and "withdrawals" everyone makes. Now be quick, it is a very demanding job and I have other matters to attend to.
npc.topic.greyareedy.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.greyareedy.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.greyareedy.4: The Bank of Windhowl will provide you with a secure way of keeping your gold pieces away from the brigands. You may "deposit", "withdraw" or verify your "balance". I do not even operate the bank during the night because I am far too scared of being robbed by cloaked brigands in the shadows of the night.
npc.topic.greyareedy.5: You have %u gold pieces in your account.
npc.topic.greyareedy.6: If you wish to deposit gold pieces in the Windhowl bank, you'll have to tell me how many you wish to deposit. Just tell me 'deposit <x> gold' where <x> is the amount of gold pieces you wish to deposit. Or perhaps you would like to verify your "balance" or even "withdraw" gold from the "bank".
npc.topic.greyareedy.7: If you want to withdraw gold pieces from your account, you will have to tell me 'withdraw <x> gold' where <x> is the amount of gold pieces you want to withdraw.
npc.topic.greyleaf.0: I am known as Grey Leaf, elder of the Daemon Trees.
npc.topic.greyleaf.1: That does not concern you. But if you wish to make yourself "useful" to me, then perhaps I could find something for you.
npc.topic.greyleaf.10: I have no time to answer the questions of an ignorant person.
npc.topic.greyleaf.11: Daemon Trees! I've seen enough of that fool!
npc.topic.greyleaf.2: I am impressed. You have brought back the "Black" "Snakeroot" and the "Woody" "Nightshade"? Now, will you give me the two ingredients I need?
npc.topic.greyleaf.3: If you want this ring, you will have to prove yourself "useful" to me in one way or another.
npc.topic.greyleaf.4: If you want to make yourself "useful", you can always try to get me some.
npc.topic.greyleaf.5: If you want to make yourself "useful", you can always try to get me some.
npc.topic.greyleaf.6: They are mine... MINE! You'll have to walk on my trunk if you ever want them.
npc.topic.greyleaf.7: They obey my orders and mine alone.
npc.topic.greyleaf.9: Zhakar, that clumsy old fool, is always after my "belladona" "berries" but they are mine.
npc.topic.grimish.10: Dumb orc hit Grimish on head. See? Big bump on head. Then, Grimish wake up here. You here like Grimish? You prisoner too?
npc.topic.grimish.11: Doremas is a thief in Silversky. He used to like Grimish unlike other humans. I was to meet Doremas somewhere but Grimish do not remember anymore.
npc.topic.grimish.12: Grimish play game. Simple. You tell, me tell. Tell me now what better than raw rats yet more ugly than Doremas?
npc.topic.grimish.13: Nothing? You right! You good at riddles. Fine. You earn prize. Doremas want to know word pass. Or was it pass-word? Me know not. What you want to know is the Alliance is renewed.
npc.topic.grimish.15: You have three pairs of vampire bat wings? They are vampires like Count Hemogoblin, ya know. Would you give them to me? Grimish be happy!
npc.topic.grimish.16: Yes. Grimish goblin. You keen eyes! You seen "Count" "Hemogoblin" on "Arakas"? Me would like to.
npc.topic.grimish.18: Grimish know about that. Grimish think it that way. Uh.. nonono! That way! Yes. Grimish sure!
npc.topic.grimish.19: Win all? Grimish never win. Grimish not lucky.
npc.topic.grimish.2: Me no work! Me trapped here. When stomach grumble, me catch "rats" and eat. You want some?
npc.topic.grimish.20: Funny wizard. Grimish able to do magic tricks too. You see lil' rat? *glurp* Now you don't!
npc.topic.grimish.21: Grimish no like you anymore. You too mean.
npc.topic.grimish.3: Rats taste good. Try tail. Very good!
npc.topic.grimish.4: Me not remember... Ah! Me now remember... me Grimish!
npc.topic.grimish.6: Varto? Grimish no care. Me no like.
npc.topic.grimish.7: Home not here! Not here! Not here Grimish say! Home that way! Or that way!
npc.topic.grimish.8: Me want to go out. See big orc leader.
npc.topic.grimish.9: They bigger than you. Better looking too and stronger methinks.
npc.topic.guardman.0: I am sorry to hear that. We do our best to please everybody, but it is not an easy task. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to work.
npc.topic.guardman.1: I am pleased to see that you're satisfied. Have a nice day.
npc.topic.guardman.2: I don't have time for endless chit-chat, I've got work to do.
npc.topic.guardman.3: I don't know anything about that. Leave me alone, I have a job to do.
npc.topic.guardman.4: I don't know her. Now if you'll excuse me...
npc.topic.guardman.5: I am a guard of Lighthaven's militia. Pardon my rudeness, but I must return to my duties.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.0: Hah! Nomad is what we call a peculiar merchant. He's very "aggressive", and not just in his dealings with fellow guild members, but with clients as well... unless he really wants something, then he's all smiles.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.1: Add to that the fact that he can spot a good "bargain" a mile away, and you can understand why he is very unpopular amongst his fellow merchants.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.10: Yes, I am coming to that. But first, I must be honest with you... I wasn't really rambling about Urik before. I was counting on the fact that you would take this job and teach him a "lesson".
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.11: Oh don't worry, he really did owe me the money. You see, Urik is a friend of Nomad's and I "suspect" they are working together for someone else.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.12: I was about to investigate myself before you came along. The other day, I overheard Urik talking to Nomad about the "Obsidian" "Conclave" or something like that.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.13: I set an associate of mine on your tail while you paid your visit to Urik earlier. While you had him distracted, I had my associate steal a set of "keys" from behind Urik's counter.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.14: I believe that one of these keys will open the door to Nomad's "house". Here you go, they're all yours.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.15: His house is located somewhere in the south part of town. If you search inside, you might find some clue as to where he left.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.18: I am the head of the merchant's guild.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.2: Aye, why just recently he came across what he called a "Heartstone". He was very excited about it too. Knowing him, he has already made a fortune with it.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.3: Look, I would like to continue talking with you but I'm a very busy man. I must attend to a "problem" and each minute I spend talking is a minute I don't spend fixing it. If you don't mind...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.4: Bah! No one is to be trusted these days it seems! Urik the tailor master has neglected to pay his "duties" to the guild coffers and he still receives the benefits.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.5: He says he paid double the standard fees last month knowing that he would have trouble paying this month. The problem is, the amount counted in the coffers says otherwise. People like him are what give merchants a bad name! Don't they know they shouldn't bite the hand that feeds them? Anyway, now for the "mercenaries"...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.6: Hey! You're a mercenary, aren't you? Would you do this small "task" for me? I will pay you and I can even help you find the Nomad. I'm a merchant after all, I know people.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.7: I already told you who this is about in my ramblings. Urik the tailor master hasn't paid his duties this month. I need you to pay him a visit and recover the money he owes the guild. Look around town and I'm sure you will find him hiding in his shop.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.8: Give me that money so I can put it somewhere safe. Now, about "Nomad"...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.9: That's what you get for trying to cross me! Now don't come back until you have 2000 gold!
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.10: Thanks for the business, until we meet again.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.2: I am the town weaponsmith. I sell my "wares" to whoever is in need of a "weapon". Luckily for me, there is no shortage of need here, what with the feud between the races.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.3: I see I've caught your attention, eh? Well, perhaps you would like to take a closer look at just what I have to sell?
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.4: Only those with godly keys, such as the Key of Artherk, can ever hope to find him.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.5: Of course you want to buy, who wouldn't? Will you take a look at my selection?
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.6: Truly, I have the very best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Feel free to look around and "buy" what you like!
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.7: I don't see what you could possibly have to offer me, but I'll oblige you anyway.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.8: If it's advice you seek, go see Yolangda the gypsy. You might find her advice expensive, but if you're desperate, I'm sure she's the one to talk to.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.9: Leave my shop at once, you're wasting my time.
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.0: *Grunt* Guntertag is lieutenant of guard! *Snort* Guntertag crush goblins *snort*. Urggh!
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.1: I am GUNTERTAG DESTROY! *grunt*, Brother of *snort* "Murmuntag" Destroy. *grunt* Uuaaarrrgghhh!
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.4: Murmuntag is brother of *snort* Guntertag. He lives in *grunt* Lighthaven. Together, Murmuntag and Guntertag could crush *snort* *grunt* anything.
npc.topic.gwen.0: I am Gwen, the best and only armor shopkeeper in town! You won't find a better deal anywhere else, I assure you! Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.gwen.1: I work as an armorer. I sell imported armor and sometimes even make them myself. Everything here is of the finest quality! Do you want to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.gwen.4: Windhowl? That is the name of this town.
npc.topic.gwen.5: It is our sister town on the eastern part of this island. Another armorer named "Rolph" has set up his armor shop there.
npc.topic.gwen.6: He is an armorer who lives in "Lighthaven". He is, of course, less skilled than I am.
npc.topic.gwen.7: What do you wish to buy?
npc.topic.gwen.8: What item do you wish to sell?
npc.topic.gypsy.0: You seem surprised that I know about that... the answer is simple. I am a "seer".
npc.topic.gypsy.1: I can see images in my dreams that are beyond understanding. For instance, I had a vision yesterday, and you were in it. You were searching for someone named... "Nomad" I believe.
npc.topic.gypsy.2: I can help you find him, but first I must attune myself with your aura. Let's see now... did the one called Olin Haad tell you about the New Breed, yes or no?
npc.topic.haden.0: My name is no concern of yours.
npc.topic.haden.1: So, you know about me, how unfortunate... for YOU!
npc.topic.haden.2: What I do with my time is none of your business.
npc.topic.haden.4: So, you know about my sister. What do you want from me?
npc.topic.haden.5: So, you know about me, how unfortunate... for YOU!
npc.topic.haden.6: You want a fight? Then I'll give you one! En garde!
npc.topic.haden.7: Hah! You want the Blade of Ruin? Then come and get it!
npc.topic.halam.0: My name is Halam Tors! Pleased to meet you!
npc.topic.halam.1: I'm the "innkeeper" of this inn! Would you like a "drink"? This is the best ale around! It's also the only one around! *laugh*
npc.topic.halam.10: Nightswords are pretty nifty items for people who like to dwell into darkness. I seem to remember a fellow who once made some, but for some reason, I can't seem to remember his name or where he lives... Heh heh... Perhaps you'd care to jog my memory with a thousand gold pieces?
npc.topic.halam.11: The inhabitants of Arakas have too many problems with the goblins. They need all the help they can get! It is rumored that Righul's Mountains, located north of Arakas, are infested by those ugly goblins! But that's not the worst! It is also said that an evil necromancer--as if a necromancer could be anything else--is leading this army! If he could be defeated, it would help us more than anything! Except maybe another mug of ale.
npc.topic.halam.12: They say that there are many atrocities lurking in the cave south of here. You should go have a look! It is not that far. Although, I have also heard that they had moved somewhere to the west... Or was it the north? Oh, I don't really know.
npc.topic.halam.13: I heard a mage talking about a dungeon under the temple of Lighthaven! I've been living here for 20 years and I never knew!
npc.topic.halam.14: Not many have seen a dragon, they have all taken shelter and they do not bother people. Have you seen the huge one we trapped? Now that's what I call a real dragon.
npc.topic.halam.15: Mato? It's the biggest forest on Arakas.  If you wish to travel on Arakas, you won't find a way around this forest!
npc.topic.halam.16: It'll cost ya 50 GP if you want me to tell you your worth. That comes with a beer, so it's not a total waste. Heh heh. Will you pay?
npc.topic.halam.17: I could throw you out for using such foul language.
npc.topic.halam.4: Have a seat and I'll send Geena to you as soon as she's free.
npc.topic.halam.5: As an innkeeper, I hear strange "rumors" from everyone.  "Travelers" often come here to buy a mug of ale or two!
npc.topic.halam.6: I heard many rumors! Some are about "goblins", others about "atrocities", but seldom are they about the "temple". I even heard people talking about "dragons"! But I warn ya, it's only rumors, you know!
npc.topic.halam.7: They usually come from all around, but these last few months, I haven't seen many.  Business isn't going too well.
npc.topic.halam.8: Don't know what you're talking about, friend.
npc.topic.halam.9: Oh, that! Yes, it's a pretty impressive magical sword, although I'm told only sinister fellows use it. Something like a boosted version of a Nightsword, I think.
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.1: Me gett odder tribe "scalp" an Weethgwotha pey me reel guud.
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.2: Yu bring me, um... handful of scalps ov odder tribe, und I give yew a "Skraugbashor" "Mace".
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.3: Me gonna bash sum hummie skull wit dis bigg glubb!
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.4: Hummie go, me can gett back t' werk.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.1: Don't ask me, ask someone who knows. Hey, why don't you ask that old dame, Chryseida? She's a fortune-teller, I'm sure she'll help... for a price.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.3: I am the town's armorsmith. If you want to "buy" an armor, come to me first and I will make you a deal you cannot refuse.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.4: I have some the strongest armors you can find around. They'll never let you down in the middle of a fight. Do you want to have a look at my selection?
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.5: Whatever it is, I'm sure it's very powerful. Make sure you don't go there unprepared, and that means you should be wearing good "armor".
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.6: So, it is your turn to sell some wares, eh?
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.7: Feel free to come back if you need something else.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.0: Yes, ever since the day he came in our poor town, he started to demand things that we could not give to him. For the most part, we could not understand what it was he wanted, except maybe for this "stone"...
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.1: By Artherk! What have I done? Quickly, you must find the merchant! Can you help me get the stone back?
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.10: Yes that's it! You should start your search in Windhowl, far to the west. There you will find the merchant's guild. You can ask them where to find the "Nomad". Please hurry and get the stone back. Oh, and take this, you seem to need the gold more than I.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.11: That is what he calls himself. If you ask the merchant's guild about him, I am sure they will recognize the name.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.12: Alright then... the Heartstone is the heart of an ancient god named Lothar the Just. He was the god of Justice and the brother of our revered Artherk. It is written that millenia ago, a god named Gluriurl broke the Compact, which prompted a war between the "gods".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.13: Gluriurl, who understood the potential of the ancient race, made contact with an elven king, Makrsh P'Tangh, to whom he promised untold riches and power in exchange for a "service".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.14: The elven king was to erect a monument to our dear Artherk and lure him into its center, where a powerful ritual was taking place. Thousands of Elves died in the ceremony. After the ritual was complete, Artherk's essence was bound into a "physical" "body".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.15: Not much else is known about the Celestial War. However, other records indicate that when Lothar sacrificed his own life, it created a force strong enough to "bind" the essence of Gluriurl into his own Heart.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.16: It is believed that in the Heartstone lie the last remnants of the dead god. If the seal was to be broken, Gluriurl would return to life again! Do you remember when I told you about the Battle of Emanations? That was the last battle that occured because of this "seal".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.17: Recently, the stone has started to throb with energy. I don't know what Olin Haad's "true" "intentions" are, but something must be done to prevent Gluriurl from coming back to life. If he were to live again, the world would suffer greatly from his thirst for vengeance.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.18: He bound their essence inside his necklace... He is trying to use this as leverage to force me into revealing the location of the burial grounds of Lothar. My poor Aly! As much as I want to save her, Artherk would never allow me to do such a thing. It would mean the end of everything! We must "stop" the dog at all costs!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.19: As I said before, I received a letter from the king that explained Olin Haad's deception. The necromancer never stopped the Corrupters of Gluriurl as he was hired to do... he's actually a "part" of them!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.2: One day, I was cleaning the cellar of the church when I happened upon an old stone that looked somewhat out of place. I eventually sold it to a nice "merchant" for a fair price. Two days later, the "necromancer" came bearing a letter from the king that said he was entitled to the stone.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.20: Do you remember when I told you that the Corrupters were a fanatic cult of Gluriurl and that the king thought they were the survivors from the Battle of Emanations? It has been confirmed that Olin Haad was a "Harvester" of Life in this battle.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.21: The sole purpose of a Harvester is to bring the dead god Gluriurl back to life. They believe that once they achieve this, one of them will be chosen to rule over Althea. To dupe them into thinking this way, the dead god's heart gives them the "illusion" of power.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.22: He gives them what they call the Gift of Corruption. It supposedly nourishes the desire to revive dead god, while giving them considerable power. I used to believe that it was impossible for a mere mortal to fight against a for like this until just "recently".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.23: When I sent you to retrieve the Darkstone and the Skull of Gluriurl, I thought that the only way to stop the Harvesters was to gather the components for the ritual and hide them, but I was "wrong".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.24: In one of my books on the Battle of Emanations, I read that the alliance used a mighty blade called Caledbolg to defeat the Harvesters. I also found out that Artherk has blessed us by giving you the only thing that can give us access to where the sword lays... the "Heart" "of" "Artherk".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.25: Efnisien is the guardian of the entrance to Lothar's temple, but the necromancer doesn't know that. You should go now and find that blade. Caledbolg is kept safe in a shrine in the southeast part of the desert on Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.26: My name is Gunthar, but you may call me father Gunthar.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.27: Yes, that is my name, although you may call me father Gunthar, child.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.28: I am the High Priest of this town. My duties mostly involve teaching the priests, as well as an occasional sermon or two.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.29: Go with Artherk's blessing, my child.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.3: The merchant... he was a nice man. He came to our church to pay homage to our lord Artherk while he was in town. That is when he saw the stone... He offered me gold coins and a ruby rod of foreign design for it and... "wait"!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.4: Now that I think about it... the merchant asked me something that I found odd at the time. He asked me if anyone had asked for the Heartstone before, but I told him no, and that he was the first. But when the "necromancer" came with his letter from the king, he also called it the Heartstone.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.5: May Artherk shield me from the influence of that vile spawn of wickedness. Our king, for reasons known only to him, hired this creature of darkness to stop a group of cultists called the "Corrupters" "of" "Gluriurl". Supposedly, the king promised him the stone if he could manage to get rid of the cultists.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.6: The Corrupters are believed to be a fanatic cult that worships a forgotten god called Gluriurl. The king believes that they are the survivors of an ancient battle that occured a century ago... the "Battle" "of" "Emanations".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.7: The Dragons, who were less in number than their enemies, lost nearly two thirds of their kin. Those Seraphs that were allied to the Dragons perished, and the Harvesters of Life were "completely" annihilated, or so it was thought.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.8: It is only recently, after a series of gruesome events, that "Theodore" "XIII" discovered that not all of the Harvesters were destroyed in the battle. The survivors passed down their arcane knowledge to others and they eventually created the Cult of Gluriurl.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.9: I do not know why the king would hire a necromancer to dispose of the cult, but I believe the answers are somehow linked to this "Heartstone"...
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar2.0: Hurry! You must bring the stone to Olin Haad before it's too late!
npc.topic.humandrunk.0: zZzz.. Heh? Ah... Er... zzzZzZZzz... Zzz...

npc.topic.iagocaballero.0: What can I do for you, %s?
npc.topic.iagocaballero.1: Yes? If you need me to "heal", you simply have to ask.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.10: I see that you have heard of this evil lady before. Do not ever trust her for she is a very manipulative person gifted with a skill for lies and deceits. The local thieves are known to be her allies.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.11: You could say that Baldric Silverknife is the thieves' leader in "Raven's" "Dust" but "Shadeen" doesn't trust him as he shares a mentality similar to hers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.12: Ghundarg Rumblefoot is the orc leader. You should do best to not underestimate his shamanic powers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.13: Bane Blackblood is a shadowy person blinded by his lust for power. He wishes the throne
npc.topic.iagocaballero.14: King Theodore XIIIth is the current ruler of the Kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.15: The Kingdom of Goldmoon regroups the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.18: Silversky is the small town located in the south-eastern part of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.19: Arakas is the island located north of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.2: I am Iago Caballero, paladin of the God of "Healing" and Mending, "Artherk".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.20: Raven's Dust is the island's name.
