npc.topic.iagocaballero.21: Kalir and Jamir are often wandering in the desert. Quite frankly, I do not have a clue how they do it or why.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.22: Althea is the name of the world in which you are.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.23: I am sorry but I cannot answer this question of yours.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.24: Such foul words coming out of your mouth shows how much politeness you lack.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.25: Farewell, %s. Follow the path of Light and ye shall be protected.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.3: I follow the path set by my God, "Artherk". I spread seeds of righteousness throughout the realm, hoping to purify the sins done by other humans.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.4: Our God, "Artherk", has not yet answered my holy prayers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.5: Artherk is the God of "Healing" and Mending. It is He who I pray to light my path and protect me of the influence of "evil".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.6: "Shadeen" is one evil woman. If you happen to see her, do not follow her orders for it will be your downfall into the path of sins.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.7: Ah ha! You have heard of us! Yes, I am such a champion, and there are many more that walk this land, and other lands in the west. If you seek to become one of us, I suggest you do only good deeds, then swear fealty to our righteous cause.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.8: So you truly desire this? Then speak to Chamberlain Thomar, he shall help you.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.9: Zhakar, despite his odd manners, is a wizard who follows the Path of Light.
npc.topic.idas.1: I am one of the knights of "Silversky".
npc.topic.idas.2: Like Edden, my duty is to "guard" the entrance to the castle.
npc.topic.idas.3: Contrary to Edden here, I think the city should be closer to the castle.
npc.topic.idas.4: I must say it gets quite tiresome sometimes. I think I am getting too old for this.
npc.topic.idas.5: Although much younger than me, I still consider him a good friend.
npc.topic.idas.7: Yes, I know this thief very well. Caught him red-handed, once, but he managed to escape me, that fox! He's caused a great deal of trouble in these parts, especially when he meddled with the lonely wives of many honest men. *hmpf* We don't like his kind around here, so I hope you're no friend of his.
npc.topic.idas.8: I have not seen anyone suspicious. Even if I did, he would probably be in the dungeon right now.
npc.topic.idas.9: So %s, you want to give a shot at the lottery game Edden and I play? It's quite simple, really. You tell me the number you wish to "pick" and give me 1000 gold pieces. Then, I'll pick a number out of this bag. If you have the same number, you'll win. Then, I'll put that number back in the bag and I'll do this 4 more times! This means you can win up to five times! Surely you don't want to lose the opportunity to be a rich man or woman.Heh! Heh! Oh, and by the way, the number you choose has to be between 1 and 12.
npc.topic.iraltok.0: I have the unending task of collecting knowledge and transcribing it to books so that others may later "learn" from them.
npc.topic.iraltok.1: Arcane scribes such as myself use "runic" "scripting" "kits" in order to create "blank" "magic" "scrolls" that are later used to inscribe powerful magics.
npc.topic.iraltok.10: Urtanar is a great place. Many say it is the greatest tower of magic.  I was trained there and learned much about the ways of "magic". Even "Uranos" was once an apprentice there. Urtanar is in the middle of a great continent southwest of here. Perhaps one day you will be able to travel there.
npc.topic.iraltok.11: I'm always happy to help an initiate with his spells. There are several "spells" I can teach you.
npc.topic.iraltok.12: Yes, I would be glad to teach you a spell or two.
npc.topic.iraltok.13: Uranos is one of the greatest wizards in the kingdom of "Goldmoon".  He is also the oldest.
npc.topic.iraltok.14: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping the islands of Arakas, which is the one you are currently on, and Raven's Dust, where the king's castle is.
npc.topic.iraltok.15: Yes, we have hundreds of them in our "library". In fact, we have so many we cannot count them all.
npc.topic.iraltok.16: It is located in the northwest corner of the tower.
npc.topic.iraltok.2: In order to create such a kit, I need a pouch of yellow powder, a vial of spider venom, a flask of goblin blood, a diamond, and a feather. I ask a modest fee of 1,000 gold pieces to make the kit for you. Please gather all I need and mention "make" "runic" "kit" when you're all set.
npc.topic.iraltok.3: I cannot make such scrolls myself, but I heard that some wizards in Windhowl could help you with this.
npc.topic.iraltok.5: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.iraltok.6: I am known as Iraltok, mage of "Urtanar", and the seeker of "knowledge".
npc.topic.iraltok.7: My task is as endless as time itself. I seek all "knowledge" and transcribe it into "books".
npc.topic.iroualknowall.0: I am Iroual Knowall and I know just about everything there is to know about "drinks", my friend!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.1: I am the barman and innkeeper of the Drunken Dragon's Inn. It's a very fine tavern, to say the least. I've been its owner for more than twenty years now! But where are my manners? Would you like a "drink"? We've got the very best ale in the whole town!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.iroualknowall.3: Oh, I don't know for sure if she's dead or alive, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.iroualknowall.4: It's the best I tell ya!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.5: For 100 GP, I'll tell you about your karma. That comes with a good meal, so it's not a total waste. Will you pay?
npc.topic.iroualknowall.6: Here at the Drunken Dragon's Inn, we have the best ale in all of "Goldmoon". The king himself gets his supplies from here!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.7: Are you some kind of traveler? if you want to know about Goldmoon, just ask people about it. I don't have time to answer questions now.
npc.topic.isulgur.0: My name is Isulgur. I "work" for the town's "Lord".
npc.topic.isulgur.1: I work for Kirlor, the "lord" of Lighthaven. Since the "brigands" started attacking the "merchants", we have been very busy here at the "lord"'s office.
npc.topic.isulgur.10: Theodore's father was King Theopold. A great king indeed, he united all the villages of the land of "Goldmoon" to fight against the ever growing hordes of goblins. His leadership led to a legendary victory and brought peace throughout the land. Ever since Theodore gained the throne two years ago, things have been taking a turn for the worse. The goblins have begun making slow progress and the King is doing nothing about it.
npc.topic.isulgur.11: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.isulgur.12: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.isulgur.16: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.isulgur.17: To help a merchant travel across the forest, all you have to do is register at the "Lord"'s office.
npc.topic.isulgur.18: The westernmost town on the island, Windhowl is the greatest in the kingdom. Still, be careful if you go there, "brigands" and strange creatures roam around the outskirts, ambushing wanderers.
npc.topic.isulgur.19: They have been regrouping lately and they are attacking our merchants every time they try to pass through the forest. I wish someone would stop them. They are ruining us!
npc.topic.isulgur.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.isulgur.4: Kirlor is the first and only lord this town has ever had. I'd have to say he has done a fine job up until now. The problem is that ever since "Theodore" XIII won the title of king of "Goldmoon", things have been going pretty bad around here, especially for the "merchants".
npc.topic.isulgur.5: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.isulgur.6: Raven's Dust is the island on which the castle of "Theodore" XIII is located.  Travel southward from "Arakas" to find it.
npc.topic.isulgur.7: That is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.isulgur.8: Yes, Theodore XIII.  If you ask me, he isn't half the king his "father" used to be. He's so lazy, nothing ever gets done right around here. I heard things are getting pretty bad with the "goblin" invasion of "Windhowl", and having a sleepy king is no help, let me tell you!
npc.topic.isulgur.9: Goblin legions are massed in the mountains at the northwest corner of the island. "Windhowl" is the only defense standing between us and them.
npc.topic.jagarkar.0: I am Jagar Kar. I help people to "learn" new skills. My assistant and I have trained each and every one of the town's guards. I was even a personal guard of "Theopold" in my younger days. I have come here to "teach" people how to fight the "goblins".
npc.topic.jagarkar.1: Oh, I don't know if she's dead or alive for sure, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.jagarkar.10: I don't seem to have as much time as I used to so I won't be able to train you in the use of your new skills. You can talk to my assistant though, I'm sure he'll be glad to help you.
npc.topic.jagarkar.11: I am here to "teach" people how to become fierce fighters. I must say, humbly, that I am great at it! Better yet, I am amazing, no uh, incredible! Err no that's not it, oh well... Anyway, you get the picture. There simply is no better teacher around here.
npc.topic.jagarkar.12: Go make use of those new skills and kill some damned goblins!
npc.topic.jagarkar.2: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.jagarkar.3: Oy! He's one of the finest warriors around. A tough fellow, that Ortanalas. He can work for hours without getting bored! Sometimes, I even give him the pleasure and honor of doing my laundry, shining my armor and weapons collection, and he still has a bright smile on his face after that. Never heard a word of complaint out of his mouth. I tell ya, good ones like him are hard to find, nowadays.
npc.topic.jagarkar.4: If I wasn't so busy training guardsmen, I would be out there crushing as many as I could! One day I'm going to charge right into "Righul"'s mountain, and show them my way of thinking.
npc.topic.jagarkar.5: Righul's mountain is where the goblins hide.  It's a very dangerous place for a normal fellow.  Swarms of goblins live there. Oy! But it's like a child's playground for me! Goblins are hardly a match for my superior battle skills!
npc.topic.jagarkar.6: Ahh, a great king he was. The greatest, no doubt. He didn't wimp out from a fight like his coward of a son, Theodore. He once went alone against a troll warband and came out victorious. He personally led the assault against the goblins, and he even fought in the front lines. His son must have inherited some goblin blood or something, because he is nothing like his father!
npc.topic.jagarkar.7: I indeed have a few Nightswords, but they're not for sale. I'll trade you for a "Sword" "of" "Fury", if you can find one. Some elite goblin warlords own one, so with some luck, who knows...
npc.topic.jagarkar.8: I'd gladly give you a Nightsword in exchange for a Sword of Fury. Do you have one to trade?
npc.topic.jalus.0: I am Jalus. Pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.jalus.1: Nice "field", isn't it? I take care of it and make sure everything will be all right for the next day!
npc.topic.jalus.2: Everybody has to "eat", right? Well, I've never met someone who didn't have to. That would be pretty handy in the "desert".
npc.topic.jalus.3: There are no deserts on Arakas, so you don't have to worry about that.
npc.topic.jalus.4: Is the day almost over already? My eyes aren't what they used to be. I usually know that night has come when I start feeling "hungry".
npc.topic.jalus.5: I heard there is a giant cow somewhere in this realm. If you ever get lucky enough to catch a glimpse of it, please let me know! How I would love to bite down on a nice, juicy steak right now.
npc.topic.jalus.6: Poor me, I never thought I would go blind some day. Now I know it won't be long. Nevertheless, I know that even blind I could tend to my crops as an "expert" would.
npc.topic.jalus.7: You can only reach the level of expertise that I have after many years of work.
npc.topic.jalus.9: I don't know that woman. Sorry I couldn't help you.
npc.topic.jamar.10: I have not seen anyone like that.
npc.topic.jamar.3: He is still in the desert somewhere, lagging behind as usual.
npc.topic.jamar.4: Well, I feel more alive when I am walking under the desert sun.
npc.topic.jamar.5: If you would like to give me something, just type "give <item name>" and that should do it. For instance, if you would like to give me, say, a letter, you should say "give letter".
npc.topic.jamar.6: Oh, a letter from Kalir?? Thank you! I was getting a little worried about him. This letter says where he is, so I can join him a little later. Thanks for bringing it here. Please take this letter to him so he knows where to meet me...
npc.topic.jamar.7: Hm? No, I don't have such a key. It's Kalir who's got it, sorry...
npc.topic.jamar.8: The desert west of here is not one to be taken lightly.
npc.topic.jamar.9: Kalir and I have been friends for many years now.
npc.topic.jarko.0: The name is the Great Jarko to you and it will be the last you will ever hear if you attempt to thwart my "plans" of conquest. With this "spellbook" in my hand, nothing shall stand in my way, not even "Makrsh" "P'Tangh" and especially not you.
npc.topic.jarko.1: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.jarko.10: It is not of your business to know what I do. But you shall know in time.
npc.topic.jarko.11: The goblins and the undead minions are nothing but my war toys. They can be easily replaced if they are defeated. By my grandfather's rotting leg, if one goblin dies, I can even channel a small portion of my magical energy and animate his lifeless body. Nothing can stop me! Ha ha ha!!
npc.topic.jarko.12: The island of Arakas is part of the kingdom of Goldmoon and it is ruled by King Theodore. They say he is weak, but I say he is intelligent enough not to cross my path by sending his armies against mine. Only the "druids" dare to challenge me.
npc.topic.jarko.13: Lighthaven is able to repel my goblins but still, it has problems with the minor undeads that are raising from their own cemetary.
npc.topic.jarko.14: I can assure you that this town will fall into my hands in no time.
npc.topic.jarko.15: "Araknor" once tried to wrest the spellbook of necromancy from me, but failed miserably. Would you like to have it and all the powers that are kept within these pages?
npc.topic.jarko.16: My sources tell me that the Stone of Life has been stolen from the druids. By the rotten leg of my grandfather, I must have it! I MUST! Find it and bring it back to me in time, and I shall reward you greatly!
npc.topic.jarko.17: If you get killed on your way back, do not worry, I have a job for you. Ha ha ha!
npc.topic.jarko.2: Who is she? Bah! I have no time for such nonsense!
npc.topic.jarko.3: Araknor might practice the same dark art as I do, but he really is no match for my powerful magic. In fact, he can barely fight one of my goblins. Some day, he is bound to make a mistake that will cost him his life, and then I shall enslave him as one of my undead minions.
npc.topic.jarko.4: Mhorgwloth the troll lives in the ruined Castle of Orkanis north of these mountains. He usually does not bother my "goblins" much, unless they attempt to enter his domain.
npc.topic.jarko.5: The Lich Makrsh P'Tangh is said to have been cursed--or blessed--during one of the "comings", I do not quite remember which one nor do I really care. It is said that he was once an Elven prince who now rules as the Prince of Darkness. Pah! I am sure he is no match for my magic!
npc.topic.jarko.6: The Oracle claims it has seen a vision and that the Fourth Coming is finally at hand and humans will be judged for their misdeeds. It does not cause me much concern because I intend to be powerful enough to be *THE* judge.
npc.topic.jarko.7: It was a good move to recruit the Orc Leader. He is able to lead my armies to great victories even though the "goblins" despise him.
npc.topic.jarko.8: The druids are located on the northeastern part of the island. Their magical powers are the only threat to my "plans". I would be highly interested in studying the "source" of their power.
npc.topic.jarko.9: According to the reports I have received from my goblin spy, the druids apparently worship a "stone" "of" "life", which is an ordinary stone in which they have poured life, hence its name.
npc.topic.jeremiah.1: Personally, I think it's a wonderful name.
npc.topic.jeremiah.2: Hah! You want to know what I do for a living? Then I'll tell you! I travel the world over in search of whatever is "worth" searching for! Sounds interesting? It is, let me tell you my friend!
npc.topic.jeremiah.3: Well, part of my work is to bring back the details of my findings and explorations to "Menark". He can then scribe all my notes into books that are available to everyone.
npc.topic.jeremiah.4: He is getting too old to travel, so all he does is write into those books there. I suppose I should be grateful because it leaves all the travelling to me!
npc.topic.jeremiah.5: Hmm, now that you mention it, I have noticed a strange individual searching through the records awhile ago. I didn't really pay him much heed, seeing as he was very polite upon entering and leaving the grounds.
npc.topic.jeremiah.6: The books you see all around you were all written by Menark. I can't imagine reading all of them, let alone writing them. Menark is very courageous, in his own way.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.1: I am Jon Hamhoo, your humble servant.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.10: It is rumored that Blackblood has a daughter.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.11: Zhakar? He is the old mage who lives secluded in his tower.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.12: That's not a smart thing to say to a man holding a butcher's knife.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.13: Fine! I have still have work to do.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.2: I am the royal cook. I am the one who has to cook all the meals for the entire castle. Not to mention about King "Theodore"'s insatiable appetite. My occupation is not an easy one as you see. Especially during the day, I never have a moment to myself.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.3: Yeah, we made this cake for His Majesty's forty-fifth birthday. It was a *huge* cake, and through a really "odd story", it turned out to be put into the cake and was found by someone...
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.4: Well, it went like this... The king's youngest son, Theokrat, found the key in his father's apartments... Sort of took it without permission. Anyway, as he was wandering in the castle's corridors, he chanced upon a group of thieves who had snuck inside the castle to steal expensive tapestries... But you don't care to hear "the rest", do you?
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.5: Ah, well, as you wish... In any case, the thieves saw the young prince and started running after him. Fortunately, His Highness knew the castle well and managed to evade them, but not before losing the key somewhere along the way in the castle's dungeons. It was found some time after by a wandering atrocity that had dug its way into the dungeons. Want to hear "more"?
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.6: I wonder where King Theodore stores all the food he eats. He always sleeps, but somehow always seems to find time to eat my meals.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.7: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.8: It doesn't look quite like your usually peaceful forest.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.9: I never went in the desert nor do I want to.
npc.topic.julian.0: My name is Julian. Are you surprised I knew your name? Why, who has not heard of the one that slew the great Shadeen?
npc.topic.julian.1: I live in a small house not far to the northeast. I am to spy on the townsfolk and report any important events to my "master".
npc.topic.julian.10: I'll have nothing to do with someone as ill-mannered as you.
npc.topic.julian.11: Very well, until we meet again.
npc.topic.julian.2: I cannot reveal his name to you... but I can tell you where to find him. He lives within a natural fortress of mountains to the north. Seek him out, and perhaps he will deem you worthy of the knowledge of his name.
npc.topic.julian.3: You can find some spider venom on the giant black widows and necrospiders far to the east of this town.
npc.topic.julian.4: The arachnofiends sometimes carry these. You can find them far to the east of here.
npc.topic.julian.5: I believe there is a shaman in one of the skraug villages that sells these, but I cannot say precisely which.
npc.topic.julian.6: You have found the Blood of Ogrimar? Splendid! Well, just remember that I helped you get it, heh heh.
npc.topic.julian.7: Ahh, the Bones of Ogrimar, yes. Did my master send you to look for them?
npc.topic.julian.8: There is a complex maze of caves under the northeast part of Stoneheim. Inside one of these caverns rest the Bones of Ogrimar. The "entrance" to this cave is but one amongst many.
npc.topic.julian.9: There was once a man called Venadar who was believed to be successful in finding the Bones of Ogrimar. This man, a giant among men, was a good friend of the one called Khimtesar. One day while walking outside the house of his friend after a meal, Venadar fell into an unseen hole that opened up to a huge cavern in the ground. Being very tall, he was able to climb back out of the hole and trace his steps back to the well behind Khimtesar's house. Some say he inscribed this information on the well itself. Afterwards, he returned to the hole in the ground and explored it for days, after which he found the bones. Very few know of this and even fewer know what happened to Venadar afterwards. Remember this story when you look for the entrance, and you will succeed.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.0: My name is Jurnistakr Kira. Greetings to you.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.1: I bear the title of Archbishop of "Artherk".
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.2: But Balork's dead... Isn't he? No?!? Heavens!
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.3: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.4: Artherk is without a doubt the greatest of all the gods. I follow his ways faithfully and will certainly continue to do so until my life's end. Because of the importance of my work and the "responsibilities" I carry, I do not have much time to answer your questions. I will therefore ask that you be brief.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.5: The duty of an archbishop is to help troops in combat. I must accompany the soldiers and follow closely behind during battle against the evil "goblin" army. The wounded are brought to me and I do my best to get them back into the fray or to make sure they can survive the trip back home.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.6: Not many towns are as lucky as we are to have an army capable of resisting the continuous onslaught of goblins.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.7: I am but one of many who have chosen to use their healing spells for the greater good of civilization. If you wish to help further the ambitions of the church, a small "donation" of 200 gold will be rewarded with the healing of your wounds.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.8: I see, you are interested in helping us with our cause? Well if you have enough money to pay, I will heal your wounds without further delay. Do you still wish to be healed?
npc.topic.kahplethguard1.0: The skraung guard glares at you and you quickly wish you were somewhere else.
npc.topic.kahplethguard2.0: The skraug guard glares at you and you quickly wish you were somewhere else.
npc.topic.kalastor.0: My name is Kalastor, but don't tell anybody. If you don't keep it a "secret", you'll soon find yourself without a purse.
npc.topic.kalastor.1: Yes, that's my name. You're pretty sharp, aren't you?
npc.topic.kalastor.10: Ah, well then, it appears you wish to take part in the darker side of the world. That's great news, really. Welcome to the world of fame and fortune! There's a lot of stuff going on in this town, but we don't "trust" you yet, so you'll have to do "earn" it by doing "missions" for us.
npc.topic.kalastor.11: What do I look like to you, an employment center? I don't give work to people who aren't members of the Shadow Guild. Go away.
npc.topic.kalastor.12: Edgar? Edgar Gimplestratten? A pain in the back, if y'ask me. He owes me a lot of money. I work my @$$ off for him and what do I get? Rejection! Scorn! I tell you, this world is all upside down!
npc.topic.kalastor.13: Just tell him my "name" and that you're there to collect the protection fee he owes me. Then come back and tell me all about it.
npc.topic.kalastor.14: I have nothing to teach you.
npc.topic.kalastor.15: What, you would think we're gullible enough to trust you just like that? No, we will test your resolve before we tell you more about who's who, and what's going on.
npc.topic.kalastor.16: You don't know much about geography, do you? It's the other island that makes the Kingdom of Goldmoon, ruled by our <cough> beloved <cough> King "Theodore" "XIII".
npc.topic.kalastor.17: Aaah, what a <cough> GREAT <choke> King we have, wouldn't you say? But I can't complain. If he didn't spend his time sleeping, boozing and womanizing, I'd be out of a job. *grin*
npc.topic.kalastor.18: You want to know more about the Shadow Guild? Perhaps you do, and perhaps you don't... At the very least, I can tell you it's a guild of thieves... and more.
npc.topic.kalastor.19: Well, yes, actually I just stole your purse! Do you want it back?
npc.topic.kalastor.2: I am an apprentice "thief". I could show you how to rob someone later if you like. All you have to do is close your eyes and open your purse while you ask for training.
npc.topic.kalastor.20: Don't tell him I told you his name.
npc.topic.kalastor.21: I do not have the skills necessary to teach you anything.
npc.topic.kalastor.23: We're just friends, okay? So don't give me these looks! Sheez... Some people are just busybodies...
npc.topic.kalastor.24: Uh huh. Awesome use of the language. Care to try again?
npc.topic.kalastor.25: Next time, bring more gold! Just kidding. *smile*
npc.topic.kalastor.3: I don't know where she is.
npc.topic.kalastor.4: So you killed him? Good for you, too bad for the rest of us. S'okay, though, he'll come back to life in a little while. His corporeal form regenerates over time, so it's not like you did any permanent damage.
npc.topic.kalastor.5: There's indeed a great evil that walks the land, but personally, I'd prefer to stay away from it, like... *cough* like honest folks do.
npc.topic.kalastor.6: Ugly, fast and very powerful. If you're gonna go fight them, make sure you're loaded up with healing potions.
npc.topic.kalastor.7: Yes, my master calls himself "Shadow" Stalker. He never told me his real name.
npc.topic.kalastor.8: They live west from here, between here and Windhowl. They won't know who you are, so they may attack you. Don't mess with them, they're mean and tough.
npc.topic.kalastor.9: Yes, my master has taught me the ways of "robbing" and the like. I'm also quite adept at dodging, and I could probably "train" you in that field, seeing as it is very useful for a thief. Heh heh.
npc.topic.kalir.0: *huff* Forgive my... exhaustion. *puff* I am Kalir.
npc.topic.kalir.1: No, I'm sorry, I don't have such a key. I think you should ask my friend "Jamar".
npc.topic.kalir.10: Jamar would be a good friend... *gasp* if he didn't always leave me behind.
npc.topic.kalir.11: I doubt there are many people that wander into the desert *gasp* just for the pleasure of it.
npc.topic.kalir.2: If you would like to give me something, just type "give" "<item name>" and that should do it. For instance, if you would like to give me, say, a letter, you should say "give" "letter".
npc.topic.kalir.3: What?!? Jamar wrote back! Fantastic! *gasp* Now I know where we can meet again! Thank you for all the help! Hrmm. I think you wanted something from me before I've sent you on this errand... now... *gasp* What was it? Something about a key...? *pant*
npc.topic.kalir.6: Well, "Jamar" has abandonned me *pant* as usual, so I am trying to catch up to him. *gasp*
npc.topic.kalir.7: He has... probably already made it *huff* into the "town".
npc.topic.kalir.8: Why, yes *pant* the town of Silversky... *huff* *puff* you must have seen it already.
npc.topic.kalir.9: The sun is very hot and bright here... *pant* *pant* It is dangerous just to sit around if you are not adequately dressed. *puff*
npc.topic.karahn.0: I am known throughout these parts as Karahn.
npc.topic.karahn.2: I travel the countryside selling my "wares".
npc.topic.karahn.3: Why, I deal in "weapons" of high quality! Would you like to take a look at them?
npc.topic.karahn.4: You want to see what I have to sell, is that it?
npc.topic.karahn.5: I have some of the best weapons you can find on this island. There's only one other who can boast that he has better wares, and that's "Seban" "Forgelot".
npc.topic.karahn.6: As much as it pains me to say, he probably has the best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Mind you, I'm not saying they are going to be cheap!
npc.topic.karahn.7: Hmm, I suppose I could take a peek to see if there's something I want.
npc.topic.karahn.8: Come back if you need anything else.
npc.topic.karl.0: My name is Karl and I am rather "busy" now.
npc.topic.karl.1: I am the assistant trainer. I help Sir "Arganor" with his work. It is a tiring job, but I manage. If you're here to "train" your attack skills, you've come to the right place.
npc.topic.karl.3: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.karl.5: What a great man! His swordsmanship is unmatched in the realm. He has already won many tournaments across the "land".
npc.topic.karl.6: The world is a large place indeed, my friend. I haven't traveled much of it myself, but I hope to change that someday.
npc.topic.karl.7: He is the other assistant. A good lad with a big heart, his only flaw is his bad temper. I have known him for years now, and although we both like to work here, we are getting very tired of it.
npc.topic.kavarian.0: My name is Kavarian the Unseen.
npc.topic.kavarian.1: Yes, I am Kavarian the Unseen. My knowledge of the "arts" has allowed me to become invisible to the naked eye.
npc.topic.kavarian.10: The major combat sense spell greatly augments the recipient's fighting abilities. You are required to have knowledge of the minor combat sense spell to learn it.
npc.topic.kavarian.11: The invisibility spell renders the caster completely invisible to the naked eye. The caster will still be visible to someone with the detect invisible spell cast upon them, however. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the detect invisible spell.
npc.topic.kavarian.2: I have been studying the art of spellcraft for a very long time now. Ever since I was but a small boy, my path in life has always been that of the "wizard".
npc.topic.kavarian.3: The path of the wizard is a hard one to follow, but in the end all the hard work pays off.
npc.topic.kavarian.4: Well, my long "research" has taught me the ability to alter my physical appearance in such a way that I blend into my surroundings, rendering me nearly invisible. Only those with a certain enchantment can see me.
npc.topic.kavarian.5: I have long ago stopped working to pursue my own goals. As it happens, the "research" I have done has allowed me to make a great deal of profit. Consequently, there is little I cannot provide for myself in the way of material things.
npc.topic.kavarian.6: I have been conducting research in several fields of the mystic arts. Seeing as I am discovered, I see no harm in "teaching" you a few of my best spells.
npc.topic.kavarian.7: Hmm, this is a strange variety of spells, you will probably think, but they are all very potent spells nonetheless.
npc.topic.kavarian.8: The dispel spell will remove all negative spells that are anchored on the target, and will have a chance of remove some of the other spells also.
npc.topic.kavarian.9: The flare spell can inflict tremendous amounts of fire damage on a living target and may even set it on fire for a short period of time. You are required to have the rain of fire spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.kederic.0: I am known as Kederic Riverbane, "harvester" of the rains.
npc.topic.kederic.2: I harvest the powers and forces that flow in waters all around us.
npc.topic.kederic.3: I am here to protect the forest and all who inhabit it. I can also "teach" you a spell or two.
npc.topic.kederic.4: You're interested? In that case, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.kederic.5: So you seek the maleak plant? I believe there might be some in the nearby woods.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.0: My name is Khan Wulgworth. You may call me 'Your Honor' since I graduated in Law from the Corinthian Academy of Jurists.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.1: I trained to be a judge, but seeing all the corruption of human society convinced me to return to my folks and improve their lives.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.2: If you will help me, I might have a task for you. Have you ever heard of "Skraugbashor" "Maces"? If so,please kindly bring me as many as you can.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.4: Fare well, and be sure to stay away from my people.
npc.topic.khimtesar.0: Well then why are you here? I have much to do, you know.
npc.topic.khimtesar.1: I am known as Khimtesar, but you can call me old Kim.
npc.topic.khimtesar.2: That's right! You're a bright one aren't you?
npc.topic.khimtesar.3: I have not heard that name in a long time...
npc.topic.khimtesar.4: I am a scholar of the arcane art. I spend most of the time I have reading large tomes of magic.
npc.topic.khimtesar.5: I will not tolerate this kind of abusive language. I am taking half of your gold as punishment!
npc.topic.khimtesar.6: At last, I can return to my studies.
npc.topic.khimtesar.7: Ahh, so you come here seeking my help as a scholar of the magic arts, is that it? Very well then, I will teach you what my research has taught me. If you did not already know, there are currently seven destinations for the gateway spells. These are "Lighthaven" "gateway", "Windhowl" "gateway", "Druid's" "Point" "gateway", "Silversky" "gateway", "Wizard's" "Vale" "gateway", "Stonecrest" "gateway" and "Sunken" "Woods" "gateway". As a small note, the "Sunken" "Woods" "gateway" spell will bring you near this place. Now then, which spell would you like to learn?
npc.topic.kiadus.3: Would you like to take a look at what I have to offer?
npc.topic.kiadus.4: I'm sorry, friend, but you'll have to come back later when the sun is up.
npc.topic.kiadus.5: I haven't seen anyone out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.kiadus.6: Hmm, it would seem I have forgotten what her name is again. If you would give me another 2000 gold, I'm sure I would remember it again. So how about it?
npc.topic.kiadus.7: Sword? I'm sorry but I don't sell swords.
npc.topic.kiadus.8: Feel free to stop by anytime!
npc.topic.kilhiam.0: The High Priest? He had to leave to take care of some important matters. You should talk to Brother Kiran if you need more details.
npc.topic.kilhiam.1: People are nice around here. If you need to know someone's "name", just ask them. It's the same for their "work" too. Most of them will tell you without any complaints.
npc.topic.kilhiam.10: The Sanctuary is where your body and soul are restored by the Gem of Destiny if you have been killed. Do you wish to set the Temple of Lighthaven as your sanctuary?
npc.topic.kilhiam.2: Balork's brand is a terrible curse he bestows upon those foolish enough to dare challenge him.
npc.topic.kilhiam.3: Annabelle has a peculiar healing touch.
npc.topic.kilhiam.4: I'm a priestess of "Artherk". Sometimes I "teach" new spells to those I deem worthy of such responsibility. I'm not the only one doing this. There are many practitioners around the world which will teach you about almost any skill you can possibly think of. All you must do is choose a path, or several paths to take and try to find the people willing to aid you in those fields. Artherk has also blessed me with the Gift of "sanctuary".
npc.topic.kilhiam.5: Artherk is a wonderful god. If you have any questions, I will do my best to answer them. On the other hand, if you feel that the conversation is over and you have no need of anything else, you can always say "goodbye" and be on your way.
npc.topic.kilhiam.6: Priests are people who specialize in the art of healing and treating wounds and the like. This is achieved by the use of certain spells which deal with the elements of earth and water. Once you have learned these spells, you can always call upon their power to aid you. Unlike skills, spells need not be practiced and achieve full effectiveness as soon as you learn them. Because of this, the price to pay tends to be significantly higher than with skills. As you gain experience in battle, you will be able to increase your abilities as well as learn new skills and spells. If you wish, I can teach you one of the most basic spells available. It is the "light" spell, which will help you see in the darkness. Do you wish to learn it now?
npc.topic.kilhiam.7: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.kilhiam.8: Windhowl is located on the western side of the island.
npc.topic.kilhiam.9: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.0: I am Aedenas Gravesoul, revered King of the centaurs.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.1: I am king of the Centaurs. I have sworn to protect my people from the Kahp Leth skraugs.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.10: You are not ready to undertake the quest that will lead you to the Will of Artherk.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.11: You will need the ethereal key to use the ethereal portal. As for the location of the portal, I'm afraid that you're on your own as the portal is never located in the same place.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.12: You no longer need the staff of submission. Therefore, I shall take it back.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.13: If you want to defeat the red-eyed centaurs, you will need the "staff" "of" "submission" first.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.14: The staff of submission is a magical weapon that can knock unconscious the red-eyed centaurs without harming them more than necessary. If you can defeat twelve red-eyed centaurs using the staff of submission and bring me back the mind-control talismans, I shall help you further in your quest. Do you agree to help me?
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.15: Zion Thunderheart is my cousin and he is next in line for the centaur throne. He hungers for power and even went as far as spreading foul rumors about me in hope of gaining support.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.16: If you seek the Fangs of True Resolve, the White Crow can help you in your quest.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.17: You are a dishonor to your race.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.2: If you have time, I would look favorably upon your bringing me "Collector's" "Books" to add to my collection.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.3: He probably doesn't realize I know what he's been up to, but that's how it should be. I know he plots behind my back and I can make sure he doesn't get out of control. Keeps your friends close, I say, and your enemies even closer.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.4: Strong and reliable Kyathos. He's one of our best warriors and an excellent guard. When he patrols our town, I know everyone's safe.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.5: His manneris a little gruff, but he's one of the best smiths you can hope to find in the world. Be sure to drop by his shop, some day, and buy a few trinkets off him.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.6: Without Dionysus, ruling the Centaurs would be a far more daunting task than it currently is. His gentle words of wisdom, his vision and his compassion would make him an excellent king to succeed me when I depart, but I know he is dedicated to Artherk and would not want the position. That's why he would be perfect. *sigh* I wonder sometimes if there will be someone to follow in my footsteps when I'm gone...
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.7: I suspect he works in secret with Zion Thunderheart, but I have no proof.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.8: It seems the Windchasers have always been guardians of our town. They are a strong and proud lineage, and I couldn't imagine our clan without them to protect us.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.9: I think that he lives somewhere in Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.0: *yawn* I am not quite in the mood for some chit-chat.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.1: I am "King" "Theodore" the XIIIth, ruler of the Kingdom of "Goldmoon" and proud father of "Princess" "Delilah".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.10: Princess Delilah is my proud daughter. Although, I fear that she may have become too attached to her mentor, "Bishop" "Rikken" "Crowbanner". She cannot bear when he falls into sickness and spends her days in prayer for his recovery.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.13: Please, do not speak of Ghundarg Rumblefoot in my presence. I let "Mordrick" "Warstone" to deal with them, that is what he is paid for.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.14: *yawn* Yes, I have some of those. But, I don't see why one such as you would need one.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.15: How should know who could tan an animal's skin? I am the king, not the Oracle. But.. wait.. perhaps Samuel knows someone. Ask him on my behalf.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.16: Mordrick Warstone is the best knight in the realm. Perhaps you might want to step forward as a recruit into our army? If so, simply ask him.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.17: When my father passed away, a "tournament" took place and I, Theodore the XIIIth, was the sole survivor. Thus, I inherited of my father's title and became the "King" of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.18: Isn't a small town located somewhere in "Arakas"?
npc.topic.kingtheodore.19: Windhowl? I don't have a clue about what you're referring to.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.2: One should think that a King has nothing to do but it is quite the opposite. All day long, I have to isolate myself in my private quarters and think how I could improve the life of all the people in my "kingdom".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.20: Arakas is an island located north of Raven's Dust. It is also part of the kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.21: No one would want to go there and especially not me.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.22: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.23: Yes, this is my title. Or you may call me your "Highness".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.24: I am royally offended by such gross words! GUARDS! Bring this denizen to jail NOW!!!
npc.topic.kingtheodore.25: Our conversation has come to an end, I think it is time for a little nap.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.3: Indeed, I am King Theodore the XIIIth.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.4: Such impoliteness! If you must talk to me, do it using my rightful title!
npc.topic.kingtheodore.5: They are dead and gone. Ghosts do not exist.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.6: When father passed away, it was written that my twelve "brothers" and I had to fight to death. I shall spare you how bravely I fought my own brothers... but the bottom line is that I've won. Thus, I have been crowned "King" of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.7: King Theopold was my father and a good king. I must say that I am much like him and everybody in the kingdom is happy.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.8: This is such as great castle. It was built by my late father, "King" "Theopold".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.9: Yet another rebel who is jealous of my throne. He does not cause much of a threat to me.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.0: My name is Kirlor Dhul, Lord of Lighthaven. I "work" to help my citizens live a better life!
npc.topic.kirlordhul.1: My occupation is to collect taxes, serve our great "King" and protect the villagers of our humble town, although, we have had some "problems" with that lately.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.10: I heard it was a very bloody fight.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.11: Brigands have been banding together to attack our merchant carriers. Since I don't have many guards, I can't spare any of them to protect the merchants. I must keep them to "protect" the town against a sudden goblin invasion. Lord Sunrock is offering rewards for anyone who will help a merchant to deliver his report across the forest to our sister town, "Windhowl". Would you like to register?
npc.topic.kirlordhul.12: The path to Windhowl is home to many brigands and strange creatures, so be careful not to get ambushed.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.13: Many of them cannot afford to get plundered by roving bandits and will be grateful for the assistance. See "Rolph" or "Sigfried" if you want to help them with the report.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.16: Just ask any merchant about it and he will give you more details.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.17: Those guards are the best at their job. There isn't a monster who gets within bow-shot that doesn't get chased back to the mountains.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.18: Feel free to come back anytime.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.2: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.kirlordhul.4: Yes, our great King Theodore the "XIII"th.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.5: His story is a rather short one, and not too inspiring. When "Theopold" died, his 12 other sons all had to compete in a deadly "tournament".  The survivor would then inherit the kingdom. Surprisingly, Theodore was the only one to survive this lethal match. Rumor has it that the reason he survived was because he was sleeping when the tournament actually took place, although I have not been able to confirm this.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.6: Ahh! A great king indeed. He united all the villages of "Goldmoon" to fight against the ever-growing hordes of goblins. His leadership led to a legendary victory and kept peace throughout the land. Now that his son is on the throne, the situation is deteriorating at an alarming rate. Our forces are wearing thin and the last time I asked him what his plans were for the region, he told me that he would sleep on it!
npc.topic.kirlordhul.7: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the island of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.kirlordhul.8: That is the island on which the castle of Theodore is located. Head south of "Arakas" if you wish to find it.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.9: That is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.0: I go by the name of Kyathos Shatterskull.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.1: I am a guard and my duty is to ensure that no skraugs will ever invade our land again.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.2: I can't help you, stranger, but I'll tell you this: during your stay here in our town, you either walk a straight line, or you deal with me.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.3: You shouldn't associate with the likes of Thunderheart or Fatebringer. They're not people who work for the greater good.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.4: He's another guard, like me. Don't get in our way, we're busy people.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.5: See my weapons? See my armor? He made them. It cost me quite a bit, but I'm one of the best Centaur warriors you can find, thanks to his superior equipment.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.6: We all like Dionysus. Whenever there's a dispute that's too petty for the King to handle, Dionysus steps in and makes sure we're all treated fairly. We're indebted to him.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.7: Gladdius's not too worried about him, but I have reason to believe Malachai Fatebringer isn't always on our side, if you know what I mean. I suspect he's dabbling in dark powers, but no one believes me.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.8: He was once married and had a heir, but they became sick and died many years ago. Our poor king never really recovered and hasn't remarried. It was very tragic, really.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.0: I am a master smith. If you need some weapons or armors, "forged" or "improved", I'm your man. If not, might as well be on your way. *Mutter*
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.1: Will these questions ever end? You can call me Silversmith. Lance is my first name. *sigh*
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.10: Raven's Dust? Been there, done that... A quaint little island, although not much is ever happening there. *hrmph* A few monsters, evil sorcerers and thugs... Perhaps I can interest you in some of my wares...
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.11: Arakas, you say? *Cough* You... you're still looking for that island? Well, if you don't know where it is by now, then we really have no business together.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.12: The Sleeping King, we call him, but not in front of the guards. He's not really a bad king, he just doesn't do what a king should do. Think that's seditious? Blasted right it is! *Arumph* Problem with that? Didn't think so.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.13: Oh, wonderful, you've just discovered new words!
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.2: I can build special weapons or armors for you, if you provide me with the basic materials and components, and have the gold pieces to afford my services. I can create a "Blessed" "Chainmail", a "Gloomblade", or a "Demonblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.4: The Gloomblade is a weapon of darkness, one that I am loathe to make. But I have sworn to uphold the balance of this world, so I make good swords and evil swords. It's up to people to make appropriate use of them. I require a Scroll of Enchantment, a Nightsword, a Ring of Darkness and, of course, my usual fee of 10,000 gold pieces. When you have all this, ask me to "make" "gloomblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.6: Aah, a good choice... Building such an armor requires a Scroll of Enchantment, a Chainmail, and 5,500 gold pieces for my service. When you've got all these, come back and ask me to "make" "blessed" "chainmail".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.7: Lance Silversmith gives you a demonblade.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.8: The Demonblade is decidedly an evil weapon, but in order to do the greatest evil, it will serve both good or evil masters. I, however, only give it to evil individuals. I ask that you bring me a Scroll of Enchantment, a Chaos Sword, a Demon Skull, a Necklace of the Black Heart, and 8,000 gold pieces. Once you have gathered all this, ask me to "make" "demonblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.9: Thor Glarefire is a centaur blacksmith who taught me everything I know.
npc.topic.lantalir.0: Lantalir Rainmist is the name. I have the peculiar ability, for one so young as I am, to summon the rain with a single thought.
npc.topic.lantalir.1: I was an orphan, but Yrian raised me into the man I am now. He then recruited me into the "Order" "of" "Nature". Even though I am still an apprentice, I have grown in powers quite rapidly.My current work is to protect the forest from the "goblin"'s vicious attacks and various other "errands".
npc.topic.lantalir.10: Decades ago, the city was abandoned for reasons unknown and the main mountain entrance was sealed. The only way to reach it is to go through the "labyrinth".
npc.topic.lantalir.11: Lighthaven is a town located on the south eastern part of this island. Its sister town is named "Windhowl" and is located on the south western part.
npc.topic.lantalir.12: The inhabitants of Windhowl do not share our concerns for nature, they are much too busy doing business with Lighthaven and fighting brigands.
npc.topic.lantalir.13: The goblins are controlled by "Jarko" the necromancer and they are not bright enough to understand that if they do not stop the desecration of the forest at once, we will all perish. The "Forest" "Guardians" are doing a good job of eliminating them on sight, however.
npc.topic.lantalir.14: The Forest Guardians are trees that are able to walk. Do not attack them, they are our friends and they are very powerful.
npc.topic.lantalir.15: I am still an apprentice, but once I am a true disciple, I shall rightly earn the title of Druid.
npc.topic.lantalir.16: He is our leader and I consider him as my father. He is also the bearer of the "Stone" "of" "Life".
npc.topic.lantalir.17: The Stone of Life can drastically increase the strength of our elemental magic. "Yrian" "Earthsong" once allowed me to use its power to summon a rainstorm, but he made me stop it promptly, for it is not a good thing to tamper with the weather.
npc.topic.lantalir.18: Dunikus? Did you know that he can control winds? Really, I've seen him hovering a few feets above the ground. The air swirled about him like a small tornado.
npc.topic.lantalir.19: Jarko? Sorry, but I do not really want to talk about him.
npc.topic.lantalir.2: To meditate is to heal the soul. The art of meditation is a discipline that takes time to master. If you wish, I could "teach" you how to use it.
npc.topic.lantalir.20: The Order of Nature was created to preserve nature. We rarely rely on violence, for we do not wish harm to nobody. Sadly, it seems the only viable solution against foul creatures such as "goblins". The leader and founder of our order is "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.lantalir.21: The key is to protect nature, remember that my friend.
npc.topic.lantalir.3: Very good, let us begin then.
npc.topic.lantalir.4: Very good, then let us begin your training.
npc.topic.lantalir.6: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.lantalir.7: The book of Feylor? I am studying it right now, even though a few pages are missing or have crumbled to dust. It is very peculiar, it seems as if each time I read those pages, they disappear in front of my eyes. I can not explain this and yet... Oh well! *sigh*
npc.topic.lantalir.8: "Yrian" "Earthsong" always gives me many tasks to complete.
npc.topic.lantalir.9: I do not even know where the entrance is located exactly. However, I do know that it is required to go through it if one wants to reach the "Ruined" "City".
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.0: I am Laonian Rikarr. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.2: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.3: I wonder where she lives nowadays.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.4: Artherk is the god I worship, and the path he has set forth for me is undoubtedly a great one. I hope your destiny will be as good as mine, stranger. If you are in need of healing, you should ask Jurnis.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.5: I am rather busy at the moment, but I am sure Jurnis would have time for you.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.6: Come back when you are in need of help.
npc.topic.laren.0: My friends call me Laren. You look friendly enough so you can call me Laren too.
npc.topic.laren.2: I work in the "fields", but right now I'm taking it easy, if you know what I mean.
npc.topic.laren.3: It's damn tiring work I tell you, enough so that I'm really glad to come have a "drink" here at the end of the day.
npc.topic.laren.4: I don't know much about him, but I once overheard a conversation about him in a local inn. Seems like there was a romance between him and Adriana, but it turned bad. She doesn't talk about him, but maybe her assistant would know something. Why don't you try asking him?
npc.topic.laren.5: Heh, you here to have a drink too? That's good I suppose, I can use the company.
npc.topic.laren.6: You're not asking the right person for that kind of information, friend. I just sit here and drink.
npc.topic.laren.7: Maybe I'll see you later then.
npc.topic.leana.0: I am Leana, proud wife of the acclaimed "Drardos".
npc.topic.leana.2: I'm not really that proud to tell you the truth, but my husband only wants me to talk this way when we see potential customers.
npc.topic.leana.3: My husband is very proud of his business, a little too proud perhaps. We are not quite ready to open up shop yet, but once we are, you will be able to buy most of the antiques on display here.
npc.topic.leana.4: As soon as we are finished setting up the shop, we can start selling antiques.
npc.topic.leana.5: My husband believes he will have the best antiques store in the land. That should not be too difficult since there aren't any others around.
npc.topic.leana.6: I have been much too occupied to notice anyone out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.librarian1.0: The elves were the race Artherk cherished the most. He loved them like a father loves his children. The god of Corruption knew that to get to the god of Light, he would have to reach through the elves. He also knew that Artherk had fallen for an elven maiden and used this knowledge to design a ritual in which he could temporarily trap Artherk's essence inside a "physical" "body".
npc.topic.librarian1.1: The god of Corruption knew that even in a physical form, Artherk would prove stronger than any other mortal foe, but he would be no match against another god. He instilled the gift of sight on Oberon and forced him to foresee the coming of the Harbinger. Oberon, fearful for the fate of his people, made a deal with the god of Chaos, "Ogrimar", as instructed by Gluriurl.
npc.topic.librarian1.2: The gods of Chaos and Corruption conspired to rid the celestial realm of Artherk's presence. After receiving the gifts promised him by Ogrimar, Oberon, possessed by Gluriurl, attacked the god of Light in his physical form at the peak of the ritual. A great battle ensued during which Artherk was nearly defeated. Just as Gluriurl was about to strike the finishing blow, "Lothar" "the" "Just" appeared in the form of a great dragon of crimson scales and he slew Gluriurl, who had been weakened by the fight.
npc.topic.librarian1.3: The god of Justice sacrificed himself by imprisoning the essence of Gluriurl inside his own heart, releasing Oberon form its hold in the process. When the Harbinger came to punish the elves, Ogrimar "abandonned" them to their fate.
npc.topic.librarian1.4: Oberon was marked as a traitor to his race and the one responsible for the downfall of his people. He received the curse of unlife and became Makrsh P'Tangh, which means the Traitorous One in the ancient elven tongue. The elves were taken by Death save for a few of the wisest, who were imprisoned by the Harbinger into what is called the "Elvenweave", a beautiful and intricate tapestry created by Artherk himself.
npc.topic.librarian1.5: The tapestry depicts the majestic elven city that was buried by the human town of Lighthaven. Many believe that the ruins of Anwynn, the elven city, still lay beneath the human town. Some legends even say that deep inside one of its temples lies the "heart" of Lothar the Just.
npc.topic.librarian1.6: That's right. It is also said that should the heart be found and desecrated, Gluriurl could be brought back to life again.
npc.topic.librarian1.8: I gather information on the Celestial War and any other subject that is closely related to it.
npc.topic.librarian2.0: Despite the warnings, the elves continued to ignore the gods. When Death returned one thousand years later, the elves refused to repent and were nearly all destroyed. The Harbinger then went to see the dwarves and announced that they were now the chosen race. He also informed them of their new responsibilities and duties towards the gods, and the "consequences" of his next visit, should they fail in the task set before them.
npc.topic.librarian2.1: One thousand years later, the Harbinger returned to see the dwarves in what was now his third coming to the world of mortals. Very much impressed with the society the dwarves had evolved into, the Harbinger came to see them in his true form. The dwarves, confused by such a horrible apparition, attacked him thinking he was a demon from the deepest pits of hell. Death did not take this affront lightly and transformed the entire dwarven race into mindless atrocities, condemned to eternally roam the land as hideous creatures, shunned by all. He then left the dwawrves to their misery and sought out the "humans".
npc.topic.librarian2.2: The Harbinger told our ancestors that they were the chosen race. He told them about the proud elves and the bold dwarves and warned them about his next coming. Their task was to preserve the balance between good and evil, and remain steadfast in faith.
npc.topic.librarian2.4: I am doing research on the Harbinger and the influence he has had on our society.
npc.topic.librarian3.0: A Darkseed is a darkstone in its early stage of development planted on this plane of existence by the gods in order to give them a mortal body. The only Darkseed that is not known to have evolved into a darkstone is that of Ogrimar. If the ancient texts are to be believed, then one could quite possibly find Ogrimar somewhere on Althea.
npc.topic.librarian3.1: Even though Gluriurl didn't have time to absorb Artherk's essence, in the end the god of Light was still slain. It is now known that his essence has survived and returned to his own plane and answers our everyday prayers, but his heart remains in this land.
npc.topic.librarian3.2: As the darkest of all hearts, the heart of Gluriurl is the only one known to have retained some magical energies. This phenomenon gives uncertain proof that Gluriurl is not truly dead, but rather in some kind of slumber, awaiting to be brought back to life.
npc.topic.librarian3.3: Very little is known about the heart of Lothar. Legends say that it contains the bound essence of the dead god of "Corruption" but no one knows for certain.
npc.topic.librarian3.4: Yes, and it is also believed that should the heart be broken, Gluriurl would return to this land and exact revenge on all life.
npc.topic.librarian3.6: My main field of research is artifacts and relics of the past.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.0: You can call me the Lighthaven Samaritan.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.1: I just stay here all day and answer "questions" about this place. That's what I do.Perhaps I might send you on an "errand" if that is what you wish.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.10: The "page" command allows you to privately send a message to someone who is not nearby or with whom you want to have a private conversation in public, sort of like whispering. You simply type /<name> <text>, where <name> is the name of the person you want to talk to and <text> is the message you want this person to receive. If you do not want to receive pages, you can press <ESC> and toggle your page option to off.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.11: The "shout" command allows you to send public messages for everyone to read. You simply type :<text>, where <text> is the message you want to send to everyone. If you do not want to be disturbed by shouts, you can press <ESC> and toggle your shout option to off.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.12: If you're all right with the "basics" I've already explained, how about we now discuss some more serious topics, such as "spells", "skills", and "quests"? Or would you rather hear more about the "environment", the "world" and the "cities"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.13: The main thing you have to remember is that night and day follow each other in succession. When it's night, it's usually darker outside than during daytime. Sometimes, you need a "torch" to see around. That's especially true when you go inside "caves" and "dungeons".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.14: You can buy those at any merchant's store. They're pretty inexpensive, they don't weigh much, and you can bet you'll find them useful when you go into "caves" and "dungeons". You can sometimes find them in treasure chests.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.15: Caves and dungeons are dark, dangerous places. Dungeons, because they were man-built, occasionally have torches on the walls, so they tend to be lighter than caves. Caves, which exist because of some fluke of nature, are much darker. It would be foolish to enter them without a light source.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.16: This is the world of Althea, but I'm sure you already know that. You are in the Kingdom of Goldmoon, on the island of Arakas, one of the two islands of the kingdom. This is the city of "Lighthaven"; the other city southwest of here is "Windhowl".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.17: This is the town of Lighthaven. We live fairly quiet lives, but there has been a great deal of trouble lately, what with the goblins and undeads and orcs and demons and brigands and all these adventurers roaming about. Just ask other people here about these... You'll see. Anyway, if you want my advice, don't leave town unless you're trained and armed to the teeth, or you have someone to protect you.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.18: Windhowl is a larger town lying southwest from here. It takes a bit to get there, but the people are friendly enough. Lord Sunrock rules the town with an iron fist. If you go there, make sure to visit the Windhowl "Samaritan" and ask him a few questions.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.19: There's one like me in almost every city. Our job is to make life easier for you. Of course, if you want more information, you could always read the manual...
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.20: Cities are fairly safe. On the island of Arakas--where we are right now--you have only two cities: "Lighthaven" and "Windhowl". There are many more cities in the world beyond, but we don't have much to do with them.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.21: Magic is present in the world of Althea. Its nature is complex and I won't get into it, but suffice it to say that it is manipulated with "mana", the equivalent of an individual's magical strength and endurance. Spells can only be "learned" from certain "teachers", but only if the student is gifted enough and has already learned the "pre-requisites".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.22: Skills represent learned abilities which allow you to accomplish certain feats during the course of your adventures. They must be learned from a "teacher". Often, teachers will not train a student who does not have certain natural abilities ("stats") or has not reached a certain "level" of expertise.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.23: During the course of your adventures, several inhabitants of the world will ask you for assistance in return for certain rewards, whether it be gold, items or information. We refer to this as quests. Make sure you jot down a few notes when you embark on a quest, lest you never finish it and miss some important clue. Quests can either be "minor" or "major", depending on whether they have something to do with the over-arcing storyline or not.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.24: The 4th Coming is a complex tale, one which you will discover as you go along. Some of the missions you will undertake may have to do with the grand scheme behind the scenes; we call those major quests. Some other quests are just side tracks which you don't have to follow; we call those minor quests. They are not always necessary to further the plot, so you can ignore them if you prefer.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.25: Everyone has mana, but not everyone has enough of it or knows how to use it to weave magic. Those who do must spend a great deal of mana. Usually, the more mana is spent, the more powerful the spell. Mana is spent with every spell, but rest and potions can help regenerate it, just like physical damage ("hit" "points").
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.26: You don't know everything you need to know when you start adventuring. You'll quickly realize there are "skills" and "spells" that you need to learn, and you can only get that training from specific teachers living all over this island--and beyond.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.27: Yeah, you need those if you're to learn anything. Sure, you may think that because you can wield a sword you could train someone in using it too, but it's not that simple. You need to know what you're doing, so you need someone who's willing to "train" you. Most teachers will ask you for some money, however, so don't visit a potential tutor empty handed.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.28: We rate everyone according to a restricted number of values, named stats, which represent that person's strengths and weaknesses. Most starting stats range roughly between 10 and 20, but these values tend to go up with levels. You can see your stats by pressing <ctrl-s>.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.29: As you gain experience, your skills and stats go up. Your level will also go up. A level indicates how far along you've come and how generally powerful your character is.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many who walk the land and bear his mark.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.30: There are dozens of weapons in the game, some more powerful than others. The price is usually a good indication of their combat effectiveness, but not always, so don't rely on that. Try them out and you'll soon figure out which one allows you to do more damage in combat. Say, perhaps you'd like me to tell you a bit about "combat"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.31: Kind of like weapons, there are a good number of armors available; some are good, some are bad, and some are both good and bad for you. Check your stats carefully and you should quickly find out which ones protect you better. Say, perhaps you'd like me to tell you a bit about "combat"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.32: It's all pretty simple, really. You use a "weapon" to attack and wear "armor" to defend yourself. If the attacker's power is higher than your defenses (also called AC, for armor class), you may end up taking damage ("hit" "points", or HPs). If you lose all your HPs, you die. This isn't the tragic end, however, since you own a Gem of Destiny. That will take you back to the temple, where you can get healed and resume your journeys.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.33: Hit points measure how tough you are and how much punishment you can take before dying. The higher your level, the more hit points you tend to have. Endurance also plays a factor in the number of hit points you have. Hit points recover over time, but you can also use "healing" methods.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.34: Other than time, two things can heal you: spells and potions. Potions can be bought in shops or found in chests. Spells can be learned from a "teacher". You can also ask some priests to heal you. Some do it for free, some do it for money.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.35: You start with some items in your backpack (press ctrl-i to have your backpack pop up). Use them wisely. Replacing them may cost you money, so don't throw them away unless your backpack is full and you absolutely need the space. Most items are useful, but not all of them, so don't expect every mug of beer to be of great value.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.36: So.. you wish to do an errand for me? Very well then... let's see... Go into the temple's basement and slay at least 15 rats. Then, come back to me and I shall give you a reward.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.37: That's hardly appropriate language! This will not win you friends here.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.38: Thank you for spending some time with an old man. Come again.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.4: Not every NPC uses keywords, but most folks have something specific to say about certain topics. Make note of them and bring it up in the conversation. They might have more to say than it first appears.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.5: There you go. You're a quick study.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.6: I can tell you about several things, but I need to know whether you want "basic" information or "advanced" information. So which one is it?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.7: It's not always easy to start adventuring, I know. I was once a young person, just like you, and I wish I had had someone to show me the ropes back then. Anyway, back to business... When talking to people, you can always ask them their "name" and about their "work". Most will gladly tell you more. Try it, you'll see. Then ask me again to tell you about "functions".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.8: There are some magic buttons that can help you memorize some of the basic functions. F1 gives you a summary of online help. F2 makes you drink a healing potion so you don't have to rummage through your backpack in the middle of combat. The rest are documented in your reference tome. Would you like me to tell you more about "weapons", "armors" and various "items"? Or would you like me to talk about "communication" and "advanced" features?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.9: Ah, someone who likes to talk... That's great, because you'll find plenty of people to talk to in this world. There are communication tools such as "paging" and "shouting" that can help you contact other individuals elsewhere who can answer some of your questions.
npc.topic.liurnclar.0: I go by the name of Liurn Clar. Perhaps you have heard of me?
npc.topic.liurnclar.1: I am a Warwizard. Usually, I "teach" "spells", but lately I have been rather preoccupied with completing my great "portal".
npc.topic.liurnclar.10: Ah, well, yes, you didn't really expect me to do this just for free, right? Now, let's get down to business. You must first sign a few discharges and non-disclosure "forms". Then, there's the issue of "payment".
npc.topic.liurnclar.11: Well, seeing as you've already been to Raven's Dust, I can't very well pretend that I can't send you... I charge %u gold pieces for that trip, however. Will you pay the sum?
npc.topic.liurnclar.12: Theorn is known as the old hermit, a good friend of mine.
npc.topic.liurnclar.13: Learned a new word today, haven't you? How do you like feeling those mental gears at work? Ooh, I can almost hear the cogs turning in your head, here. Funny, that.
npc.topic.liurnclar.14: Well, certainly, I could send you there, but there are certain "conditions" that must be met, certain "quid" "pro" "quos" to discuss...
npc.topic.liurnclar.15: You have already gone through all the formalities. I am ready to "send" you on your way.
npc.topic.liurnclar.16: You have already signed all the require forms and have paid your payment. We are ready to "send" you on your way to "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.liurnclar.17: If you want me to "teleport" you somewhere, just say so.
npc.topic.liurnclar.18: The portal is perhaps the most ambitious project anyone has ever undertaken. It is designed to reduce the time it takes to travel between two towns. I have encountered several problems, though, and I can't seem to figure out what's going wrong. Because of this, I'm afraid I will not have enough time to teach you any spells. At least, I have almost mastered the art of translocating a living target to another place. Perhaps even as far as "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.liurnclar.19: The art of magic must be learned carefully. It takes a lot of intelligence, patience and most of all, money to pay for your teachers!
npc.topic.liurnclar.21: Here are the spells I can teach you.
npc.topic.liurnclar.3: The chaos portal is another project of mine. I am trying to build a portal that will bring me into a parallel world. No one has ever been there but I swear I'll succeed eventually. Alas, for each of my failed attempts, a "chaos" "key" is consumed and that is the reason why I need every key I can get. I won't let failure discourage me.
npc.topic.liurnclar.4: You can find a chaos key on a creature called "Chaos" "Spawn".
npc.topic.liurnclar.5: They are located somewhere on "Stoneheim". I am not sure exactly where they are located but you should begin your search near the fortress in the middle of the island.
npc.topic.liurnclar.6: I can "send" you to Raven's Dust but unfortunately, I have not completed the Stoneheim portal.
npc.topic.liurnclar.7: There is a scholar I'v encountered once who was specialized in arcane scribing and probably has a magic scripting kit or two lying around. I hope this helps you. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll go back to my portals.
npc.topic.liurnclar.8: I'm afraid I cannot help you as I'm all out of blank magical tomes.
npc.topic.liurnclar.9: I wonder where she lives nowadays.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.0: I am... the LORD OF THE SHOPS!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.1: I sell "unique" "items" you can't find anywhere else in the world.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.2: We have Cedar Longbows, Cedar Reflex Bows, Cedar Recurve Bows, Cedar Compound Bows, Cedar Composite Bows, Lancewood Reflex Bows, Lancewood Recurve Bows, Lancewood Compound Bows, Lancewood Composite Bows, Black Locust Recurve Bows, Black Locust Compound Bows, and Black Locust Composite Bows. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "bow".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.3: We have Mithril Shields, Gothic Shields and Adamantite Shields. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "shields".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.4: We have Adamantite Platemail Armors, Adamantite Plate Protectors, Adamantite Platemail Gauntlets, Adamantite Platemail Helmets, Adamantite Platemail Leggings and Adamantite Platemail Boots. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "armors".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.5: I have a "wide" "selection" of very special items. Other vendors won't even buy them from you. Once you have them, they remain yours.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.6: Unfortunately for you, there is nothing I need that you have.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.7: Suit yourself! I have to be elsewhere anyway.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.0: Whether or not you are guilty of treason, you will have to get my "merchandise" back at once!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.10: If you're strong enough to survive hours in the cave north of Windhowl, then you would be able to take a look at what is happening at the mountain.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.11: I tend to lose my diamonds around, I guess I'm plain careless, these days. If you happen to find one, please return it to me at once! Hmmm... By the way, did you find one of my diamonds, by any chance?
npc.topic.lordsunrock.12: Lighthaven is our sister town on the eastern part of this island.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.13: The armorer of "Lighthaven" is supposed to send me a "report" soon.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.14: Sigfried is a great weaponsmith who lives in "Lighthaven". I wonder if he has sent a messenger for his "report" yet...
npc.topic.lordsunrock.15: I have previously given you a reward for bringing me the report I needed. I therefore do not think you need any more gold pieces. I see in your eyes the thirst for adventures, which is probably why you accepted to do this errand once more. I thank you very much.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.16: I'll return to my work now.
