npc.topic.lordsunrock.17: Hm? What, a letter from Asarr? He wishes to surrender, perhaps? Let me see this. Mm. M-hm. Uh huh... Eh? What?!? Who does he *think* he is! That devil shall pay for these words! What insolence!You! Come here! Tell that ruffian he's not going to call me a blue-nosed babboon without suffering the consequences. Tell him he will feel the heat of my "wrath" and pay for his insufferable disrespect!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.18: Tell him. Tell him my anger will pursue him 'till the end of time!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.2: Windhowl is more like a city than a town. It has grown much in size lately.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.3: I am Lord Sunrock. I rule over the city of Windhowl.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.4: I try to maintain order in the town. I have to make sure the "guards" are doing their job well, and see the economy does not fall apart. That is what is giving me the most trouble. There aren't any "merchants" coming from Lighthaven except those under the protection of young adventurers like yourself. "Jarko" the necromancer causes me many headaches, for his goblins are everywhere in the forest.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.5: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.7: They're doing their work well enough, but there aren't enough of them to make a strike at "Righul's" "Mountain".
npc.topic.lordsunrock.8: Tell you what, you bring me Jarko's "spellbook" as a proof that you defeated him and I'll reward you. Sounds nice, eh?!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.9: I thank you for bringing back Jarko's spellbook as a proof of your courageous act. I shall burn this atrocity at once, for it is probably cursed. For your good deed, I give you this small amount of gold and this magnificient golden ring!
npc.topic.lordtravis.0: I am Travis, Lieutenant of the guard and renowned knight of Windhowl!
npc.topic.lordtravis.1: I am lieutenant of Windhowl's guard. I have the task, no, the obligation of keeping the town peaceful for all of its citizens. And might I say that it has become an "overwhelming" task lately.
npc.topic.lordtravis.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.lordtravis.4: Goblins must get reinforcements from somewhere or help from some outsider, because they are better equipped than ever and come in ever-increasing numbers. Luckily, they are still no match for the skill of our guards.
npc.topic.lothan.0: My name is Lothan, pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.lothan.1: I am a mage who studies the element of "water". I have been assigned the task of watching over "Araknor". I have yet another concern, however. The orc shaman named "Araf" "Kul" is dangerously growing in power. I highly doubt he will ever be a match for my magic. However, I wonder what special component he uses for his spell casting.
npc.topic.lothan.10: The tower's library is a place where knowledge from all over the world is stored. You can find information on just about any subject in there.
npc.topic.lothan.11: Brigands are attacking all the "merchants" crossing the forest to the west. If you wish to help, go see Lord Kirlor's office.
npc.topic.lothan.12: The tower of magic contains a great "library", where thousands of books containing all sorts of information can be found.
npc.topic.lothan.13: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping the islands of Raven's Dust and Arakas, which is the one you are currently on. As for Raven's Dust, it is the island southwest of here, where the castle of King "Theodore" XIII is located.
npc.topic.lothan.14: Raven's Dust is a small island located southwest of this island.
npc.topic.lothan.15: I must say, he is the worst king the kingdom has ever had! He always sleeps and never gets anything done, even now as the "goblin" hordes are gaining ground. These are indeed dark times we live in...
npc.topic.lothan.16: I don't know precisely what is happening with them, only that we are slowly losing the battle. Some say they even witnessed certain goblins carrying magical weapons! I fail to see how that is possible, goblins being rather stupid and wanting nothing to do with magic.
npc.topic.lothan.17: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.lothan.18: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.lothan.2: I don't know where she is. Sorry I couldn't help you.
npc.topic.lothan.22: Windhowl is a town located to the southwestern part of the island.
npc.topic.lothan.23: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.lothan.24: I have studied long and hard to master the use of these "spells"... Perhaps one day, when you are strong enough, I will "teach" you some of them.
npc.topic.lothan.25: Let's see if you are ready for what I can teach you.
npc.topic.lothan.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.lothan.5: Human bone? I could simply ask "Araknor" for one, he has a collection of them, you know.
npc.topic.lothan.6: The leaf of a pink tree? What would I do with that? Pfah! I'll tell you...NOTHING! Well, perhaps a druid could find a use for it of course.
npc.topic.lothan.7: He is a shaman orc and surprisingly skilled in the art of magic for one of his race.
npc.topic.lothan.8: He is someone who just can't be trusted. He is a follower of the ways of necromancy, and therefore is a very dark and disturbed individual. He is currently a resident of the "tower" and benefits from the massive "library" stored here. This is the only reason why he would accept to pay the ridiculous sums of money we charge him to stay here. If it was up to me, I would kick him out of the "kingdom" myself, but our town is in dire need of resources due to the "brigands" roaming around town.
npc.topic.lothan.9: Our sister town on this isle, Windhowl is located on the western part of the island. Because of its proximity to the goblin hideout, it is always assaulted by the "goblin" army. Fortunately, the guardsmen have done a good job repelling them. Let's hope they will hold on until reinforcements arrive.
npc.topic.lyria.0: They call me Lyria. You don't look as suspicious as they say.
npc.topic.lyria.1: Oh, I am just doing things. Not very "interesting". But you seem to be a great "adventurer".
npc.topic.lyria.3: I am a master at picking locks. I could "teach" it to you, if it will help you in your journey.
npc.topic.lyria.6: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.lyria.8: If you are a good robber, you should ask "Asarr" for a job. But you have to be very good, because if you get caught, he will not do a thing for you.
npc.topic.lyria.9: Asarr is our leader and a greater master thief too.
npc.topic.malaar.0: I am Malaar, a bishop of Artherk's "church".
npc.topic.malaar.1: I am a bishop of "Artherk". It is my life's work to follow the path of light.
npc.topic.malaar.10: You still don't know what Arakas is?
npc.topic.malaar.2: Ach! So that fiend Balork has cursed you too? I know a traveller to whom it happened, a long time ago... When I saw him again, he said something about a certain "Annabelle" curing him.
npc.topic.malaar.3: Young, lovely Annabelle, how we miss her! She could heal the sick and comfort the downtrodden. She would hear your plight and help you, no doubt. If she were still alive, that is.
npc.topic.malaar.4: We would gladly accept a donation from you, if you would be so kind as to make one. Would you perhaps have 10,000 gold pieces to offer to Artherk?
npc.topic.malaar.5: Artherk is the god of mending and help. He is the only god worshiped in the kingdom of "Goldmoon", I believe. Most of his many followers have the unending task of helping people and praying for those lost in darkness.
npc.topic.malaar.6: Ahhh, what a great kingdom it is. Our fair King "Theodore" rules wisely and the people are kind of heart. None follow any god other than the great "Artherk", and rightfully so, since he is the only god worshipped by our church. There is also a long forgotten "temple" on Goldmoon, but I do not know if it was dedicated to "Artherk".
npc.topic.malaar.7: Ahhh! What a wonderful king! He sends us "donations" every month and, in return, we tell everyone how great a king he is.
npc.topic.malaar.8: There are many churches of Artherk throughout the land. Most of the other churches follow a dark path, however. Beware of those that hide their work from the eyes of the people.
npc.topic.malaar.9: That ancient temple? Oh, well, I do not know much about it. It lies in the forest in the center of Arakas. I think it is near the center but I don't have any time to spend on finding such a mysterious place.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.1: I am a manaweaver by profession. I can create powerful magical items if you have the gold.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.2: I have no help to give, nor quest to suggest, but should you happen to have "Scrolls" "of" "Horse" "Friendship" on you, be sure to drop by and let me know.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.3: A weakling! He believes in his own sanctimonious, righteous act, but I am not fooled by it. He is guilty of something, and even though he hides it well, I'm confident Zion Thunderheart will eventually expose him.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.4: He should be the king! None of this weak-hearted compassion and nonsensical trading with humans. Let Zion rule and take us on the path to reclaim *our* Stoneheim!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.5: Dumb as a doorknob! He can fight pretty good, but his ridiculous equipment is what makes him good, not his skill. Some day, I'll show him who's the better warrior!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.6: A rank amateur! He thinks his manasmithing is better than my manaweaving, but that's because I've never challenged his little creations with my own. I've made swords and armors that could slay him in one blow!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.7: A delusional idiot! I want nothing to do with the likes of him. Religion is for those who do not have the strength to stand proud and tall on their own. I don't need a god to tell me I'm worth something, I already know that!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.8: Brawns with no brains! He thinks he's all that, he thinks he's noble and selfless, but I know better. He and his ilk only want to be seen as great heroes and protectors, when all they do is walk around with a sword and pretend they're something else. It makes me sick!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.9: Leave at once, you're wasting my time.
npc.topic.markam.0: The name is Markam Korwald to you, stranger.
npc.topic.markam.1: My duties are numerous in this town. You might say that I am "Lord" "Kirlor"'s assistant.
npc.topic.markam.10: All you have to do is "register" at the Lord's office, and find a merchant.
npc.topic.markam.11: The western town on the island, Windhowl is the biggest town in the kingdom of "Goldmoon". But be careful if you go there because "brigands" and strange creatures have been ambushing careless wanderers lately.
npc.topic.markam.12: Brigands have been banding together in large groups to attack our "merchant" carriers. If one could "help" them by bringing a simple report to Lord Sunrock in "Windhowl", it would allow both towns to send guarded merchant caravans at a secret planned time and do business without fearing the interference of the brigands. If you are an adventurer, then by all means, talk to Lord Kirlor in his office and "register" yourself!
npc.topic.markam.13: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.markam.14: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.markam.18: Windhowl is a town located to the western part of the island.
npc.topic.markam.19: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.markam.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never met her.
npc.topic.markam.4: Lord Kirlor has been looking for adventurers lately to help in the protection of the local "merchants".
npc.topic.markam.5: It is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.markam.6: That is the island you can see just southwest of here.
npc.topic.markam.7: Arakas is the island you are currently standing on.
npc.topic.markam.8: The merchants are constantly being robbed by "brigands" while trying to cross the forest to "Windhowl". They are having a hard time. Their shops are losing money and all.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.0: I am Marnec Sunim, the greatest "farmer" around!
npc.topic.marnecsunim.1: My ancestors have been farmers for generations now. I have "secrets" which help me grow food that has made me famous. I am not very rich yet, but I'm sure it's just a matter of time.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.12: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.13: It is the largest town on this island, and is located west of the forest.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.14: Our army is so small that it can't even take out the "brigands"' hideout. Fortunatly, "Murmuntag" sometimes goes in the forest and cleans up the road for a day or two.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.15: He's quite a big fellow, I tell you. Not very intelligent, but strong as an ox, maybe even stronger.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.16: I'll return to work now, goodbye.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.2: I'm sorry, but my farmer's secrets are only passed down from father to son.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.3: I am the town's greatest farmer! And I tell you, it isn't going as well as it used to. Those damned "brigands" are really starting to annoy me. It's a shame our town's "army" is too small to give them a good beating. One of these days I tell ya, I'm going to pay them a small visit. It's just that I'm too busy to do it now with my farm and all, you know...
npc.topic.marnecsunim.6: They are attacking everyone who tries to cross the forest. Trading with "Windhowl" has been nearly impossible lately because of them. Perhaps you could help the "merchants" doing some business with Windhowl if you are a true adventurer.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.7: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.8: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.marsaccred.0: I am Marsac Cred. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.marsaccred.1: I am an "elemental" mage, and I help "R'yleth" here in this tower of magic.
npc.topic.marsaccred.10: You can't make that on your own, you have to check with someone who's specialized in making such kits. I know of a certain Iraltok who could perhaps help you with that.
npc.topic.marsaccred.11: Elemental magic is the base of all things pure. A mage can gather the mana that flows around him and channel it into one of four elements and release the energies in the form of a spell. I control the forces of "water".
npc.topic.marsaccred.12: Althought most of the time, water is peaceful in nature, it can sometimes be devastating. I can show you how to harness the forces of water and "teach" you how to cast water spells, so that you may use these forces to your advantage.
npc.topic.marsaccred.13: I will teach you what I can.
npc.topic.marsaccred.14: The guildmaster's work consists of controlling the research of new spells and the teaching of magic to apprentices. The guildmaster is also often asked to help the city in various matters, mostly political.
npc.topic.marsaccred.3: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.marsaccred.4: So, Uranos needs a special component, eh? Well, he can thank his lucky star that I know exactly what he's looking for. You will have to find some decaying bat "wings" and bring them to him before they crumble to dust. He'll probably need more than one though, so get as many as you can.
npc.topic.marsaccred.5: They're just ordinary bat wings... Well, that's not entirely true. Actually, the kind of wing he is looking for only comes from the undead bats that roam in the dungeon under Lighthaven.
npc.topic.marsaccred.6: R'yleth is the current mage "Guildmaster" here in Windhowl. His great power is only matched by his enormous ego. *snicker* But other than that, he truly is a master of magic. He has travelled much and has learned from the greatest magicians that live.
npc.topic.marsaccred.7: These are powerful scrolls indeed. They can help you make a magical item, or to improve an item that is already magical. Would you like me to make one for you?
npc.topic.marsaccred.8: This type of scroll is required to create "scroll" "of" "enchantment". You should definitely try to acquire a few. All true mages have them and trade them.
npc.topic.marsaccred.9: Orcs sometimes collect those, so you know where to look. Go figure. *shrug*
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.1: I am the mayor of Stonecrest. I see to the well-being of the citizens of this town. In this, I have to say that I am fortunate to have one such as "Grant" "Hornkeep" to uphold the law.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.2: He is the town's sheriff. It is his duty to enforce the law and stop thieves and skraugs from wreaking havoc around here.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.3: I used to be a dragonslayer in my young days. That's before I retired and took this job as Stonecrest's mayor. It's a cushy job compared to fighting dragons, but the politics can really get to you, sometimes. There are days when I miss the 'old life'...
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.4: If you have half a dozen or more of those, I will reward you handsomely.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.5: I will not tolerate such language from anyone.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.1: I am Meltar Winterstorm. You do not have to tell me who you are, I already know your name, %s.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.10: If you want to secure our friendship, there is no better way than by gathering gems and precious stones and bringing them back to me or my colleagues. You will be rewarded differently for each type of gem depending on value, of course.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.11: You want to know what your standing amongst the thieves is?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.12: It's about time. Our little chat was somewhat boring.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.14: So, you want to learn how to hide now?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.15: If you need training, I suggest you look elsewhere.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.2: Eh, you think I would tell you?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.3: I don't care about anything that happens on that island.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.4: You think you're so tough, eh? We'll just see about that!
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.5: I have already given you the Crown of Corruption. What more do you want from me?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.6: Yes that's right, I called you an insignificant. You probably think you're some sort of avatar or something of the like, but in reality you are nothing more than a mere puppet.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.7: Bah, I have already given you the crown, what more would you have me do?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.8: Bah, I have already given you the crown, what more would you have me do?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.9: There are several ways to increase your standing with the thieves. Since we yearn for treasure of all sorts, one way of improving your image would be to bring us valuable "gems" and "precious" "stones".
npc.topic.menark.10: Why yes, I suppose you could call them books too.
npc.topic.menark.11: I am the one true master of all riddles! If you need help with some, just ask me for "riddle" "hints" and I'll see what I can do. I must warn you, however, my help comes with a price. I haven't spent the last few decades learning riddles to just *give* away the answers!
npc.topic.menark.2: I am what you might call a chronicler. "Jeremiah" and I have been charged with the never-ending task of gathering knowledge from all over the world and keeping "records" of his "journeys" here.
npc.topic.menark.3: Who told you about the Chronicles of Doom? Shadeen... I see! I assume she sent you here to try to get it from me, right? Are you actually threatening me, boy?
npc.topic.menark.4: I have had many visitors lately, but the one that was just here struck me as being rather "odd".
npc.topic.menark.5: I'm affraid I must get back to my writing so I can't really help you with that. Why don't you just ask around? You might get more information with the other townsfolk.
npc.topic.menark.6: He's a charming fellow to tell you the truth, but don't tell him I said that!
npc.topic.menark.7: We keep records of all knowledge so that others might one day look through these pages and learn about the many different parts of the world.
npc.topic.menark.8: Jeremiah has very poor handwriting and so gets to do most of the travelling. Even though I am accustomed to living indoors, I still long to go outside. Still, I dare not travel where mummies and skeletons are living. I have heard that they feast upon the warm blood of humans. If you could bring me some mummy's bandages and a skeleton bone, perhaps I could "study" these beings.
npc.topic.menark.9: You've found a skeleton bone and some mummy's bandages? Do you want to give them to me so that I can study the undead's mysterious nature?
npc.topic.metanas.0: Metanas is the name, not that it concerns you.
npc.topic.metanas.1: If you keep saying my name like that, you'll find that it's considerably harder to pronounce without any teeth in your mouth!
npc.topic.metanas.2: Well, what does it look like I'm doing? I'm keeping an eye on the "patrons", that's what I'm doing!
npc.topic.metanas.3: See those two by the table over there? They know what it feels like to have my boot stamped all across their faces. Just give me one good reason and I'll do the same to you!
npc.topic.metanas.4: Of course I've seen a strange visitor! This is a tavern you idiot!
npc.topic.metanas.5: Get out if you're done, otherwise stop bothering me and sit down!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.0: Mhorgwloth not have shiny rock. Mhorgwloth gave rock.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.11: Mhorgwloth not know her. Only know "pretty" "lady".
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.12: Huh huh huh... Awhlop! Pretty lady! Huh huh...
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.2: Whorc? Mhorwgloth don't know. Mhorgwloth dumb. Only thing Mhorgwloth do is "grow"!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.3: GRRR! Evil king chop Mhorgwloth arm! But arm grow back! Mhorgwloth "special".
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.4: You want special too? Mhorgwloth "teach" you.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.7: Mhorgwloth too strong for small humans. Mhorgwloth killed king.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.8: Balork's Brand? Me not understand! Awhlop!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.9: Isshhhh! Awhlop! Town.. human town. Me don't like human!
npc.topic.miraknira.0: I am Mirak Nira, nice of you to ask.  I am "working" now, so please be "brief", unless you seek "information" about the town, of course.
npc.topic.miraknira.1: I am an assistant for his lordship.  I guess you could say that I work for the "town".
npc.topic.miraknira.10: Lord Sunrock asks a lot from us, and we are always kept very busy. As a result, we don't have much time to talk with people. *sigh* How I wish that one day I will have enough money to go far away from here. The world is so vast, and to be confined inside a small place such as Windhowl is very frustrating.
npc.topic.miraknira.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady but somewhat odd, even though I have never seen her myself.
npc.topic.miraknira.4: I do not want to hear about that dreaded necromancer.
npc.topic.miraknira.7: I will only trust one who helps Windhowl. If you kill a hundred goblins, then surely you are trustworthy. And even if you are not, you will have at least rid us of some of these annoying monsters. Either way, you will deserve a reward.
npc.topic.miraknira.8: Our town has many treasures, and my task is to keep track of all of them. Food supplies, water supplies and the town's finances must also all be accounted for.
npc.topic.miraknira.9: I am truly sorry, but all information concerning town supplies are confidential at the moment, as well as the financial state of the town.
npc.topic.miramlaky.0: My name is Miram Laky, son of "Rothar" Laky.
npc.topic.miramlaky.1: My father was a great man. I don't know what he did, but I'm sure he did something great, like fighting off dragons or something. I heard he was an adventurer, you know. Unfortunately, he's been gone for about fifteen years now and I haven't seen him since.
npc.topic.miramlaky.2: Isn't it obvious by looking around? I take care of the fields. I harvest many kinds of vegetables. We've only two farmers in this town to feed the whole population. It isn't much I tell ya! Sometimes we even need to get some food from "Lighthaven".
npc.topic.miramlaky.3: Oh, I don't know if she's dead or alive for sure, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.miramlaky.4: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.miramlaky.5: It's the village east of here, but then again, you look like you come from there anyway. I wonder how you got passed the brigands... They have been harrassing anyone that tries to cross over to this town, lately. This "island" is doomed to chaos if nothing more is done about the evil lurking around.
npc.topic.miramlaky.6: Don't you know anything? You're on the island of Arakas!
npc.topic.miramlaky.7: I heard they're using magic swords now! I don't know about you, but I don't trust anything about that magic stuff. It always gave me the creeps.
npc.topic.miramlaky.8: I hope next year will be better.
npc.topic.mirandul.0: Mirandul, the fastest "thief" who ever lived.
npc.topic.mirandul.1: I make sure that nobody steals the treasures we get.
npc.topic.mirandul.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.mirandul.4: Not long ago, I had flying boots. They were very useful, but I had to give them away to save my life. I think they were forever lost in the ocean.
npc.topic.mirandul.5: You will never be as fast as I was.
npc.topic.mirandul.6: I am not a thief anymore, but a brigand. I know I do not look very fast now, but you would be surprised of my feats four years ago.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.0: Yes, Mirymwen Featherfoot is the name.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.2: I am a thief and I'm particularly skilled with a dagger. I'm also quite adept at dodging, and I could probably "train" you in that field, seeing as it is very useful for a thief.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.4: Dantalir Songweaver is a bard. Though, I must say that his thieving skills are much better than his vocal cords.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.5: Rablek is the man with the gleaming sword who is standing over there.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.1: I am Mithanna Snowraven, white sorceress of Stonecrest.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.10: That is not something you should be concerned about. It has to do with legendary beings of ages past.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.11: I can help you by "teaching" you a spell or two
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.12: These are the few spells that I can teach you. Use them wisely.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.13: The ice storm spell will freeze everything within the area of effect, inflicting great amounts of damage to all living creatures affected. You are required to have the glacier spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.14: The blizzard spell will freeze everything within the area of effect, inflicting tremendous amounts of damage to all living creatures affected. You are required to have the ice storm spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.15: You should leave right away before I do something we'd both regret.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.2: Fear not, I am not a sorceress of evil. I study the art of spellcraft and can perhaps "help" you if you need assistance.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.3: I see that you are now a Lightbringer, %s. Let's hope that you're ready for what lies ahead.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.4: You know of him? That's good. Yes, he's for real, he's very powerful and he's the next step toward your great destiny... to kill Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.5: You already have this piece of the key. It would do you no good to have an additional one.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.6: Why, yes, that is also how some centaurs call me.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.8: The jade ring of sorcery can enhance the strength of its wearer's spells.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.9: I am sure that a seasoned adventurer such as yourself will have no problem in finding tarantula eyes.
npc.topic.mithrand.0: My name is Mithrand. I "work" for the town's "Lord".
npc.topic.mithrand.1: I work for Kirlor, the "Lord" of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.mithrand.10: You must tell me how many gold pieces you wish to withdraw. For instance, if you would like to withdraw 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {WITHDRAW} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "deposit" gold to your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.mithrand.11: Bah! I'm getting tired of your ignorance... Go bother someone else!
npc.topic.mithrand.12: Humpf! It is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.mithrand.13: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.mithrand.14: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.mithrand.18: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.mithrand.19: The westernmost town of the island, Windhowl is falling prey to many wandering brigands and other assortments of strange creatures.
npc.topic.mithrand.2: I have heard of that woman, but I never saw her myself.
npc.topic.mithrand.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.mithrand.4: His name is Kirlor Dhul. He is the first and only Lord this town ever had. Probably the last one too if that blasted "King" doesn't do anything soon.
npc.topic.mithrand.5: Yes, Theodore XIII. He is the King of "Goldmoon", and it almost looks like he doesn't care what happens to the kingdom.
npc.topic.mithrand.6: Don't you know anything? Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the towns on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.mithrand.7: You have %u gold pieces in your bank account.
npc.topic.mithrand.8: Yes, I am the banker of Lighthaven's bank.
npc.topic.mithrand.9: You must tell me how many gold pieces you wish to deposit. For instance, if you would like to deposit 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {DEPOSIT} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "withdraw" gold from your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.0: Your devotion is admirable and it will not go unnoticed. However, I have other important matters to attend to right now, and I do not have time to perform the necessary rites of initiation.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.1: As you are probably aware, the Elvenbane has served its purpose and is now useless. It is possible for me to break the enchantment but doing so will also destroy the blade. So, do you desire to be freed from its enchantment?
npc.topic.monsignordamien.10: Zhakar resides in a crumbling tower located in the Wizard's Vale.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.11: Stonecrest is the main town on the Stoneheim island.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.12: Julian? I've never had the pleasure of meeting someone whose name was Julian.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.13: I do not believe in speaking of people behind their backs, even if such people would not hesitate to do so to thwart my goals.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.14: I do not understand what you want, child.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.15: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.16: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.17: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.18: Now that you have the means to do it, I guess it's all up to you then.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.19: Yes, that is the sword you will need to kill Shadeen.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.2: I am called Damien, Damien the Damned.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.20: Unfortunately, I am not aware of his whereabouts. As you are a resourceful person, I have no doubt that you will succeed in finding him, even with my lack of information.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.21: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.3: I preach to the winds, a single voice in a desert of madness. I plead for reason, and sure enough, no one listens.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.4: Yes indeed, I was condemned for my unorthodox beliefs, but only because the fools above me in the church of Artherk could not see the greater design of the world. But some day, I will show them all.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.5: Uh? I'm afraid I don't understand what you're talking about.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.6: Stoneheim is just another island. If that will be all, I have more important things to do than teaching you geography.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.7: I'm afraid I cannot help you with this.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.9: A terrible god is he. Please, do not speak his name in my presence.
npc.topic.moonrock.0: The High Priest? I'm afraid he had to leave. Brother Kiran can tell you more about it if you talk to him.
npc.topic.moonrock.1: I go by the name of Moonrock. I "work" in this temple to serve the great god of mending, "Artherk". A long time ago, I used to wander the world to help those in need, but now, I am content to just stay here and pray.
npc.topic.moonrock.10: I do not really like filthy dungeons.
npc.topic.moonrock.11: I am the Bishop of this church. I can "heal" your wounds using powerful "magic".
npc.topic.moonrock.12: Annabelle has a powerful healing touch.
npc.topic.moonrock.13: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.moonrock.14: Artherk is the greatest deity of them all. He is the god of mending and truth. It is an honor for me to be able to serve him.
npc.topic.moonrock.15: I am one with the elements of light and earth. With the knowledge that I possess, I am able to heal one's wounds. If you have time, I can share that knowledge and "teach" you a few spells.
npc.topic.moonrock.16: Very well. This is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.moonrock.2: This is the name of a coastal town located on "Stoneheim".
npc.topic.moonrock.3: Stoneheim is a distant island where the town of "Stonecrest" is located.
npc.topic.moonrock.4: A Champion of Light is a person who has decided to follow the path of Light.
npc.topic.moonrock.5: To become a Lightbringer, you must be a "Champion" "of" "Light". If you are, then all you have to do is to seek a paladin such as Sir Beltigan of "Stoneheim".
npc.topic.moonrock.6: I am sorry but there is nothing I have to say about that to you.
npc.topic.moonrock.7: I think she resides in Stonecrest now. If you ever see her, tell her I said hello.
npc.topic.moonrock.8: I had one such key, a long time ago, yes. It wasn't for myself, but was necessary to save the life of a friend who had been taken hostage by Bane Blackblood, on Raven's Dust. I guess he still has it, although some people have already asked me about it.
npc.topic.moonrock.9: Balork dwells in a "dungeon" under the temple of Artherk.
npc.topic.moontugguard1.0: The skraug sentry growls ominously when you wave your hand... you quickly stop and look away.
npc.topic.moontugguard2.0: The skraug sentry growls ominously when you wave your hand... you quickly stop and look away.
npc.topic.mordenthal.0: Whence I came, they called me Sir Mordenthal.
npc.topic.mordenthal.1: A "dark" "knight" I am, and mayhaps something more.
npc.topic.mordenthal.10: You are already one of my lord's followers.
npc.topic.mordenthal.2: I was once foremost amongst the great generals in "Ogrimar"'s army.
npc.topic.mordenthal.3: Since the past few thousand years, there has been one whose power has grown steadily. Since a balance must be kept, what is gained must be lost somewhere else. Fortunately, there is "another" whose power has also been decreasing.
npc.topic.mordenthal.4: If you would assist me, I could use some "Rings" "of" "the" "Lion". King Aedenas Gravesoul, ruler of the Centaurs, should have some, but you might need to give him something in return.
npc.topic.mordenthal.5: Artherk, the god of Peace, curse his name, has also been affected by the uprise of the "Dark" "One".
npc.topic.mordenthal.6: The one I am referring to is none other than "Makrsh" "P'tangh".
npc.topic.mordenthal.7: Most wretched of men is he, the Dark One will stop at nothing to gain whatever power he can have. His strength is so great that it rivals that of the "gods"!
npc.topic.mordenthal.8: So profound is their need that the gods are hard-pressed to take action. My god is searching for "followers" to help him vanquish this threat.
npc.topic.mordenthal.9: You are already one of my lord's followers. You should seek to "uphold" him in all you do.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.0: I am known as Mordrick Warstone, Knight of Might and protector of King "Theodore" XIIIth.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.1: I am the Knight of Might. This title has been bestowed upon me by the King himself. I have pledged on my honor that I will defend King "Theodore" XIIIth no matter what. I also have the task of choosing new young "recruits" to fill our ranks.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.10: I need to know how good you can be in the heat of a battle. Therefore, you will have to slay at least 15 demon trees that plague the forest of Ravenwood. That shouldn't be too difficult for you.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.11: The Lich Makrsh P'Tangh is both strong in body and in magic. Weapons alone will not overcome it that easily. Only a good mix of steel and magic will be able to destroy him for good.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.13: What would be the need of going there? There's no water and nothing interesting there. Furthermore, I heard stories of deadly scorpions roaming in that area.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.14: I could break all your bones just for saying that to me but I'll let it pass... for now.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.15: Be on your way and stop bothering me. I have work to do.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.2: I despise him because he does not care about his people. Not as much as a true king should. He does little other than sleep all day while people are starving or attacked by vile creatures. Good men such as "Derran" "Ironstrife" have to take the burden upon themselves of making difficult decisions.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.3: You are trying to fool me with some fake swords, %s?There can be only one Sword of Might!
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.4: There's an underground complex called the Caverns of Illusion. That is where sword often returns, for some mysterious reason.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.5: Derran Ironstrife is a great warrior and one of "King" "Theodore"'s pillars. Without him, I am sure that the kingdom would already be overtaken by savages.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.6: The orcs are a constant danger. They must be obliterated once and for all or they will always attempt to cause use mischiefs.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.7: Do I look like a trainer to you? Go see Derran if you want some training.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.8: Do I look like a teacher? Stop bothering me and see Derran if you want to be taught new abilities.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.9: We are always recruiting well-trained soldiers into our ranks of elite warriors. I'll readily admit that the pay is rather slim but our soldiers are always well fed.  Do you wish to enroll yourself and pledge loyalty, even through death, to our Majesty?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.0: I am known as Morindin Arrowmist, the "hunter".
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.1: Cut the chit-chat, what do you want from me?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.10: I am a hunter and an adventurer. I hunt small animals during the night and sell the skins at the town at a fair price.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.11: Mordrick Warstone has sent you? Fine then. Do you have a document you'd want me to translate?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.12: GreyLeaf is of much greater power than the usual demon trees you see in Ravenwood.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.13: That's the name of this forest. There's not many animals here though. Perhaps I should think of moving into a more healthy forest such as one that can be found on "Arakas".
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.14: Arakas is the island located north of this one.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.15: I see that I'm not in good company right now.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.2: As a hunter, I have learned how to "survive" and sustain myself with the resources that are hidden within the forest. I am always in search for good quality "antelope" "skins" which I resell at the town after I have tailored them into fine leather jackets. I am also a master tracker. I could follow the tracks of anybody throughout the woods. Let's just say that I have earned quite a few pennies as a bounty hunter. Nowadays I prefer to hunt small animals however for I am not as young as I once was. Still, I can defend myself against any "orcs" or daemon trees that stand in my way.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.3: To survive, you have to be able to mend your wounds. I could "teach" you how to use the first aid technique that would help you accomplish that.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.4: You have two antelope skins you'd be willing to trade to me?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.7: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.8: Even the best "hunter" in the world would find it hard to survive in such as harsh environment.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.9: Sometimes, I encounter orcs in the forest. Although I do not seek any hostilities, they attack me on sight and I have to defend myself. I've come to understand their crude language over the years. If you have a document that needs to be "translated", perhaps I could help you.
npc.topic.murmuntag.0: Me Murmuntag! Me good orc! Me friend with human like "Elmert" *grunt* Me strong! Me crush enemies! "Urgh!"
npc.topic.murmuntag.1: "Murmuntag" guard town. "Elmert" say kill, Murmuntag kill! *snort*
npc.topic.murmuntag.2: Elmert guard master. *grunt* Elmert pay Murmuntag to protect town. *snort*.
npc.topic.murmuntag.3: This battle cry. Uuuuurrrrrggghhh... Scare "monsters" baaadly. Only great "warriors" have battle cry.
npc.topic.murmuntag.4: *snort* Me could kill Balork easily! Me do "urgh" and him flee.
npc.topic.murmuntag.6: Near city. They come many from cave. But me always scare them.
npc.topic.murmuntag.7: You great warrior? Not great like Murmuntag! Can help you become great, Murmuntag "train" you hard!
npc.topic.mushn.0: I'm Mushn. Greetings to you too.
npc.topic.mushn.1: I own a farm, and I can tell you, it's a job that "occupies" me every minute of the day.
npc.topic.mushn.2: I've never heard of that woman.
npc.topic.mushn.3: Balork's curse? As long as it does not tamper with my crops...
npc.topic.mushn.4: Yes, there are so many things to do on a farm like this. Feed the animals, cultivate the wheat and plant new grains. I sure could use some help around here, but unfortunately, I'm not making much money, and those darn "goblins" are making the trading business very difficult.
npc.topic.mushn.5: Darn little red demons. Several days ago, one got through here, and I had to kill it myself with my shovel. I wish somebody would go to the northern mountains and wipe them out!
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.0: I am Nafuhr BloodHammer. Peculiar name isn't it? It comes from my dwarven "heritage".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.1: I am the village's blacksmith. Although I know how to forge weapons, I leave this in the expert hands of "Rhodar" "Heatforge". My speciality is crafting strong and durable armors.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.10: She was a brave woman. I wish I'd known her better.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.11: Orcs *cannot* be trusted. Incidentally, Raven's Dust is plagued by an orc campment located somewhere in the north. They have battle siege weapons that could do severe damages to our castle but fortunately for us, they are so heavy that even the orcish brutes cannot bring them within range.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.12: You will not be disappointed with my very durable pieces of armor.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.13: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.14: I have customers to tend to so if anyone strange walked in front of my store, I probably missed it.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.2: You look somewhat surprised that dwarven blood runs freely through my veins. I had a "great" "grandfather" who was a dwarf while his wife was human.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.3: This is the smith you must seek if you are looking to buy a good weapon.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.4: The name was Moridhar Rumblehill. He was an awesome warrior who could not be bested in one-on-one combat. In fact, he even fought the powerful dragons of Firesky. Alas, he never learn to retreat and eventually ended up crushed by a "dragon".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.5: I wonder what happened exactly to that race.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.6: Yes, that's the name of my "great" "grandfather".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.7: The dragon tooth was a tiger's tooth in reality? I knew it. It's so small, even a baby wyrm has bigger teeth!
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.8: The dragons are fearsome creatures. They have razon-sharp talons, "teeth" that can bite through the strongest armors and some are even rumored to breathe fire! Fortunately, most of the evil dragons have mysteriously disappeared from Althea.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.9: Even though Murmuntag, Vuntertag and Guntertag are on the right side, they are still orcs and cannot be trusted. They will fight on your side (or against you) for a pouch of coins and a bread crust.
npc.topic.namelessbard.0: Into the "abysssss" I have looked and it said they were the next.
npc.topic.namelessbard.1: Look to the land and you will find the "remnantsssss" of my people.
npc.topic.namelessbard.2: In a tree you will find wisdom, in a fountain, knowledge. Where wisdom and knowledge converge, the answers you seek will emerge.
npc.topic.namelessbard.3: I too was of the chosen... They came and offered us the forbidden... We refused and still we prayed to them... We dedicated our little life to their heaven... And they came and offered us the forsaken... Still we refused and we repented... Death came and cursed us of our lament... He slew all of us and in our amend... We swear that one day we will be avenged.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.0: I am Nisalm Malorik. Please, do call me Niss, it's what all my friends call me.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.1: I am an assistant here, at Lord Sunrock's office. I am in charge of the citizens' demands. I also keep track of everything that's happening in town. Unfortunately, that is "confidential" information, as per Lord Sunrock's orders.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.2: I heard that she has elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.4: Do not forget that our town is waging a fierce war against the goblins. Many unscrupulous fools would sell information about our town for a goodly price. So we have to keep some information under a seal of secrecy.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.0: He speaks to good and evil folks, but before you speak to him, you will need to find him, and that means you must undertake a very difficult quest... to become a Lightbringer.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.1: You have reached a point in your life where no guidance of my part could actually help you. Nevertheless, our church offers several "services" that might help you, all of which are available for a small donation.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.2: I strongly doubt that you wish to cross Sir Beltigan. He is a paladin and surely does not appreciate your ilk.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.5: You already have the Key of Artherk. All that is left is to find the Chamber of Providence and enter the portal.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.6: Dionysus Silverstream is the only cleric in the town of the centaurs. Once you're there, head for the temple and you'll find him.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.7: Theoran lives in a small house outside of Stonecrest. I must warn you however that if you or a friend of yours go there with bad intentions, Theoran might not react well at all.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.8: Annithae lives right here in Stonecrest. I'm sure you won't have any troubles finding her.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.0: I have no time for meaningless chit-chat.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.10: You're asking the wrong fellow. I have no help to give, not even to sell. Go see the old gypsy if you need your future told, I hear she's quite accurate... if you have the bank account to back it up.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.11: It was nice talking to you.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.2: Norimar Steelwind is the name. If you have some hard-earned gold pieces that you want to "deposit" in the secured vault, I am the one to whom you must speak.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.3: I am the banker of this town. I must keep track of all the "deposits" and "withdrawals". I also ensure that thieves such as "Daran" "Lightfoot" do not get access to the vault.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.4: If you store your hard-earned gold in here, you will have nothing to fear of this thief.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.5: She is an odd lady. I wouldn't trust her but I must say that she is rich and gold pieces usually win my trust quite easily.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.6: The services I offer you are quite simple. You can "deposit" or "withdraw" gold pieces or view your account's "balance".
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.7: You have %u gold pieces in your bank account.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.8: You must tell me how much gold pieces you wish to deposit. For instance, if you would like to deposit 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {DEPOSIT} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "withdraw" gold from your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.9: You must tell me how much gold pieces you wish to withdraw. For instance, if you would like to withdraw 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {WITHDRAW} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "deposit" gold to your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.oldhermit.10: Raven's Dust is the island located to the south.
npc.topic.oldhermit.11: The kingdom of Goldmoon regroups the island of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.oldhermit.12: Lighthaven and Windhowl are the two towns located on this island.
npc.topic.oldhermit.13: Arakas? If you do not know where it is, lemme tell you this my friend.. you're LOST! *cackle*
npc.topic.oldhermit.14: Silversky is a small town located on "Raven's" "Dust" near "Theodore"'s castle.
npc.topic.oldhermit.15: King Theodore? I hear he cannot do anything other than sleep.
npc.topic.oldhermit.16: Seeing as you bear no such curse upon you, this is hardly a concern of yours, is it?
npc.topic.oldhermit.17: Easier said that done, I'm afraid she lives on "Raven's" "Dust", not on this... But one as resourceful as you are should not be deterred by hundreds of leagues of water... Perhaps you could "swim" there...
npc.topic.oldhermit.18: Just kidding, my friend. Must you take everything so seriously? Er... Don't answer that. You probably should. Take everything seriously, I mean. You youngsters are so flighty... Anyway, swimming's not really an option. Perhaps a "boat"?
npc.topic.oldhermit.19: Nah, let's strike that out, boats aren't a very good idea at this time of year. Plus, there's the pirates... How about "flying" there?
npc.topic.oldhermit.2: Yes... That would be me. Please be on your way and trouble me no more.
npc.topic.oldhermit.20: No, wait, that's not good either... The giant rocs are all but extinct, and Dwarvinci's flying machine is nothing more than a pipedream. Even that feeble-minded thief who thinks he had flying boots is way off the track. I guess it would take a miracle to take you to "Raven's" "Dust"... Too bad.
npc.topic.oldhermit.21: Asking for a miracle, hmm? Well, I do not know about that, but have you considered "wizardry"? Perhaps that would work.
npc.topic.oldhermit.22: I fail to see why you would need the trust of an old man.
npc.topic.oldhermit.23: *laugh* Excellent! That's the spirit! Heh heh.. I like someone with a sense of adventure. If you're not afraid of dying, you could try teleportation. Speak to Liurn Clar, a wizard in "Windhowl". He needs test subjects. *grin* Now go, I'm tired and your company bores me.
npc.topic.oldhermit.24: Being worthy is great achievement, one that may one day save humankind. Would you not agree? But no matter, youngsters such as you have no care for an old man's "drivel".
npc.topic.oldhermit.25: So you would have me speak of this nonetheless? Don't you have something better to do with your time. Methinks you should find another way to "prove" your "worth".
npc.topic.oldhermit.26: Is that her new name? It stinks! *cough* Oh, don't tell her that. Eh Eh!
npc.topic.oldhermit.27: Don't get lost on your way back home.
npc.topic.oldhermit.3: Hmpf... They shun me, then seek me out... *sigh* Very well, what would you need from me?
npc.topic.oldhermit.4: Read my lips, young pup: N*O*W*A*Y. I'm done with teaching. Seek a tutor elsewhere.
npc.topic.oldhermit.5: I know not of any way to prove to me that you are a good person, but I trust my "daughter" and her alone. If she says you are trustworthy, then I will "trust" you. If not, then begone and stay gone.
npc.topic.oldhermit.6: She lives in "Windhowl". Now go and leave me be.
npc.topic.oldhermit.7: You know of her? Few people are aware that she has Elven ancestors... A very long-lived, comely lass, she was.
npc.topic.oldhermit.8: Ah, wish that I could have lived in the old days, that I could have seen them, walked with them. What a grand time I would have had. But they be long gone, now, cursed by the gods and all but extinct.
npc.topic.oldhermit.9: Hmmm... So you know my real name. That is not bad for one so young as you are. But you'll have to do better than that if you want to impress me.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.0: That is what I was told to do, but I was duped. Don't worry, I will not do the "same" to you. It is just what we call the big picture.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.1: Are you not the one sent by the king? The New Breed of Altheans, the ones who carry in their blood the rage of those who have fallen? But I am getting ahead of myself. I would like to see what you are made of. What do you say? Will you fight to get the answers you seek?
npc.topic.olinhaad1.10: The fool thought the Heartstone to be a mere piece of rock, while it is much more than that... Huh? What is that you carry? A "Darkstone"? This is not what I am looking for. This stone has no value to me whatsoever.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.11: Oh, I understand now. The priest sent you here to hurt me with that, did he? Hah! Go tell your priest that I will take his miserable life if he still insists on denying me the "Heartstone".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.12: You do not know what the Heartstone is? You should ask your high priest, as he knows more about it that anyone else. But beware, even though he is a priest of Artherk, he schemes and "lies" more than Ogrimar himself.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.13: Enough of this... guards! Dispose of him and send his remains to the priest! Maybe that will change his mind.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.14: I will crush you like an ant!
npc.topic.olinhaad1.15: In my veins flows the power of my lord Gluriurl. He has chosen me to be the "Herald" of my master Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.16: Centuries ago, my master created a group comprised of the most powerful archmages of Althea. This group, which you know as the Obsidian Conclave, was to find a way to "destroy" everything that was dear to the gods.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.17: They wreaked havoc everywhere they went. One day, when the Obsidian Conclave was conquering the island of Stoneheim, we dragons intervened and it was at that moment that I first found a dark stone. I later learned that it was the Heart of a god named Gluriurl. At the time I did not know what it was, but it was not long before I started to hear the "soothing" "voice".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.18: I now have his skull, his ribcage and his heart! Do not be surprised, the Darkstone you have in your possession is the Heart of Artherk, not Gluriurl. All I need to do is find a way inside the temple of Lothar to get my lord's essence. Now, begone and for the last time, tell your high priest Gunthar that I will not hesitate to slay everyone in this town if he doesn't tell me where the entrance to the temple is located!
npc.topic.olinhaad1.19: I am known as Olin Haad.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.2: The Council of the Eight. No one knows exactly who they are, but it can't be good seeing as they intervene only in matters concerning the "Harbinger".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.21: I don't see how this is any business of yours.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.22: Leaving so soon? Such a pity.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.3: The Harbinger of Death. The god that is mentioned in the "prophecy" of the Fourth Coming.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.4: It is said that Death will one day plant into the world the "Seeds" of Decay. Once fully grown, these seeds will harvest Life and shape the land in preparation for "His" arrival.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.6: Each of these seeds will contain the rage of the dead races that were destroyed in the name of pride. The Council of the Eight believes that "you" are such a seed.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.7: You are what we call the "New" "Breed". In your veins flows the blood of the elves, the orks and the dwarves of the past.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.8: I can never have enough undead at my service.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.9: Why did I tell you all this? The answer is quite simple actually. I did it for revenge. Knowledge is power, my friend... remember that. Now, I want you to do something for me. Tell that damned high priest in the Temple of Lighthaven, Gunthar, to give me what I was promised or I will not leave until all the people of this town become part of my staff of undead! Now, if you will excuse me, I have things to do.
npc.topic.omarhald.0: I am Omar Hald, the renowned jeweler.
npc.topic.omarhald.1: I am the town's jeweler. I am particularly skilled when it comes to polishing "raw" "crystals". You might also be interested to "buy" some of my wares.
npc.topic.omarhald.2: You can find raw crystals in the caves on the eastern side of Stoneheim. The skraugs are particularly fond of them. I have developed an expertise that allows me to polish these raw crystals into a fine gem of courage. However, I require 9 raw crystals and 50,000 gold for my services to create a single gem.
npc.topic.omarhald.3: Do you want to take a look at my selection of expertly crafted jewelry?
npc.topic.omarhald.4: So, it is your turn to sell some wares, eh?
npc.topic.omarhald.5: I've had enough of you. Leave my house at once!
npc.topic.oracle.0: Once you are reborn, you will be gifted with wings, a part of your heritage as a Seraph. You will also gain the status of a Seraph, gaining access to certain places where you could not go before. Be warned, there is a price to pay for such a prestige. Upon gaining the status of Seraph, you will be demoted to an inexperienced adventurer and will have to begin your life anew. You will, however, begin this life with greatly increased mental and physical capabilities. Well now, there is not much more I can say to prepare you. When you are "ready" "to" "be" "reborn", simply tell me so and we shall begin.
npc.topic.oracle.1: Since the "beginning" "of" "time", I have worn many guises. Those who know me now refer to me as the "Oracle".
npc.topic.oracle.10: There is very little you must do really. simply tell me when you wish to make the "final" "step" and I will send you on your way. I must remind you that if you feel you are not yet ready, you may continue with the "test" in order to be reborn again.
npc.topic.oracle.11: For your test, you will face Gabriel Archonis. You will fight him in a duel to the death inside a special arena. There are four doors surrounding the site, each of which will whisk you out of battle to a safe place should you so desire. To use one of these doors means that you forfeit the battle and will later have to start over. To reach the place of battle, you will require a "key".
npc.topic.oracle.12: Here you are then... I trust you understand what must be done now. Be steadfast and you shall surely succeed. Remember this when you enter the arena. Now go and best of luck to you.
npc.topic.oracle.13: This kind of behavior will not be tolerated within these walls. You get that one for free, %s.
npc.topic.oracle.14: May you find the path that will lead you to your destiny.
npc.topic.oracle.2: I am one with the flow of time. I see all that was, is and will be.
npc.topic.oracle.3: Show me... This is a sparring program, similar to the programmed reality of the matrix. It has the same basic rules. Rules like gravity. What you must remember is that these rules are no different than the rules of a computer system. Some of them can be bent, others can be broken. Understand? Then hit me, if you can...
npc.topic.oracle.4: I am the Keeper of Time. I have many tasks to perform, not the least of which is the oversight of the "balance" between Good and Evil.
npc.topic.oracle.5: There is "one" who deems himself outside of the flow of Time. His mere presence is a threat to the delicate scales of Good and Evil.
npc.topic.oracle.6: I speak of "Makrsh" "P'Tangh" of course. His desire for "death" and "destruction" is beyond understanding.
npc.topic.oracle.7: He must be dealt with, and soon, if this world is to continue its existence. There are few today with the "potential" to one day be able to confront one powerful such as he. I believe you may be one with such "potential".
npc.topic.oracle.8: The entire world will be consumed by Makrsh P'Tangh's need for destruction. He cares not what happens to any of his lieutenants and followers. His desire is not to rule the world, but to destroy it as revenge for his own suffering.
npc.topic.oracle.9: Yes, I do believe you truly have what is necessary to defeat Makrsh P'Tangh. All that remains is for you to "prepare" youself for the final conflict.
npc.topic.ortanalas.0: Je suis Ortanalas. Que puis-je faire pour vous ?
npc.topic.ortanalas.1: Je peux vous transmettre une partie de mon savoir si vous êtes prêt à apprendre.
npc.topic.ortanalas.2: Unfortunately, I am not yet experienced enough to teach. I can only train the skills that my master "Jagar" "Kar" teaches.
npc.topic.ortanalas.4: I have heard of that woman, but I never saw her myself.
npc.topic.ortanalas.5: Bah! He can barely fit through a door frame because of the size of his head! I tell you, if I could, I'd show him a thing or two. Luckily for him, the lord pays me well to be his assistant. He thinks he's a master warrior, but he's only a big lazy tub of turd. He makes me clean all his clothes, shine his old rusty armor collection, and I do all the work when it comes to training people. True, he had some days of glory when he was the king's assistant and he can be one tough lad in combat. It's a shame he doesn't put his talent to better use. Oh well, I guess it's all the better for me... That way it will be much easier to take his place *grin*.
npc.topic.ortanalas.6: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.pig.0: Je suis A pig. Que puis-je faire pour vous ?
npc.topic.pig.1: Je m'occupe de mes affaires et je connais bien les environs.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.0: We're currently not holding a lottery. You can always "buy" "a" "ticket" for the next one, though.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.1: The lottery pick will be held in %u minutes.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.3: The lottery system is quite simple. First, you must "buy" "a" "ticket" from me for only 1000 gold pieces. I'll pick the winner exactly 2 hours after the first ticket has been bought. I can tell you the "lottery" "time" if you ask me. If the winner does not "claim" the "jackpot" after a while, the gold pieces are automatically added to the next jackpot.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.4: It is quite simple to play the game I host and be a very rich person. You tell me what number you wish to "pick" and give me 1000 gold pieces. Then, I pick 5 numbers out of this sack. Each time I pick your number, you win 1000 gold pieces! You can win up to {FIVE} times your wager. I'm telling you, this could be your lucky day!
npc.topic.pmtheisser.5: Sorry but the Goblin Invasion Quest is currently running.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.7: Have a nice evening, %s. It is currently %u:%u in the world of Althea.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.8: It is currently %u:%u in the world of Althea.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.0: What would satisfy you? Just name your reward, whether it's a "prayer", "healing", "curse" removal, or... "gold", and it will be so. Make your choice carefully.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.1: Oh... I should have expected someone like you would ask for something as mundane as money for a good deed. Are you certain this is what you want?
npc.topic.princessdelilah.10: My name is Delilah, daughter of "King Theodore".
npc.topic.princessdelilah.11: I am the king's daughter and a priestess of Artherk.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.13: Be well. May Artherk protect you.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.2: I see that you have been cursed by that evil demon, Balork. Perhaps I could repay your generous deed by helping you with that? Would that be agreeable with you?
npc.topic.princessdelilah.3: I've never been on the island of Stoneheim but I've heard rumors that it is the field of a great battle between the forces of good and evil.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.4: He is a bit eccentric but I sense that he is a good person at heart. Plus, he is a wizard of immense power. You should treat him with respect. I sure wouldn't want him to be mad at me.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.5: Bishop Crowbanner is a kind man. Because he has always been my "mentor", I feel it is my duty to see to it that he is treated with the same care as he would for me.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.6: Yes, he has been my tutor for many years now, in fact more than I can remember. Bishop Crowbanner knows more about the workings of the world than most men seek in their lifetime. Since you have been good to him, I am certain he would gladly teach you a thing or two.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.7: The Oracle has disappeared a long time ago, but could foretell the future. I'm afraid I know little of these matters. Perhaps Sorcerer Zhakar could help you.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.8: I will pray for you tonight, %s, and hope that Artherk will save your soul.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.9: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.0: Yes, Rablek is the name. I am the swiftest blade gold can buy around here. Using a special "technique" I have learned a while ago, I am able to deliver harmful blows even against an armored opponent.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.1: The technique is known as "armor" "penetration". I might "teach" this skill to you if you're willing to pay the price.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.10: Didn't I tell you that curiosity is a bad habit?
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.2: You haven't heard of me before? I am Rablek Swiftblade, the renowned thief.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.3: Curiosity is a bad habit. Around here, we do what we have to do and we keep our mouth shut about it.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.4: You need %u more levels, %u more strength, %u more agility and %u more intelligence to learn armor penetration.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.5: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.7: That's the guy over there who thinks he has some musical talent but obviously does NOT.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.8: Your tongue will get you killed someday.
npc.topic.ramirgo.0: That is what I am... nothing more, nothing less. I see that you have Artherk's Darkstone. As it is written, you may "enter" the shrine without any reprisal from me.
npc.topic.ramirgo.2: To guard this shrine until the end of time... such is my fate.
npc.topic.rawlin.0: Hello %s, I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.rawlin.10: You should ask someone else about that.
npc.topic.rawlin.11: Do not hesitate to come back if you need a good weapon.
npc.topic.rawlin.3: I wander around the country, selling my skillfully crafted "weapons" to whoever's wealthy enough to purchase one.
npc.topic.rawlin.4: I am sure that you won't be disappointed if you ever "buy" a weapon from me. Would you care to have a look at what I have?
npc.topic.rawlin.5: You'd like to buy a weapon, eh? I'm sure I have the perfect weapon to match your fighting style. Would you care to have a look at the weapons I have for sale?
npc.topic.rawlin.7: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.rawlin.8: That is the town where the castle of King Theodore XIII is located. It is located somewhere to the south-east of the island.
npc.topic.rawlin.9: I doubt I'll make a sale with you today.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.0: I am the one called Alphan.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.1: I have been waiting for your arrival. I am here to "help" you prepare to start your new life.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.2: You have been granted a certain amount of energy that must be spent before you can move on to the next stage of evolution. Right now, you have a total of %u points of energy. Each of my associates will briefly explain to you how these may be spent to increase your abilities. Talk to each one and once you have spent all this energy, come back to talk to me and I shall arrange for your departure back into the world.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.3: The preparations are complete. Within a few seconds, you will be transported to Lighthaven to begin your life anew. I wish you good luck on your journey. May we one day meet again!
npc.topic.remortnpc1.4: Very well, return when you are ready to hear what I have to say.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.0: I am the one called Betran.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.1: I am here to help you increase your main "attributes" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your main attributes. The attributes you can increase are "strength", "endurance", "agility", "intelligence" and "wisdom". Note that the higher you decide to push an attribute, the more costly in energy the process will be. For example, raising all your attributes by 1 costs much less energy than raising one attribute by 5. Such is the price of specialization. Now, which attribute would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.3: To increase your strength attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.4: To increase your agility attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.5: To increase your endurance attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.6: To increase your intelligence attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.7: To increase your wisdom attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.8: If you wish to increase your main attributes more later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.0: I am the one called Caplan.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.1: I am here to help you increase your elemental "powers" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your elemental powers. These directly reflect your spellcasting ability in each of the elements. The elemental powers you can increase are "fire", "water", "air", "earth", "light" and "dark". Note that the higher you decide to push an elemental power, the more costly in energy the process will be. For example, raising all your elemental powers by 5 costs much less energy than raising one elemental power by 30. Such is the price of specialization. Now, which power would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.3: To increase your fire power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.4: To increase your water power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.5: To increase your air power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.6: To increase your earth power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.7: To increase your light power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.8: To increase your dark power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.9: If you wish to increase your elemental powers again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.0: I am the one called Delaan.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.1: I am here to help you increase your elemental "resistances" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your elemental resistances. These directly reflect your defensive abilities against each of the elements. The elemental resistances you can increase are "fire", "water", "air", "earth" and "dark". Each and every increase in your elemental resistances costs the same amount of energy. Now, which resistance would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.3: To increase your fire resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.4: To increase your water resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.5: To increase your air resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.6: To increase your earth resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.7: To increase your dark resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.8: If you wish to increase your elemental resistances again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.0: I am the one called Epilan.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.1: I am here to help you increase your maximum "health" and "mana" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.2: To increase your maximum health by 10, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc5.3: To increase your maximum mana by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc5.4: If you wish to increase your maximum health or mana again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.1: Me Morgrath, me very strong. *snort* Me see, me kill.
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.10: Morgrath sometimes have weird "scribble-papers" from Master Jarko. *snort* Not know how to read, so Morgrath drop or give them.
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.11: Jarko call them scroll, you want scribble-paper from *snort* Morgrath?
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.12: Uhh... *grunt* Morgrath give you magic scribble-paper if give Morgrath big glum sword. You agree with that?
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.13: Me see you again, me kill! *snort*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.2: "Jarko" pay me. Great gold he pay. *snort*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.3: Powerful wizard he is. *snort* Me listen him or him be maaaaaaad... *grunt*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.4: He very strong, but me better. *grunt*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.5: *snort*.. H... He scary. Me don't like him. *grunt*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.6: They stupid, they attack me. *snort* But me attack them. *grunt* They run. *snort* Fast!
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.7: Goblins are weak, but orc are *snort*... stronger.. Much stronger!
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.8: Morgrath not have pretty stone. Morgrath was attacked by mean brigands. Took pretty rock from Morgrath. Too many of them. Morgrath could not do anything. Asarr has rock. Master Jarko will be mad at Morgrath. Mad! Mad! *grunt* *snort*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.9: *snort* Lighthaven is small human town like Windhowl. *grunt*
npc.topic.resha.0: I have no time for chit-chats.
npc.topic.resha.3: Forget about quests! What are you doing with "Bows" "of" "Centaur" "Slaying"?!?
npc.topic.resha.4: *grumble* Yeah, I know of him. I went to him to ascend, a long time ago, but I did not succeed the challenges he put before me, so I returned here as a guard. Hope you'll have better luck!
npc.topic.resha.5: My duty is to enforce the law and protect the citizens of Stonecrest from harm.
npc.topic.resha.6: He should be hanged and his entrails should be given to the bears in the forest.
npc.topic.resha.7: Did you know that Makrsh P'Tangh the Lich used to be an elven prince? He sure doesn't look like an elf anymore. They say that he is cursed but I am not sure it is a curse to have such awesome powers.
npc.topic.resha.8: I'll teach you some good manners.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.0: I'm called Reynen Aspicdart, but most people used to call me '"The" "Dart"' back in my *ahem* earlier career.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.1: Right now, I'm looking for a way out of this cave, but the illusions keep on bringing me back here. Bloody darn annoying, if y'ask me. But if you're asking what I used to do for a living, I was a con artist. I've reformed, though, so you don't have to worry right now.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.2: That's what they used to call me, back when I was a younger, more dashing rogue and hero. Now, I'm just Reynen, and I'd like nothing more than to get out of this cavern...
