npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.5: Heh heh... I'm sorry, I forgot to mention that the chest could be locked...
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.6: What is the problem with the chest?
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.8: Keep this up and you'll end up losing more than money! *smile*
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.9: If you ever find a map of this cave, don't forget to bring it to me.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.0: The name is Rhodar Heatforge but people usually call me Rhodar.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.10: Brownbark is a woodcutter who lives somewhere in Ravenwood with his son, Anrak.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.11: Bane Blackblood wants to rule over the island of Raven's Dust but he won't as "King" "Theodore" "XIII"'s guards are using my weapons. *smile*
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.12: I heard he won the throne by sleeping. I wish I could do the same.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.14: Althea is the name of the world in which you are.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.15: Do not be afraid to come back to my shop if you need anything else.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.2: I am the weaponsmith of the village. I forge all my weapons myself from ore obtained in the mountains.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.3: You want to buy something, is that it?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.4: Wait a minute! Lemme see that hammer you have... hey, that's mine!!! How did you find it?! Ah.. Qardos.. that wretched blackguard... of course! If I was a bit younger, I swear I'd put this hammer to good use. Now, will you give it back to me?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.5: Hey, you've killed %u goblins, right? Looks like you hate them as much as I do. Come with me in the back of the store, I've got something to show you that might be useful. Look at this beautiful sword, it's a Goblin Slayer sword. It has the uncanny ability of literally destroying goblins. It's yours if you're willing to pay the fair price of 25000 gold pieces. Does that sound fair to you?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.6: The desert of "Vulture's" "Den" is nearly as hot as my forge. You shouldn't go there or I'll lose yet another good customer.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.7: That's the name of the desert on the west part of the island.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.8: What do you want to sell?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.9: I would not go there if I were you. Unless you're wielding one of my great weapons of course.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.0: I'm not sure about the magical properties of the Ring of the Seraph but I'll make a wild guess and say that it protects its wearer against harm.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.1: The name is Roen Greenleaf but Roen will do just fine.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.2: I hunt the wild animals in the forest when I have need of sustenance. I've also learned how to use the forest's vast resources to my advantage. For instance, I know how to mend my wounds using plants and roots found in the forest. If you want, I could "show" you how it's done.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.3: You need %u more levels, %u more intelligence and %u more wisdom to learn first aid.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.4: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.6: The young pup bares its fangs, eh? The old wolf will teach you some manners!
npc.topic.rolph.0: My name is Rolph, I am the greatest armorer around!
npc.topic.rolph.1: I own the best armor shop in all of "Goldmoon"! Although nowadays, with those damned "goblins", I'm not selling much.
npc.topic.rolph.10: I buy and sell armor. Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" any?
npc.topic.rolph.11: I forge the toughest armors in all of "Goldmoon"! Which one do you want?
npc.topic.rolph.12: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.rolph.13: Feel free to visit my shop again!
npc.topic.rolph.2: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.rolph.3: Balork's curse? That's horrible! Hmmm... Are sure you don't want to "buy" something?
npc.topic.rolph.4: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust", and I can tell you, you won't find a better armorer than me on any of these islands! Well, actually, maybe on Raven's Dust and the town of Windhowl too... Oh well.
npc.topic.rolph.5: It's the island where the castle of Theodore XIII is located.
npc.topic.rolph.6: Aye, that's the name of this island. It is home to the towns of Lighthaven and Windhowl.
npc.topic.rolph.7: Goblins... They are everywhere now! Some small groups sometimes succeed in passing Windhowl's defenses and terrorize the citizens. Usually, they get killed by brigands, or by our great guards, whom, I might add, are all equipped with gear from my fabulous shop.
npc.topic.rolph.8: You're still in Lighthaven? It is imperative that you deliver the report I gave you to Lord Sunrock's as soon as possible.
npc.topic.rolph.9: The lord's office is at the east side of town.
npc.topic.rondy.0: Ah'm the town's farmer. I have the uneasy yet rewarding task of tending t' my field and animals.
npc.topic.rondy.1: Ah'm Rondy, the best farmer you'll ever see in the East. No wheat can resist fer long t'my scythe and I.
npc.topic.rondy.10: I don't see why ya would want t' play m'ah game fer now.
npc.topic.rondy.11: Out of my sight or I'll make ya eat manure!
npc.topic.rondy.3: Ah'm a farmer allright. Ya can see the crops behind m'ah house.
npc.topic.rondy.4: Ah'm very proud of m'ah farm.
npc.topic.rondy.5: Ravenwood forest is cursed I tell ya. Mayhaps the "druids" will be able t' do somethin' 'bout it.
npc.topic.rondy.6: The druids' camp is located west of the town.
npc.topic.rondy.7: Oy! Methinks nothin' could grow there. Not enough water ya know.
npc.topic.rondy.9: I have absolutely no idea 'bout what ya are talkin'.
npc.topic.rylethcth.0: My name? Ignorant! I am R'yleth Cth and may you not forget it. I don't have time to babble while there is still so much work to "do".
npc.topic.rylethcth.1: Surely you jest! I am the greatest mage in this town, and maybe even in all of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.rylethcth.5: Yes, researching new spells is a long and tiresome task, and as endless as time. Moreover, I have to "teach" would-be mages the great art, which is consuming much of my time.
npc.topic.rylethcth.6: Goldmoon is the kingdom which contains the islands of Raven's Dust and Arakas. Although it is a big kingdom, I am probably the highest ranking and most powerful mage in all of it.
npc.topic.rylethcth.7: Don't tell me you need to learn new spells? I'm rather busy at the moment, perhaps you should come back later.
npc.topic.safe.2: The safe's combination is composed of 3 numbers that can be anywhere between 1 and 100 inclusively. To rotate the safe's wheel, you can type {RIGHT} 10 to rotate the wheel 10 numbers to the right or type {LEFT} if you wish to rotate it in the opposite direction.
npc.topic.safe.3: If you wish to rotate the wheel to the right, you must provide a number. For example, you could type RIGHT 10 and you would rotate the wheel to the right by 10 numbers.
npc.topic.safe.4: If you wish to rotate the wheel to the left, you must provide a number. For example, you could type LEFT 10 and you would rotate the wheel to the left by 10 numbers.
npc.topic.samilalgder.0: I am called Samil Algder, and I am pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.samilalgder.1: My work, if it can be called that, is to follow the path set by "Artherk". I also have the task to bless our "troops" before they go into  a confrontation, and to attend to their wounds when they come back.
npc.topic.samilalgder.10: Druids can be very powerful, but they don't follow the true path of good. I do not dislike their ways, but I'd rather become a great priest.
npc.topic.samilalgder.11: May Artherk protect you in your visions.
npc.topic.samilalgder.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.samilalgder.3: I knew her well, that Annabelle. Lovelier than an Elf--not that I know what Elves look like, they left this world a long, long time ago. But yes, you'd love to meet her...
npc.topic.samilalgder.4: Yes, we have a rather big army here in Windhowl, but we need all the troops we can find, for the "goblins" are relentless in their assaults. As a result, our troops need godly blessing before they go into combat, to help them fight longer and harder.
npc.topic.samilalgder.5: The goblins are becoming increasingly deadly nowadays. I know not by what sadistic means they have accomplished it, but some of them have been seen wielding magical weapons!
npc.topic.samilalgder.7: He's the Archbishop of this church.
npc.topic.samilalgder.8: I spend most of my time with the troops, but another priest will gladly help you.
npc.topic.samilalgder.9: Artherk is a kind and just god. I would follow him beyond the edge of the world if I had to.
npc.topic.samuel.0: I have no time to spare for this.
npc.topic.samuel.10: You have already helped us. However, you should know that it is futile to fight the dead. The dark soul of the Death Jester simply have to enter another one of the many skeletal corpses in the dungeon to revive once more to trouble our nights.
npc.topic.samuel.11: I am not sure who told you about my special hobby but I do enjoy creating various objects in wax such as candles, fruits, etc.
npc.topic.samuel.12: I have nothing to say about that poison-brewing witch.
npc.topic.samuel.13: Why would you want to know how to create poison?
npc.topic.samuel.14: The king has request some animal skin from you and you need someone to have it tanned? Let me see... hmmm.. I think that Drardos might be the man for the task.
npc.topic.samuel.15: He operates a small shop somewhere in the town.
npc.topic.samuel.16: I could have called the guards to throw you in the "prison" for such filthy words.
npc.topic.samuel.3: I should have you thrown out of the castle or even in the "prison" for your impoliteness!
npc.topic.samuel.4: I am the "King"'s advisor. I help him in the decision-making process.
npc.topic.samuel.5: What? How can you not know our great King "Theodore" the XIIIth? You must be a beggar then!
npc.topic.samuel.6: You will address his Majesty by his rightful title.
npc.topic.samuel.7: We don't get any unusual visitors in the castle! Well, now that you mention it, you look rather strange.
npc.topic.samuel.8: This is the castle of King Theodore XII.
npc.topic.samuel.9: The prison under the Castle is no longer in use. Dark creatures led by a malevolent being that goes by the name of "Death" "Jester" have taken over. We thought it was easier to simply condemn the prison rather than attempting to fight the de.. Hmmmm. I mean them...
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.0: You spoke the word of power and I am therefore instructed to let you pass. However, I must first warn you of the dangers you will face. Even though the God of Corruption is no more, its dreadful influence can still be felt throughout the endless corridors of the tainted sanctuary. You will encounter Gluriurl's followers who were once entombed alive and who are still devoted to him, even in their unlife. Thus, I must ask you if you still desire access to this foul place?
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.1: I have been given the task of guarding the mausoleum's entrance.
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.2: I see not why this would concern you.
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.4: I am here to guard the gate, not to provide answers.
npc.topic.scholar1.0: Excuse me? Ahh that's easy. That is elven for "To" "look" "upon" "one's" "self".
npc.topic.scholar1.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar2.0: Eh? Ahh that's easy. That is dwarven for "One" "must" "only" "have" "eyes".
npc.topic.scholar2.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar3.0: I beg your pardon? Ahh that's easy. That is fey for "To" "recognize" "one's" "own" "ignorance".
npc.topic.scholar3.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar4.0: What did you just say? Ahh that's easy. That is dragon for "One" "must" "open" "these" "eyes".
npc.topic.scholar4.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.0: I go by the name of Seban Forgelot.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.2: You haven't heard of the great Seban? Fine, I will tell you then. I make the very best "weapons" you'll find anywhere on this island. I forge them in my "workshop" and then sell them to whoever I meet in my travels. I'm sure you will want to "buy" some of them.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.3: I will never reveal the location of my secret workshop to a simpleton like you!
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.4: Of course you want to buy, who wouldn't? Will you take a look at my selection?
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.5: Truly, I have the very best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Feel free to look around and "buy" what you like!
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.6: I don't see what you could possibly have to offer me, but I'll oblige you anyway.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.7: Alright then, no need to stay around me any longer, off you go now!
npc.topic.shadeen.0: I'm Shadeen, sometimes just called The Dagger for flavor.
npc.topic.shadeen.1: I don't really work, I've got other people to do that for me. Let's say I'm... a businesswoman.
npc.topic.shadeen.10: You want to know more? Sure, why not. They're a group of discreet necromancers who are working for some powerful evil overlord. If you've met necromancers before, you can bet they were "not" members of the Obsidian Conclave. The Obsidian Wizards are discreet and almost never reveal themselves to the non-initiates. It took me twenty years to learn this, so you'd better be grateful.
npc.topic.shadeen.11: Well, that was good work, got to admit it. Clever idea, that apple thing, got to hand it to you.
npc.topic.shadeen.12: Who? Who did you say? Kalastor? I... don't know what you're talking about. Hey, you strike me as a helpful kinda
npc.topic.shadeen.13: You're really a curious one, aren't you? Sure, Elves existed a long time ago, even if people are starting to believe they're just a fairy tale. Fact is--"LISTEN" "CAREFULLY", "HERE"--there are Elves left in the world, but they're mad and very, very hard to find.
npc.topic.shadeen.14: Menark is a chronicler who works in the town's library with his assistant, "Jeremiah". According to my sources, Menark has something quite valuable that I'd like to get my hands on.
npc.topic.shadeen.15: You might say that he is Menark's eyes and ears. He has the never-ending task of witnessing what happens and to report everything back to "Menark".
npc.topic.shadeen.16: Doremas is but a fool. However, he follows the orders much better than someone like "Baldric" "Silverknife" who is simply too impredictable.
npc.topic.shadeen.17: He's a real talented young man gifted with a loud mouth and a taste for troubles. He is too reckless for my taste, that is why I deal only with his henchman, "Doremas".
npc.topic.shadeen.18: The Chronicles of Doom relate of the forgotten events that occurred during the First Coming. "Menark", the grumpy old chronicler who lives in Raven's Dust, is known to have a copy of that precious document in his possession... I ABSOLUTELY NEED THIS BOOK, NO MATTER WHAT!!! I can assure you that Menark guards it preciously, I've never been able to wrest it from him.
npc.topic.shadeen.19: Heh, it looks like I have no more missions for you.
npc.topic.shadeen.2: Fair enough. It may not seem like much, but if you ever wish to travel to Stoneheim, you'll need to perform a magical ritual to get there, since no boat ever goes that far. For that, you must own a magical Silver Feather, and you're in luck, that's just what you get for helping me. Also, now that I *know* you're one of us, I'll let all my contacts know you're working for the darkness, now. That should open you a few doors, but it'll close many others. Thanks again!
npc.topic.shadeen.20: I am truly sorry but Iago Caballero, that meddling knight, is still alive and keeps thwarting my plans. Someone has to get rid of him, otherwise he'll probably find a way to make my next mission fail as well.
npc.topic.shadeen.21: Ha ha ha. You're funny. Kinda young for me, but funny.
npc.topic.shadeen.3: Him? Do you know anything about him? He's not too happy about what I did to him, so it'd probably be wiser *NOT* to mention my name to him. *grin*
npc.topic.shadeen.4: It's another island that lies somewhere west from here. That's where you'll find the Centaurs and the Skraugs. Only the most powerful adventurers can survive there.
npc.topic.shadeen.5: Aaah, Weathergate... I really had good times, there, a long, long time ago. You should try going there, if you've got the guts. Now, *there's* real adventure for you!
npc.topic.shadeen.6: I don't think you're ready to hear about things like that. Better move on.
npc.topic.shadeen.7: You're not ready to hear about this yet.
npc.topic.shadeen.8: The plan is quite simple. To be able to get "Menark"'s "Chronicles" "of" "Doom", you must create a diversion elsewhere in the town. To do this, you will need an accomplice that you trust for he will probably save your life. Give the "scroll" "of" "evil" "deed" to your accomplice. Then, he or she must meet "Doremas" for further instructions. If your friend succeeds in his or her mission, then you'll have the way clear for Menark during a short period of precious time. Good luck.
npc.topic.shadeen.9: Well, seeing as you've been pretty helpful so far, I guess I could give you a bit of information. There's something called the Obsidian Conclave, a group of dark wizards that are keeping themselves busy with some world-threatening nefarious plot. Now, if you want to know more, you'll have to do a few evil deeds and grow three more times in power.
npc.topic.shadow.0: I don't think my name matters to you!
npc.topic.shadow.3: I'm not cursed, therefore it does not concern me.
npc.topic.shadow.4: Who told you my name? No matter. I suppose you want me to "teach" you a skill now. Serves me right for not keeping my identity a secret.
npc.topic.shadow.5: A thief? Where? I don't see any thieves around here!
npc.topic.shadow.6: I guess I could teach you how to "peek" into other people's belongings.
npc.topic.shadow.8: You must look elsewhere for your training...
npc.topic.shadow.9: Very well, enjoy your purse, while you still carry it...
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.0: Da leetle hummie wanto buy alkemi kit?
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.1: Me name go like dis: Weethgwotha.
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.2: Oy is totemherbdoktor. Me teech guud "majicks" tew odder skraug.
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.3: Wut? Yew wan me teech yu guud majicks?
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.4: Yew dew wut yew want, liddle hummie, Weethgwotha nut care.
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.5: Da hentengle spel hold yur enemy wit sticky stuf.
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.6: Da bouldurs spel crush yur enemy wit big rocks. Yu kent lern if yu don have urthquake.
npc.topic.shamanweethgwotha.7: Da tru seit spel make yu see evryting odder dumb hoomans don see. Yu see hiden an invisibull wit dis spel.
npc.topic.sigfried.0: My name is Sigfried, I am the son of "Geirfres" the dwarf!
npc.topic.sigfried.1: I own the best weapons shop in all the nearby lands! I inherited it from my father, "Geirfres".
npc.topic.sigfried.10: Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.sigfried.11: I have the greatest weapons of all! I forge them here myself. Some of them have even been blessed by the monks at the temple, mind you. Would you like to take a look at them?
npc.topic.sigfried.12: Well then, let's see what you have for sale...
npc.topic.sigfried.4: He was the greatest dwarf warrior that ever lived! He killed thousands of goblins each day, even on holidays! He hunted dragons for fun, and fought gods in his spare time! And don't you dare think that I am lying, because I have a dragon's "tooth" to prove it. I'm sure you envy him. After all, who wouldn't? If you want to honor his memory, go out and kill as many goblins as you can!
npc.topic.sigfried.5: You do not have to rub it in. You know of my shameless scam. I won't try to fool you again. The teeth I have are actually tiger's teeth. Still, they might be useful... Hmm... Well... Do you want to buy one tiger's tooth for 200 gold pieces?
npc.topic.sigfried.6: This tooth serves as a reminder of the great many feats my father accomplished. For a modest fee, I will be willing to "part" with it...
npc.topic.sigfried.7: You again? What are you waiting for delivering my report to Lord Sunrock? I surely hope that you have not lost my report because if so, I will not supply you a new one and you can say goodbye to Lord Sunrock's reward.
npc.topic.sigfried.8: The lord's office is at the east side of town.
npc.topic.sigfried.9: Perhaps you should go and have a look at it. Be careful you don't go there at night though.
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.0: Har! I am Red Beard, pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.1: I work for "Harock" Harr. I take care of the ship when he's gone drinking or when he goes out at sea.
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.3: Har! I've heard of this lady, but never saw her myself. Har! Har!
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.4: Hardy har! He's quite a strong fella! He's the greatest sailor of all time, just ask him about stories, and he'll tell you quite a few about his old days. Har! He taught me all I know about sailing!
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.5: There aren't many left these days. Must have all gone to the "Lost" "Islands".
npc.topic.skipperredbeard.6: It is said that there is nothing on those islands. But I was just wondering if it's a trick, har! Could make a good hiding place with all the fog around them.
npc.topic.taliron.2: I make the strongest and most durable "armor" around these parts!
npc.topic.taliron.3: I would show you what I have for sale, but it is rather late. Come back tomorrow.
npc.topic.taliron.4: You should come back during the day, we're closed at night.
npc.topic.taliron.5: I haven't seen anyone like that, maybe Belagan can tell you more.
npc.topic.taliron.6: His shop is just around the corner.
npc.topic.taliron.7: I don't know anything about a sword. I only deal in armor.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.0: Hello! How may I help you?
npc.topic.talonirongaze.1: I am the guardian of the royal "treasury".
npc.topic.talonirongaze.10: If you wish to deposit gold pieces in the Raven's Dust bank, you'll have to tell me how many you wish to deposit. Just tell me 'deposit <x> gold' where x is the amount of gold pieces you wish to deposit. Or perhaps you would like to verify your "balance" or even "withdraw" gold from the "bank".
npc.topic.talonirongaze.11: If you want to withdraw gold pieces from your account, you will have to tell me 'withdraw <x> gold' where x is the amount of gold pieces you want to withdraw.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.2: What the hell are you babbling about?
npc.topic.talonirongaze.3: I have always been rather fond of tigers.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.4: King Theodore does not much care about his wealth. Hopefully, I am here to ensure that his kingdom does not crumble to dust.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.5: The desert? That's not place I'd want to live.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.6: Perhaps you might want to "deposit" a few gold pieces in the royal treasure chamber? It will be safe there.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.7: I go by the name of Talon Irongaze.
npc.topic.talonirongaze.9: You have %u gold pieces in your account.
npc.topic.tarnian.0: Gunthar told me he sold the stone to some merchant by mistake. That was before he knew of the stone's "worth".
npc.topic.tarnian.1: I'm not talking about it's worth in gold. The stone is a representation of the heart of "Gluriurl". It is the key to entering another temple, where you will find the "skull" of the dead god.
npc.topic.tarnian.10: Olin Haad thinks he can just take this town by force. I'm here to see that doesn't happen.
npc.topic.tarnian.2: All I know on the subject is what Gunthar told me, which I am sure is what he told you.
npc.topic.tarnian.3: We need the skull in order to discover the one who's hiding behind the curtain of blood. I'm not interested in legends and the rising of an ancient god, but rather in the "one" responsible for the recent killings.
npc.topic.tarnian.4: The one I'm after killed my only "son"... Gunthar believes that the one responsible for the "murders" is connected to Olin Haad.
npc.topic.tarnian.5: The bastard took my son and sacrificed him in a ritual! I swear, when I find him, he will pay with his life! I will scatter his entrails to the four corners of the world!
npc.topic.tarnian.6: People have started disappearing recently only to be found days later, dismembered and lying in a pentagram of some sort. Gunthar believes that the one responsible for these gruesome murders is the same insane "fanatic" that wants to revive Gluriurl.
npc.topic.tarnian.7: That's why we need your help. I must remain here to defend the town so you must get the skull yourself. If Gunthar "believes" in you, then I will do the same.
npc.topic.tarnian.8: Here, take this. To reach the Nameless Bard, you will need to travel to Raven's Dust. This stone tablet is the key to reaching "Raven's" "Dust" without Olin Haad knowing about it.
npc.topic.terwin.0: You will address me as Sir Terwin.
npc.topic.terwin.2: I am a member of the "king"'s personal "guards".
npc.topic.terwin.3: Don't think that I am as soft-hearted as those two weaklings at the front gate.
npc.topic.terwin.4: Well! I see you have one such potion on yourself! Would you care to part with it?
npc.topic.terwin.5: Oh, you mean *those* keys?!? *Arumph* I do not believe a "honest" guard such as me would discuss these matters with a peon like you.
npc.topic.terwin.7: That's right, I'm a *very* strict and honest guard! Can't bribe me, no sir-ree!
npc.topic.terwin.8: If I ever find that you have come to bear his majesty ill-will, you will regret ever setting foot in this castle.
npc.topic.terwin.9: I don't have time for this.
npc.topic.thea.10: That's the other island in the Kingdom of Goldmoon. Many adventurers seem to come from there. They often move on to Stoneheim or return to Arakas.
npc.topic.thea.11: Seems like there's trouble brewing in the world, these days. My father always used to talk about how heroes would rise to save the world when the end would come... Maybe we're getting so many heroes because the world's about to come to an end.
npc.topic.thea.12: Oh, now I remember!! That's what my daddy used to call the end of the world!
npc.topic.thea.13: You're standing on it! Pretty neat, eh?
npc.topic.thea.14: Like I said, just find a seat and I'll be right with you. Right now, I have to get back to work.
npc.topic.thea.15: We get many folks in here, some strangers, and others a just locals. We get too many strangers in a day for me to single one out for you.
npc.topic.thea.2: Well, if you'll just "sit" down somewhere, I'll show you what my work is.
npc.topic.thea.3: Well if you want me to bring you a "drink" or something, you have to sit down!
npc.topic.thea.4: Yes, I guess it's true what they say... I really don't mean to pry into people's affairs, but it's kind of hard to *not* hear what they say when I wait their tables... Anyway, I tend to know a lot about what happens in these parts.
npc.topic.thea.5: Royal keys, royal keys... I might know something, but I'm not too sure. Perhaps you could return at a time when I've got more time to chat?
npc.topic.thea.6: We don't sell any of that stuff here, sorry.
npc.topic.thea.7: Um... I *think* she went back to Arakas, but I see so many people come and go, I wouldn't know for sure. I guess you'll have to go find out yourself.
npc.topic.thea.8: This is the island of Raven's Dust. The Kingdom of Goldmoon also comprises the island of Arakas. There is another islands northwest from here, but I don't really know where it is. I believe it's called Stoneheim.
npc.topic.thea.9: I don't know much about it, except that it's one of the *biggest* cities in the world. Oh, and I hear the weather around it is really bad, so that's why there are never any boats to and from there.
npc.topic.thelurker.0: I go by the name 'The Lurker'. It is the only name you need to know.
npc.topic.thelurker.1: If you think you are skilled enough, I could try to "teach" you some new tricks. Of course, everything comes at a price.
npc.topic.thelurker.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.thelurker.3: Have you been cursed too by that Balork?
npc.topic.thelurker.4: Looks like I can't teach you anything new, but I can help you "train" your dodging skills instead.
npc.topic.thelurker.6: Asarr really sent you to me? You do not look like a thief to me, but who am I to argue with the leader of the brigands. The market of shadows is, in reality, a black market where we sell the goods we have stolen. Ttayh Mark controls the black market in WindHowl. Meet him at his shop and he will grant you access.
npc.topic.thelurker.7: But why should I know something like that?
npc.topic.theopold.0: We are the "tormented" spirit of King Theopold.
npc.topic.theopold.1: We cannot rest knowing that our cowardly and unworthy son sits on our throne, and that our kingdom stands on the brink of chaos and destruction. There are "terrible" "events" set in motion, and we are restless just thinking about it.
npc.topic.theopold.10: If you wish to return whence you came, just say the word.
npc.topic.theopold.2: I give no hints. Find the answers to these riddles or return to your world. Perhaps someone there will be able to give you "riddle" "hints".
npc.topic.theopold.3: We do no work since we are made of ether. We do have "riddles", however, and you must answer those if you wish to proceed further.
npc.topic.theopold.4: Thou know our riddles already, we might as well let thee pass. Are thou ready?
npc.topic.theopold.5: AH! We are shocked! Very well, if thou know all the answers, we must keep our word and send you further along. Art thou ready?
npc.topic.theopold.6: You are truly very intelligent, or someone has fed you those answers! Let us proceed with the next "riddle", shall we? {You} {receive} {10,000} {XPs} {as} {a} {reward}.
npc.topic.theopold.7: Wonderful! Ha ha! We have not enjoyed ourselves this much since we passed away. Let us proceed with the next "riddle", if thou art ready. {You} {receive} {10,000} {XPs} {as} {a} {reward}.
npc.topic.theopold.8: Yes, that the correct answer. Let us proceed with the next "riddle", if thou art ready. {You} {receive} {10,000} {XPs} {as} {a} {reward}.
npc.topic.theopold.9: We have no tolerance for people such as thou.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.1: How can I be of assistance to you, my friend?
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.10: Mordenthal is a dark knight who worships the god of the night, "Ogrimar". He resides in a fortified keep surrounded by mountains located north of "Stonecrest". This man is very powerful and must not be trusted.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.11: Beltigan is a paladin of Artherk who resides in his castle located south of "Stonecrest". It is him who you should seek if you wish to become a "Lightbringer".
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.12: Dionysus is the proud centaur who acts as a cleric in the small "centaur" "town".
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.13: Nissus Haloseeker is a priest who resides in "Stonecrest".
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.14: The skraugs should not be trusted for they follow the dark path set by "Ogrimar".
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.15: The centaurs resides in a small town on the southern part of the island.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.16: Stonecrest is a town located to the western part of the island.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.17: Stoneheim is the name of this island.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.18: I do not possess the power to bind your spirit here.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.19: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.2: I am a cleric and have dedicated my entire life to Him. I wear this "ring" "of" "pure" "faith" as a symbol of my devotion to Artherk, the god of Light.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.20: I have no time for such nonsense.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.21: Farewell. May Artherk light thy path.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.3: The "centaur" "avengers" stole all the grails of purity I had left. I doubt they'll be willing to give them back to you without a fight.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.4: Even though the centaurs despise us, you have to remember that they are not evil. However, I cannot say the same about the centaur avengers. For all that I know, they might be even working for the vile Zion Thunderheart.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.5: Brother Thorkas resides in the temple dedicated to Artherk in Silversky. Seek him out if you need his assistance.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.6: I wish you good luck on your journey, Lightbringer.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.7: The cursed lich has to be stopped while it is still weak. A mere mortal stands no chance against him but a "Lightbringer" might have a chance of vanquishing him...
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.8: Ogrimar is the nemesis of our god, "Artherk". He is the god of the night and represents everything that I stand against.
npc.topic.theoranironfaith.9: Artherk is the god of Light. It is He who you should turn for counsel when all odds seem to be against you.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.0: I am Thorbin Wildheart, "bartender" and owner of this fair "tavern".
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.1: Yes, Thorbin Wildheart is the name.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.10: Ravenwood is also known as the forest of the damned. Why you ask me? I don't really know but you should stay within the limits of the city of Silversky. If you go out of the city, you will leave the protection of King Theodore's royal guards.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.11: The Vulture's Den desert is located on the western part of the island of "Raven's" "Dust". The desert is a harsh environment and very few living creatures are able to survive there. Deadly scorpions, sand worms and sand crawlers are some of the inhabitants that you may encounter.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.12: For 250 gold pieces, I'll tell you about your karma. That comes with a beer, a good meal and lodging for the night, so it's not a total waste. Will you pay?
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.13: Get out of my tavern at once or I'll kick your... you know what!
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.14: Until we meet again my friend.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.2: I am the bartender of this modest tavern. If it weren't for this lowlife "Baldric" "Silverknife" disturbing my customers with his horrible songs, perhaps this tavern would be more popular.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.3: You've been able to get Baldric's drum? No need to tell me how you did that stunt. Do ya want to give it to me so I can bury it six feet under?
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.4: I have nothing to say about that poison-brewing witch.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.5: This tavern is usually frequented by "sailors" and "adventurers" in search for a good mug of ale.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.6: Sailors are good lads but they are somewhat noisy when they're drunk.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.7: Do you wish to buy a good mug of home brewed ale for only 10 gold pieces?
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.8: "Buy" him a few beers and you'll have a friend for life.
npc.topic.thorbinwildheart.9: Adventurers often come to my tavern. I don't know why they come by so often but I always welcome them with a good mug of ale. Once they're dead drunk, I usually can make them gamble fair amounts of money. Hehehe!
npc.topic.thorglarefire.0: Lance Silversmith is a former pupil of mine who now lives somewhere in Arakas.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.1: Mordenthal is one of your kin who has chosen the path of dark.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.10: Seeing as how I am very busy, I would appreciate it if you would make up your mind on what you wish to buy. My wares are of the finest quality, you know.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.11: A customer eh? Very well, but make it brief. I did not make all these wonderful weapons by watching customers you know.Well then, will you take a look at what I have to sell?
npc.topic.thorglarefire.12: You are keeping me from my work, you know. This had better be good.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.13: Leave this place now before you disgrace yourself any further!
npc.topic.thorglarefire.14: At least you were not a total waste of my time. Don't come back unless you want to buy something else!
npc.topic.thorglarefire.2: Amongst my people, I am known as Thor of the iron arm, but you may call me Thor Glarefire.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.3: Yes, that is my name. What may I do for you?
npc.topic.thorglarefire.4: He's our lord and liege, and we owe him loyalty and obedience. If you've got a problem with that, get out of my shop.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.5: Scum like him shouldn't be allowed to stay among us. We all know he is a traitor, but our king refuses to break the law just to have him executed. But we will wait patiently for the day he makes a mistake, and *then* we will have him judged for his crimes.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.6: He's my best customer! If there were more people like him, I wouldn't be a pauper! Heh heh... I'm kidding, Kyathos has made me a fairly well-to-do fellow, really. I can't complain.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.7: He's a little weepy for my taste, but I can't find much fault with him. We're grateful to have him when trouble starts brewing.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.8: There isn't much to talk about. Actually, that's all there is to TALK about. That's all he does, talk, *talk*, TALK! He's a big talker, but I've yet to see him in action. So yes, I think he's all smoke and no fire.
npc.topic.thorglarefire.9: It's just a matter of time before he becomes a regular customer of mine, just like Kyathos. Gladdius professes his belief in skill over equipment, but I know with Kyathos bragging about how good he is, Gladdius will eventually cave in and start buying my equipment.
npc.topic.tobias.1: That's right, Tobias is my name.
npc.topic.tobias.2: You know it's quite rude to call someone by their last name!
npc.topic.tobias.3: I travel the world in search of "books" to add to my "collection".
npc.topic.tobias.4: You are interested in seeing my collection? Well, feel free to look around. Oh, and don't forget to have a look at the incredible "Book" "of" "Warfare" , a favorite of mine.
npc.topic.tobias.5: Oh, yes, indeed, I had one such key a long time ago. Got it from a noble destitute whose name I can't recall--was it Sir Gothar? I can never remember. Anyway, I kept that lovely key for a few years, until Celestina Waterbreeze traded it for a Book of Feylor. You should probably ask her.
npc.topic.tobias.6: I do indeed have such a book, in fact, I have several copies of it. I sometimes sell them for 15,000 gold pieces. Would you care to purchase one?
npc.topic.tobias.7: You would be surprised at the amount of books that exist around the world.
npc.topic.tobias.8: Is there a particular book that you are looking for?
npc.topic.torgas.2: I am the bartender and owner of this tavern.
npc.topic.torgas.3: It is a pity that she does not come here more often. I'm sure she'd attract more customers around here.
npc.topic.torgas.4: Heh heh... You're not the first to ask and I'm sure you're not going to be the last. In these troubled times, many people seek him, I hear. Anyway, to make a short story long, I really wish I could help you locate him, but I've hardly any idea where you should start looking. Perhaps you could ask around? Perhaps the old gypsy could help you on your quest? Sorry, I should go, I hear a customer calling... Let's say "goodbye", okay?
npc.topic.torgas.5: I wish I could help you, but I'm no seer. If that's what you're looking for, why don't you check with the old fortune-teller? I think her name is Yolangda or something... Rumor has it she's good... and very expensive.
npc.topic.torgas.6: I can smell cheap ale all over you. I think you've had enough to drink for the day.
npc.topic.torgas.7: Feel free to come back whenever you want.
npc.topic.totak.1: I am a brigand, what else? I enjoy making "wagers" with my friends. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.totak.2: If you really want to gamble gold pieces with me, you will have to tell me how many you wish to risk. For example, if you would like to to put one hundred gold pieces on the table, simply say 'gamble 100 gold' and I'll throw a piece in the air. If it falls on heads, you will win double what you gambled, else you lose your bet. Quite simple my friend don't you think? If your wager seems too high, I simply will not accept it because I do not want you to be a wandering beggar. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.trackerooglathraaglurh.1: Oogla smash skraugs frum odder tribe reel guud.
npc.topic.trackerooglathraaglurh.2: Time tew dew sum boom-boom on hummie metinks!
npc.topic.trackerooglathraaglurh.3: Wut? Hummie wan to have my skull? Har har har! Very funny. Oogla tinks hummie will never have "enuf" treasur to buy skull from Oogla!
npc.topic.trackerooglathraaglurh.4: Har har! If hummie bring Oogla tew "villain" "skulls" an tew "scrolls" "of" "hate", mebbe Oogla give hummie Skull of Evil.
npc.topic.trackerooglathraaglurh.5: Oogla happy yew go. Hummie smell nut guud.
npc.topic.tristan.0: As I was saying, I was walking down a path on a wilderness trek when I spotted a band of rude men clad in obsidian robes "digging" up some remains.
npc.topic.tristan.1: Yes, two of them dug the ground using shovels. After awhile they finally uncovered a corpse... and it bore wings on its back just like yours! Then they loaded their caravan with the remains and went further east along with a band of heavily mercenaries and spellslingers. Do you think the corpse could possibly be one of your kin? Anyway, as much as I enjoy your company, I must now return to my chores.
npc.topic.tristan.2: So, the leader of the band was a man named Mordred? It's nice to hear again from you and your adventures but I'm not really interested quite frankly.
npc.topic.tristan.5: These days, I enjoy walking in the forest even though they are many dangerous creatures out there.
npc.topic.ttayhmark.0: I am Ttayh, the best weaponsmith around! Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.ttayhmark.1: I sell weapons of any sort, and of the "greatest" quality too! They are as sharp as a dragon's claw and can resist rust! You won't find anything better. Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.ttayhmark.10: Our army is indeed a great one. It has prevented the goblin hordes from conquering our kingdom time and again.
npc.topic.ttayhmark.3: I heard she is much older than she appears to be.
npc.topic.ttayhmark.4: Windhowl is such a beautiful town to visit!
npc.topic.ttayhmark.5: I heard that Lord Sunrock would like to receive reports from merchants in Lighthaven.
npc.topic.ttayhmark.6: I do not know about that. *cough*
npc.topic.ttayhmark.7: Ahh! Buying from me is usually a great investment! You want to see my wares?
npc.topic.ttayhmark.8: You want me to take some of the weapons off your hands? Let's have a look then...
npc.topic.ttayhmark.9: Yes, I forge weapons right here and even supply a part of our "army". My weapon forging skills were only evenly matched by my long lost brother, Lance. I wonder where he could be now.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.2: Balork is lurking in the depth of this dungeon.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.3: I could "heal" your wounds, if it is what you want.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.4: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.5: She is a priestess in the "temple" above.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.6: She is a priestess of Artherk in the "temple" above. She is recruiting adventurers to rescue the poor fools who dared to challenge "Balork".
npc.topic.twinnevanis.7: This was once part of the temple too. But since "Balork" has taken control of the temple, few travel here.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.8: He was once a war-priest of "Artherk" but went insane when he lost his faith.
npc.topic.twinnevanis.9: Artherk does not forgive easily. That is one reason why "Balork" left the brotherhood. During a battle, he had to choose between helping his fallen comrade or inflict revenge on the enemy who had killed him. His anger took control and he went berserk. The battle was won but at a high cost. In his rage, Balork had accidentally killed one of his priests. Shortly after, he was demoted to a normal priest.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.0: I am called Shovanis, the Mage.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.1: I have the gift of "magic" and I will "help" you to the best of my knowledge.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.10: Ha! My brother's doing is it? I never cared about the comings. Don't believe everything you hear, that's what I always say.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.2: Well, there isn't much I can do, other than "teach" you a "spell" or two.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.3: This is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.4: My brother takes care of healing.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.5: Balork is lurking in the depth of this dungeon.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.6: Ahh, so you met my brother already? I hope he was able to help you.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.7: I am the Mage in the family. My brother prefers to worship a god.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.8: Magic can be very dangerous. Power in the hands of those who cannot control it can be a danger to themselves and to those around them.
npc.topic.twinshovanis.9: Who? Aah... You're a believer? I don't believe in any god. I believe in my magic and myself. That is all I need. It is your choice to believe or not in a god. That's what makes my brother and I different.
npc.topic.uranos.0: I am Uranos, guardian of all the knowledge stored inside the mage's "tower" of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.uranos.1: I have the neverending task of collecting information and transcribing it into "books", so that others in search of knowledge may come here to learn. I am somewhat busy currently, I need the last component for my spell, but I do not remember the final "ingredient". I think my friend Marsac Cred in Windhowl knows which one though.
npc.topic.uranos.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.uranos.4: Yes... I wonder what it is...
npc.topic.uranos.5: Ah yes... Bat wings... Now I remember. But you've already helped me my friend!
npc.topic.uranos.6: The towers of magic are places where knowledge is stored. Whatever we find in our travels is written in books that are kept in our library. We can also teach "magic" to those who wish to learn it.
npc.topic.uranos.7: Yes, we have quite a collection here I must say. A few hundred books, at least.
npc.topic.uranos.8: Ah? You are a scholar interested in the ways of magic? Perhaps I could "teach" you a "spell" or two... If I can find the time.
npc.topic.uranos.9: You wish to increase your knowledge of spells? Very well, I shall help you.
npc.topic.urik.0: Yes, simpleton. Have you ever seen your face in a mirror? You adventurers disgust me as much as your average beggar! End of conversation. I will not "discuss" this with you any longer.
npc.topic.urik.1: You want to "bargain" with me? Are you deaf? Hey... what was that? Bah, probably just another beggar. Filthy things, all of them! Anyway, like I was about to say, bargaining with you would be like sharing a bone with a dog and I won't fall to that level!
npc.topic.urik.2: Enough of this! Men, get him!
npc.topic.urik.4: That's all you need to know about me.
npc.topic.urik.5: What does it look like? I'm the master tailor, that's what.
npc.topic.vargus.0: I have already given you the Blood of Ogrimar, what else do you want from me?
npc.topic.vargus.1: I have much need for poisons and toxins of all kinds. If you could bring me 3 vials of "demonic" "blood", 2 "foul" "potions" and 5 vials of "nephil" "spider" "venom", I would be obliged to give you the Blood of Ogrimar.
npc.topic.vargus.10: The Dark Lord of the night has many followers, but I am one of his most devoted servants.
npc.topic.vargus.11: I will not tolerate such language within these temple walls!
npc.topic.vargus.12: I bid you farewell, and a safe journey.
npc.topic.vargus.2: Well, I don't quite know exactly where to find some, but I would imagine it is something used in "tribal" "magic".
npc.topic.vargus.3: Tribal magic is usually used by primitive races such as orcs and skraugs.
npc.topic.vargus.4: I have heard tell that a powerful necromancer has the knowledge to create such atrocious concoctions. I cannot say who or where this person is for the simple reason that I do not know.
npc.topic.vargus.5: This isn't the actual venom of a nephil spider mind you. It is actually the name of a very deadly man-made poison. Julian had a very great potential in the field of alchemy the last time I saw him. Perhaps he could help you with this task.
npc.topic.vargus.6: I believe you can find him in the outskirts of the town of Stonecrest, or possibly even inside.
npc.topic.vargus.7: I am known as Vargus, dark bishop of Ogrimar.
npc.topic.vargus.8: I am here to care for the "temple".
npc.topic.vargus.9: This temple is dedicated to the great Ogrimar.
npc.topic.venadar.0: My name? Urgh... I have been down here for so long... I do not remember what I was called in the world of men.
npc.topic.venadar.1: Hmm... that name sounds vaguely familiar.
npc.topic.venadar.2: There is a strong "presence" of evil in this place. Do you not see what this evil has done to me? I am condemned to remain in this place forever. The only remaining thing for me to do is to prevent others from suffering the same fate.
npc.topic.venadar.3: This is where the "Bones" "of" "Ogrimar" were hidden long ago. Unfortunately, they have long since disappeared from here but the taint of the dark one remains.
npc.topic.venadar.4: The individual left behind a mysterious "ring". I know not if this was by accident or if he intended to leave it behind.
npc.topic.venadar.5: I have already given you the ring! What else do you want from me?
npc.topic.venadar.6: Heed my advice and leave this place.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.0: The foul "Olin" "Haad" has enlisted the mercenaries' aid and they've taken the town under siege ever since. The task which lies ahead is no easy one. You will need to conduct a coordinated attack on the three camps located near Lighthaven's northern. Hopefully, this will eventually attracts the mercenary lieutenants' attention. You will then need to deal with them swiftly. This should force the leader out of his hideout located further north. Be wary that he is a very skillful axeman who fears no one. If you defeat the leader, it should destabilize the mercenaries enough for us to pierce through their defenses. You and all the brave soldiers who participate in his demise can then return here and collect a "reward".
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.1: I've heard of your participation in the mercenary leader's demise. Well done! Here's your reward as promised.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.2: Tarnian Wolfman is the only man capable of stopping "Olin" "Haad" from overthrowing us all. That is the reason why I chose to follow him.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.3: I do my best so that Lighthaven does not fall entirely under "Olin" "Haad"'s control.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.4: Olin Haad is a shrewd and merciless necromancer who has visions of conquest and power. "Tarnian" "Wolfmane" has sworn his life to fight until Olin's demise. So did I.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.5: The name is Vincent Swiftblade to you. As the name implies, I am one of the finest blades around here.
npc.topic.vincentswiftblade.6: I fight for the freedom of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.wardenvortimer.1: I am the keeper of "Madrigan"'s house. If you ever need anything, feel free to ask.
npc.topic.wardenvortimer.2: Maddeus Madrigan was once a peaceful healer. He once left with a party of adventurers, then lost his soul while battling with Makrsh P'Tangh. Sensing he was gradually losing his mind, he tried building a house for mentally ill people, but failed to heal himself before he became stark raving mad.
npc.topic.wardenvortimer.3: I'm afraid your mind is not prepared to enter in "Madrigan"'s house without risking permanent mental injuries.
npc.topic.wardenvortimer.4: You don't have a mad house key to return.
npc.topic.wardenvortimer.5: I have no time for this nonsense.
npc.topic.windhowl_guard.0: I do not have time to talk with you.
npc.topic.windhowl_guard.1: I patrol this town to prevent fights among the citizens.
npc.topic.windhowl_guard.2: I do not have time to talk about women.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.1: My job's to answer any questions you have... Well, almost. I don't know everything, but I try anyway. I'm specialized in travelling, exploration and the "world" in general.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.10: Not the most gentle of fellows, for sure, but one who speaks his mind honestly and defends the interests of the citizens of Windhowl with an iron fist. You may not like him, but you have to respect his resolve. He always has a mission or two to give to people, so perhaps you should visit him and offer your services.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.11: There's one of us Samaritans in almost every city. We answer your questions. Of course, you could always read the manual, but in case you didn't, we're there for you.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.12: Cities are fairly save. On the island of Arakas--where we are right now--you have only two cities: "Lighthaven" and "Windhowl". We don't know much about the other cities in the world.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.13: I don't know much about magic myself, but there are dozens of skilled magicians who can teach you more about it. You just have to ask the right questions, of course. Me, I just know it's got something to do with "Karma", but I've never cared much for magic, so don't ask me any more.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.14: It's like I said, I don't know much about it. Ask someone else, perhaps some wizard...
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.15: Quests, as I'm sure you know by now, abound, and the brave and mighty adventurers such as yourself are never out of work if they wish to undertake them. You just have to know who to ask, what to say and what items or information they need. Also, you should distinguish minor quests the major one. Indeed, there's something tragic happening in the world, and if you really want to do something about it, just visit Balork in the dungeon below the temple in Lighthaven, and you'll know what I mean.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.16: Ooh, big vocabulary, I see... Grow up, willya?
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.17: Thank you for spending some time with an old man. Come again.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.2: It's a shame that so many have been cursed by this fiend from below! I have no cure for you, but perhaps you should seek someone who does. I believe she's long gone from these parts, but Annabelle would surely help you if she knew of your plight.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.3: By now, you're certainly aware that this is the world of Althea, and that you're walking on the island of Arakas in the Kingdom of Goldmoon. I'm paid to sing the merits of our good king, so please don't say anything bad about him. Perhaps I could tell you about the "races" who live here?
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.4: There are several races living in this world. Sages and Loremasters divide them between the Higher Races and the Lesser Races. Of the Higher Races, only humans still walk the world. Both the Elves and the Dwarves are gone, they say. The Lesser Races include the "Goblins" and the "Orcs". For obvious reasons, humans don't get along very well with the Lesser Races.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.5: Goblins are by far smaller than Orcs, but they are also more numerous. They're also more savage and less educated. Orcs aren't very bright, mind you, but they're still a bit more evolved than the Goblins. Me, I'd never give the time of day to either one, I'd just run in the other direction. Those two races are pretty impressive in combat, and I don't have a death wish.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.6: Ah, I see you're a clever one. Few people ask me about this. Yes, some other races speak a different tongue than ours. Take the Orcs, for instance. They call their language Orkentung, or something like that, and if you can make sense of it, you can *really* earn their trust. But then again, who'd want that, eh?
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.7: Hard to pronounce, eh? Well, anyway, if you're really interested, I'll tell you a secret. I know a bit of Orkentung, studied it with an orc who's friendly to humans. Anyway, I'm no expert, but it's not entirely different from our own, just pronounced really weird. For starters, they simplify some letters, like the *th* sounds, which become *d* sounds. Oh, and they don't have the verb *to be*. Pretty strange, wouldn't you say? But that's how they talk.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.8: Lighthaven's not quite as civilized as "Windhowl", but I would think the people are nicer there, and crime isn't as prevalent as it is here. And with all the monsters and bandits roaming the route between here and there, trade has been very bad for them. A real shame, if you ask me.
npc.topic.windhowlsamaritan.9: We're pretty happy with the way "Lord" "Sunrock" has been running things, but even he hasn't been able to rid us of the bandits and monsters. Ah well. Even the mighty can fail, I guess.
npc.topic.windhowlsentry.0: A Seraph called Hel has been plaguing this town for awhile now, abducting people when they wander outside the gates and performing all kinds of twisted forms of torture for the sheer pleasure of it. Unfortunately, I can't leave my post here because I have to make sure no one else wanders outside. That's why I need you to "take" "care" of her for me.
npc.topic.windhowlsentry.1: It is with great honor that I present this reward to you. All the townspeople pitched in, so I hope it's enough.
npc.topic.windhowlsentry.2: I'm here to make sure that no one wanders outside the gates.

npc.topic.worldwildhorse.0: I am a horse. Don't mind my talking, that's just the way I am. Some call me the World Wild Horse. Personally, I think it's a stupid name.
npc.topic.worldwildhorse.1: I travel around the world. As long as you have Scrolls of Horse Friendship, I can teleport you to one of many "teleport" "locations" around the world, but it will cost you a scroll every time.
npc.topic.worldwildhorse.2: Well, so long and thanks for all the scrolls
npc.topic.woundedguard.0: My name? Who cares about names when you are in such "pain" as I am!
npc.topic.woundedguard.1: I've seen her near the troll. She tried to stop him from hurting me... and he obeyed!!
npc.topic.woundedguard.2: Do not talk me about your... *urrrgh* problems... I have my own as you... aah... see!
npc.topic.woundedguard.3: I am... glad... you took care of him... arrrh!
npc.topic.woundedguard.4: The... "troll" did this to me... argh!
npc.topic.woundedguard.5: Do... I look like... urgh... somebody who can still... arrrh... work?
npc.topic.xanth.0: If you have gathered all the necessary elements, you can hand them over to me and I will combine them right away. Do you want me to make a foul potion now?
npc.topic.xanth.1: Bloodlust is a blood-sucking giant worm rumored to reside somewhere on the southern part of the island of Stoneheim. Few people have ever seen it, and even fewer have lived to tell the tale.
npc.topic.xanth.2: You want me to see if I can find anything useful about this ring? Very well... hmm, this is very strange. I believe I have been in contact with this ring before. If I am not mistaken, it might belong to someone I know. Would you like to know who that is?
npc.topic.xanth.3: If you do not know my name, then you have no business here!
npc.topic.xanth.4: That is none of your concerns.
npc.topic.xanth.5: So you have a letter for me, is that right? Give it to me then. {Xanth} {runs} {his} {fingers} {over} {the} {scroll}. I see, so you would have me enchant this blade of yours eh? I would have you know that this small service will not be without a "price".
npc.topic.xanth.6: Hmm, yes well, perhaps I can take some time to instruct you in the dark arts.
npc.topic.xanth.7: Well, there is nothing that I have need for right now, but I will think of something. You will need my services again sometime in the future, and when you do, I will have devised a way for you to repay me.
npc.topic.yolak.0: I am Yolak. I sell items of all kind. Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything currently?
npc.topic.yolak.1: I sell items of any kind. Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.yolak.2: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.yolak.4: Well, what do you wish to buy?
npc.topic.yolak.5: What do you want to sell?
npc.topic.yrian.0: *Cough* *cough*... *sigh* Don't you smell it? Our Great Father is diseased and there isn't much I can do, as I don't have much time myself. Like our tree, I've been poisoned so that I don't offer any "resistance".
npc.topic.yrian.1: Please, I implore you, Traveler sent by the Winds, help us! *Cough* *cough*... This all happened because of a man who calls himself "Nomad"!
npc.topic.yrian.10: Oh, I don't know if she's dead or alive for sure, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.yrian.11: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.yrian.12: Mhorgwloth lives in the now ruined Castle Orkanis in the northwestern part of the island. He is a troll, and even if you defeat him--which is somewhat unlikely--he will regenerate and will eventually return.
npc.topic.yrian.13: The island of Raven's Dust is southern of this island. Our brothers have created there a sanctuary of peace dedicated to nature.
npc.topic.yrian.14: I founded the Order of Nature for the sole purpose of protecting nature around us. We are careful not to play God, however, and thus, we shall not play with the elements unless it is truly necessary.
npc.topic.yrian.15: When they were brought here by the foul "Jarko", they were so eager to eliminate the citizens of Windhowl and Lighthaven that they were blindly destroying the forest. My elemental magic alone was barely enough to stop the massacre, and thus I had to take "steps"... It led to the creation of the "Stone" "of" "Life".
npc.topic.yrian.16: With the aid of the "Stone" "of" "Life", which served as a catalyst, my elemental spells became strong enough to repel the army back to the western mountains.
npc.topic.yrian.17: The Forest Guardians are trees that can walk. You might have seen some at the entrance of this forest. Do not harm them, for they are our friends and they prevent the goblins from invading us.
npc.topic.yrian.18: Lantalir Rainmist has an uncanny talent. He is a very good student and he learns fast. Sometimes, I feel like he is the son I never had. He will someday grow as a very proficient water elementalist, if he so wishes.
npc.topic.yrian.19: Dunikus Hornwind is proficient with controlling the winds, something I'll never be able to do. Winds are so unpredictable.
npc.topic.yrian.2: It is written in our Ogham that a Traveler from the Tears of the Past will be sent by the Winds to cleanse the Land of its "Wounds". To this Traveler, the power of Balance will be given.
npc.topic.yrian.20: Arakas is the island you are standing on.
npc.topic.yrian.21: Jarko is a dark-souled necromancer, not that I've actually seen many followers of the dark path notably good. In any case, he has to be stopped. He causes the earth to rot, but it is a satisfying thought that his skin is rotting too.
npc.topic.yrian.22: Lighthaven is a town located on the south eastern part of this island. Its sister town is named "Windhowl" and is located on the southwestern part.
npc.topic.yrian.23: The inhabitants of Windhowl do not share our concerns for nature, they are much too busy doing business with Lighthaven and fighting brigands.
npc.topic.yrian.24: The Stone of Life is used merely as a defense to protect nature against harm. However, the Stone of Life must not fall in the wrong hands or terrible things could happen. If it gets stolen, we can create a new Stone of Life after a certain amount of time. The previous Stone of Life then becomes lifeless and is no longer filled with power.
npc.topic.yrian.26: I see you're interested. This is the spell I can teach you.
npc.topic.yrian.27: I could "teach" you the spell of heal critical myself, but I can also mend your wounds if you would like that.
npc.topic.yrian.28: Remember that nature must be protected or we will all die.
npc.topic.yrian.3: The land is screaming, my friend... *cough* it is suffering from something related to this "odour".
npc.topic.yrian.4: He came with his minions and he asked for the location of a crypt. *Cough*... we didn't know what he was talking about and so we couldn't answer his questions. As a reward, he cursed our Great Father with this plague. If only I had my "staff", *cough* I could reverse the harm that he's done...
npc.topic.yrian.5: Yes, now it's coming back to me. He said something about the way to the temple being near a small gypsy settlement somewhat far west from here. Perhaps that would be a good place for you to search *cough*! Take this... May it protect you as it has protected me. Now, please forgive me, but I must rest now...
npc.topic.yrian.6: My staff is an ancient relic that was created by the Great Druid Solinae the Eternal Child. *Cough* *cough*... It was created from the heart of the great tree whose seeds gave birth to our Great Father, centuries ago. Unfortunately, this Nomad saw the potential and he ordered his "commander" to take it from me.
npc.topic.yrian.7: In my weakened state, *cough* *cough*... I couldn't stop him. They've set up a camp southeast from here, near the water. Please! You must return my staff to me! *Cough* *cough*...
npc.topic.yrian.8: I am Yrian Earthsong, elder of this small community and founder of the "Order" "of" "Nature".
npc.topic.yrian.9: My priority is to protect nature from the insanity of humans and foul creatures such as "goblins". The burden of keeping the "Stone" "of" "Life" out of the hands of evil lies upon my shoulders. Finally, I also have to instruct the young ones such as "Lantalir" "Rainmist" how to control their growing power. I can probably even "teach" you a "spell", if you're patient enough, that is.
npc.topic.zhakar.0: That is correct! Using arcane formulae and complex components such as the blood of a Seraph, I've achieved invulnerability and immortality! It was quite an "experiment". Now I will be able to take my time and gain even more power than before.
npc.topic.zhakar.1: The experiment that resulted in my invulnerability has been a success. I'm not stupid, I tried my formula on something else first. I created a flesh golem from dead body parts, revived it using some powder from a Gem of Destiny, and performed my magic. It didn't work as expected at first, but it allowed me to perfect the spell before I tried it on myself.
npc.topic.zhakar.10: You'll probably find him hunting somewhere in Ravenwood.
npc.topic.zhakar.11: He was my mentor many years ago. He no longer resides on this island, but has instead moved on to Stoneheim. If you go there some day, once the way is open again, you may try and get an audience with him.
npc.topic.zhakar.12: I have already given you more than enough arcane spellbooks.
npc.topic.zhakar.13: Very well then. To create one arcane spellbook, I will require at least 10 "arcane" "scrolls" and a minimum of 35000 gold. The more scrolls you have, the easier the process will be and the less chance of failing I have. Do you have at least 10 arcane scrolls and 35000 gold?
npc.topic.zhakar.14: The most common use I have for these scrolls is to create "Sweepers". They are little rodents that help me clean up the tower. I suppose you could find them if you want the scrolls, I can always create more later.
npc.topic.zhakar.15: You can't find any more Sweepers? I'm sure they are around somewhere. You have but to look again and I am certain you will find more lurking around.
npc.topic.zhakar.16: Unless you want to swim, you might need some "mystical" aid.
npc.topic.zhakar.17: I know of a "ritual" of blood that would require a large amount of my strength. Then, you will be able to step in the small pentacle and be translocated on Stoneheim. Once you are there, you're on your own. I will do no more for you.
npc.topic.zhakar.18: Yes, that's right, I can do a teleportation "ritual".
npc.topic.zhakar.19: Princess Delilah is King Theodore's only daughter.
npc.topic.zhakar.2: Oh, I set it loose since I didn't have any more use for it. You can find it wandering around. I'm not worried for myself since I'm invulnerable, but you're obviously not, so watch your step.
npc.topic.zhakar.20: Balork is a low-level demon who terrorizes the inhabitants of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.zhakar.21: You are not ready to leave Raven's Dust just yet. I sense there are still great things you must do on here. I would not want to be the one to oppose the Fates and send you where you're not supposed to be. In due time, I shall help you reach Stoneheim, but not before.
npc.topic.zhakar.22: It seems that you have already heard of me, haven't you? Indeed, I am Zhakar the great wizard and sole master of this damned "tower".
npc.topic.zhakar.23: I am Zhakar, the great sorceror and sole master of this "tower".
npc.topic.zhakar.24: I do not think that you would be able to understand what I am doing here.
npc.topic.zhakar.25: As I have stated before, I am very busy with my study of Kraanians, but I am not without any free time. Therefore I have time to help you better your "magic" skills, if you have any that is, heh heh.
npc.topic.zhakar.26: Now then, let's see if we can improve those magic skills of yours.
npc.topic.zhakar.28: Ha! Ha ha! BwaahahahHAHAAHAHA!!! She told YOU that I'd give YOU a key if you mentioned HER name? Surely you JEST!!!
npc.topic.zhakar.29: Bane? I don't know much about him except that his head probably does not fit in the door frame!
npc.topic.zhakar.3: Yes well, er, by starting over I meant you will have to find more "Sweepers" and bring me more arcane scrolls. The ones you brought me before have already been consumed and there is nothing I can do about it.
npc.topic.zhakar.30: They are useful for disposing of unwanted visitors and thieves.
npc.topic.zhakar.31: Beware. They are skilled assassins and their offensive magic can be quite devastating... Hmpft! Much less powerful than me, mind you.
npc.topic.zhakar.32: This is the Tower of Sorcery. It is both my home and my tomb for I will never leave the library.
npc.topic.zhakar.33: They are swift assassins and cannot be trusted. However, they sorely lack skill in the Art which is why they are not "Nightblades" yet.
npc.topic.zhakar.34: Pah! He is a pathetic fool. He would be less than nothing without his personal advisors.
npc.topic.zhakar.35: You've seen them in action on Arakas, haven't you? It is quite peculiar to see the hatred they have toward giant wasps and death stingers. I would be quite interested in obtaining a "kraanian" "egg" to study its features.
npc.topic.zhakar.36: You've seen the rogue mages wandering in the accursed forest of "Ravenwood"? They are working under the orders of "Blackblood" but they shouldn't cause you too much troubles for they aren't very skilled in the Art yet.
npc.topic.zhakar.37: It has been quite a while since I had some. Now, begone!
npc.topic.zhakar.38: It took you time to understand. Finally, I can continue on my studies in peace.
npc.topic.zhakar.39: Heh heh... If I had a gold piece for every stupid question I've been asked, I'd be a wealthy man!
npc.topic.zhakar.4: The Deep Ones are living in a cavern south-east of the "Tower".
npc.topic.zhakar.5: As you've witnessed, the experiment was a SUCCESS!! I couldn't have done it without your assistance. I am therefore indebted to you and shall reward you for your help. I give you this ethereal amulet as a token of my gratitude.
npc.topic.zhakar.7: Have you come up here only to bother me? If you do not have anything better to do, you should leave before I get angry.
npc.topic.zhakar.8: If you want some belladona berries, you'll have to ask "GreyLeaf", the elder daemon tree. Be sure to ask real nice lest you want to get squashed like a flea. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.zhakar.9: GreyLeaf is a much more powerful demon tree than those you will see wandering around in Ravenwood.

npc.topic.zionthunderheart.1: If I feel like you must know, you will. Otherwise, that is none of your business.

npc.welcome.asarr: It was splendid! We attacked Lord Sunrock's men and we stole all the merchandise they had bought according to the report. But... Hmmmm, what's this? Ah, I see! Don't ya tell me, the poor Lord accused you of being a traitor, eh? Does it mean you want to chicken out on us?

npc.welcome.balork: You again? I see that you've grown some wings. BAH! Even that won't save your puny life this time!

spell.description.remort_aura: Aura offensive et défensive permanente, utilisable uniquement par les séraphins et gagnant en puissance à chaque renaissance.
spell.description.resist_fire: Augmente la résistance du lanceur aux attaques de feu.
spell.description.resist_ice: Augmente la résistance du lanceur aux attaques d’eau et de glace.
spell.description.sanctuary: Protège brièvement le lanceur de tout dommage corporel.
spell.description.shatter: Frappe la cible avec une force suffisante pour la réduire en morceaux.
spell.description.silversky_gateway: Téléporte le lanceur vers le cercle de pierres de Argentésky, sur Raven's Dust.
spell.description.silversky_portal: Invoque un portail permettant de se téléporter vers le cercle de pierres de Argentésky, sur Raven's Dust.
spell.description.soul_steal: Draine les points de vie de la cible et soigne le lanceur du même montant.
spell.description.stone_shard: Projette un petit éclat de pierre vers la cible.
spell.description.stone_skin: La peau du lanceur devient aussi dure que la pierre, augmentant sa classe d'armure.
spell.description.stonecrest_gateway: Téléporte le lanceur vers le cercle de pierres de Stonecrest, sur Stoneheim.
spell.description.stonecrest_portal: Invoque un portail permettant de se téléporter vers le cercle de pierres de Stonecrest, sur Stoneheim.
spell.description.sunken_woods_gateway: Téléporte le lanceur vers le cercle de pierres de Sunken Woods, sur Stoneheim.
spell.description.sunken_woods_portal: Invoque un portail permettant de se téléporter vers le cercle de pierres de Sunken Woods, sur Stoneheim.
spell.description.test_marked_for_death: L’âme frappée par cette malédiction doit rapidement trouver un exorciste afin d’expulser le mal qui l’habite.
spell.description.test_mass_plague: Ce genre est réservé aux tests et ne doit être utilisé que par un employé de Vircom.
spell.description.test_sanctuary_island: Ce genre est uniquement destiné aux tests et ne doit être utilisé ou remis qu’à un membre du personnel de Vircom.
spell.description.test_temporary_sanctua: Ce genre est uniquement destiné aux tests et ne doit être utilisé ou remis qu’à un membre du personnel de Vircom.
spell.description.tetrashock: Bouclier protecteur ripostant à chaque attaque physique par une puissante décharge électrique.
spell.description.tornado: Enveloppe la cible dans une masse tourbillonnante d’air condensé. Ce sort possède une grande zone d’effet.
spell.description.true_sight: Permet au lanceur de voir tout ce qui est caché ou invisible.
spell.description.tsunami: Fait s’abattre une vague géante sur la cible.
spell.description.turn_undead: Frappe une cible morte-vivante avec de puissantes paroles sacrées de bannissement.
spell.description.vaporize: Sort de destruction réservé aux maîtres de jeu. Attention : ce sort détruit tout objet, PNJ ou joueur sur lequel il est lancé.
spell.description.vortex_of_air: Projette vers la cible une masse tourbillonnante d’air comprimé.
spell.description.windhowl_gateway: Téléporte le lanceur vers le cercle de pierres de Windhowl, sur Arakas.
spell.description.windhowl_portal: Invoque un portail permettant de se téléporter vers le cercle de pierres de Windhowl, sur Arakas.
spell.description.wizard_s_vale_gateway: Téléporte le lanceur vers le cercle de pierres de Wizard's Vale, sur Raven's Dust.
spell.description.wizard_s_vale_portal: Invoque un portail permettant de se téléporter vers le cercle de pierres de Wizard's Vale, sur Raven's Dust.
spell.description.word_of_recall: Ramène magiquement le lanceur à son sanctuaire.
spell.description.wrath_of_drake: Sort offenssi réservé aux maîtres de jeu. Attention : ce sort n’est pas soumis aux règles JcJ et possède une très vaste zone d’effet. À utiliser avec prudence.
spell.description.wrath_of_marc: Paralyse complètement la cible pendant une très longue durée.
spell.description.wrath_of_the_ancients: La rage des races disparues contenue dans le sang d’une Nouvelle Race se déchaîne parfois contre ses adversaires.
